To embrace your nature as an Accursed is to accept that sickness upon yourself; death shall have its due(*), and time shall not heal this wound(**). * If you die with the death sickness and are resurrected by starbursts or similar means, you will not be cured of your afflictions. However, the sickness will pass from you to your killer in this instance. ** Those labouring beneath the death sickness are entirely immune to lesser aeonic workings: attempts to bring down the curse of the Aeon upon such a target without foci to amplify the working (a ruinated wheel tarot, or a vodun doll or puppet for example) shall fail.

abilities.description: In your own image.
abilities.detail: Your command over your domain has grown to the point where you can now reshape the chambers of your domain to fit your needs. There are various types of chambers that your domain can possess, and you can reshape any chamber within your domain excluding the initial chamber(*). * This is the one you arrive in when crypt entering.
abilities.syntax: CRYPT RESHAPE <to new type of room>

abilities.description: The simplest of reshapings.
abilities.detail: The most basic of reshapings, you can shape a room to be a simple passageway. These have no particularly useful properties, but may be used to mislead or trap intruders.

abilities.description: The beginning of the end.
abilities.detail: The interment chamber is perhaps one of the most important chambers in your entire crypt, though also one of the least vulnerable to tampering. By necessity it must be constructed directly adjacent to the entrance of your crypt, and you would do well to ensure it is protected.

abilities.description: The repository of your knowledge.
abilities.detail: This chamber in your crypt is where you may store your ritual tablets. See AB CHARNEL TABLETS for the details.

abilities.description: A chamber for rituals and more.
abilities.detail: Your ritual manifest is where higher arcane rituals are performed, with more specialised needs than the interment chamber.

abilities.description: Where treasures are laid to rest.
abilities.detail: The reliquary is a mysterious chamber within the depths of the Charnel crypt. Its true purpose is shrouded in mystery, though there are whisperings that it is utilised in some of the higher rituals of the art.

abilities.description: To claim the unwary.
abilities.detail: Many an unwary intruder has been dispatched with a simple hole in the ground. Place these well, and trap them appropriately(*). * Note that you can only build pits out of rooms with a single up exit.

abilities.description: Your hallowed hall.
abilities.detail: The tomb of your crypt is where your sarcophagus will be kept, and it is the most vulnerable to your enemies. All of your efforts should go to defending this most hallowed of halls, for the cost of failure is terrible indeed.

abilities.description: A step into the abyss.
abilities.detail: Many things lie in wait for those that will trespass in your domain, but may they dread each step and breath. You may create a trapdoor in a location with an exit to the down; this will conceal said exit. Furthermore, when your unsuspecting foes step onto the trapdoor they shall plunge down into the blackness beneath.
abilities.syntax: CRYPT TRAP BUILD TRAPDOOR / CRYPT TRAP DISMANTLE TRAPDOOR

abilities.description: They dare walk on hallowed stone.
abilities.detail: The stone of your crypt is so saturated with arcane power that you may use its very stone as a base for the logographs of Memorium. By carving them into the stone, all that enter their location excluding yourself will find themselves struck down by said logograph's power(*). * See memorium ability files for details.

abilities.description: Your domain has teeth.
abilities.detail: A simple trap, but a deadly one nevertheless. Bringing forth spikes in a location shall cause any that approach from the upward direction (voluntary or otherwise) to impale themselves on their dagger-like points, suffering terribly in the process.
abilities.syntax: CRYPT TRAP BUILD SPIKES / CRYPT TRAP DISMANTLE SPIKES

abilities.description: No mercy for trespass.
abilities.detail: Perhaps the most formidable trap in the array available to you, this deadly surprise for intruders shall trigger upon anyone other than yourself entering the chamber in which it is placed. The walls shall slowly begin to move inwards; around ten seconds later, they shall complete their terminal journey, crushing any that remain between them and leaving nothing but the dead in their wake. You may only have one of this trap in your whole crypt, and while it will not trigger upon you entering its room, you are still vulnerable to the final crushing impact.
abilities.syntax: CRYPT TRAP BUILD CRUSH / CRYPT TRAP DISMANTLE CRUSH

abilities.description: To protect what is yours.
abilities.detail: The most basic guardians that can protect your crypt, golems are sturdy constructs that shall batter your enemies with their fists as well as smashing any magical shields that they may raise. Only one golem can be brought forth in a location at a time.
abilities.syntax: CRYPT GUARDIAN RAISE GOLEM / CRYPT GUARDIAN BANISH GOLEM

abilities.description: The chittering guardians of the accursed.
abilities.detail: A far more formidable guardian to call forth than the simple golem, the swarms of scarabs are less hardy but far more vicious in their aggression.
abilities.syntax: CRYPT GUARDIAN RAISE SCARABS / CRYPT GUARDIAN BANISH SCARABS

abilities.description: The fundamentals of the stage.
abilities.detail: The fundamental of the performer, what more critical piece of the undertaking can there be than the beginning? Performances are split into two parts: Songs: these strike all your enemies in your location periodically in some manner dependent on the type of song you are playing. Movements: these passively benefit all of your allies in your location in some way as long as your song is playing. When starting out, your performance can only contain one movement, but as your skill grows, so too will the scope of your performance.

abilities.description: The blade sings.
abilities.detail: Melding song and steel in a perfection that only a true composer could appreciate, you may now strike with a song alongside a bladedance technique as well(*). * The refrain hits before the bladedance attack. Song effects when used as the refrain: Paean: Paralysis Bhajan: Dizziness Nomos: Breaks shield and lyre if either are present. If neither, breaks rebounding Gusheh: Addiction Ode: Asthma Ghazal: Slickness Elegy: Lethargy *You may also use a finale in place of a refrain. See the finale ability for details.

abilities.description: As the music plays on.
abilities.detail: You have advanced in your mastery to a point where you may now suspend a performance and resume it at will(*). * A suspended performance will not decrease in time remaining while you're online, and a suspended performance will not hit any enemies.

abilities.description: You are the maestro.
abilities.detail: You may now weave multiple movements into your song, having up to three simultaneously tied in with your grand performance.

abilities.description: The rising swell of the song.
abilities.detail: As you approach mastery of the performing arts, so too are your performances enhanced greatly. Now, all who are passively influenced by one of your songs who have a crescendo building about them will find that that crescendo draws faster with greater speed(*). * Each time your passive song hits someone the crescendo affliction gains a stack if present.

abilities.description: Such harmony profound.
abilities.detail: Though your own performances are doubtlessly grand beyond the reckoning of all that would behold them, sometimes one may simply wish to raise the level of another, perhaps tragically less gifted, musician. By performing this ability you will greatly raise an actively building crescendo about another(*), so long as someone other than yourself is responsible for it(**). * Sets their crescendo to one stack below the finale threshold. ** You cannot be the one who gave the crescendo affliction in question.

abilities.description: The curtain falls.
abilities.detail: If a crescendo has built sufficiently about a target(*), you may bring your ongoing performance to a grand finale. This ends your current performance. * Five stacks of crescendo. Finales: Paean: gives the reeling affliction for 20 seconds, which causes all bladedance attacks to be performed from the back position until it fades. Bhajan: Strikes the hearer with both stupidity and epilepsy. Additionally, if they are suffering from head trauma, they will lose focus balance for a significant period of time. Nomos: mangles an already level two broken leg. Prioritises the left over the right. Gusheh: mangles an already level two broken arm. Prioritises the left over the right. Ode: your foe will be rendered unable to communicate by any means for five minutes. Ghazal: causes your foe to succumb to a love-wrought madness for thirty seconds. While succumbed to said madness, they will be unable to. perceive the state of themselves (similar to recklessness) and all physical damage shall become unblockable. Elegy: any blessing of the stars protecting your target will be removed, and any starburst tattoos upon their person will be removed. Prosodion: transfixes the hearer with the power of the Accentato, making earworm incurable for twenty seconds.

abilities.description: And off to war they went.
abilities.detail: This song of war will cause all of your enemies who tremble beneath its hearing to know the bloodshed of times gone by(*). * All enemies bleed. Either for a small amount or twenty percent of their current bleeding, whichever is higher. When refrained: gives paralysis. Finale: gives the reeling affliction for 20 seconds, which causes all bladedance attacks to be performed from the back position until it fades.

abilities.description: That dread which stokes the fear.
abilities.detail: This dark song will stoke the fears of all of your enemies that hear it(*). * Gives the fear affliction. When refrained: gives dizziness. Finale: strikes the hearer into such a state of inaction that they will lose focus balance(*) for a significant period of time, as well as afflicting them with both stupidity and epilepsy. * Head must be damaged for focus knock.

abilities.description: The most disciplined resolve.
abilities.detail: The relentless march of your nomos shall crush the resolve of your enemies, destroying reflections raised about their person and revealing them for who they are beneath(*). * If they have only one reflection, it is destroyed. Otherwise the number of reflections protecting them is halved. When refrained: breaks shield or prismatic, if present. If neither is present, breaks rebounding. Finale: mangles an already level two broken leg. Prioritises the left over the right.

abilities.description: Of joy and feasts with friends.
abilities.detail: A song of the many joys of life, this grand performance is sure to cloud the senses of any enemy who hears it(*). * Stuns for a short time. When refrained: gives addiction. Finale: mangles an already level two broken arm. Prioritises the left over the right.

abilities.description: For heroes do we sing.
abilities.detail: This song about legendary heroes shall take the breath away from any enemy that hears you sing it, making them unable to say anything for a short time(*). If they are asthmatic, this time is increased. * Only impacts SAY. Telepathic channels are not influenced. When refrained: gives asthma. Finale: your foe will be rendered unable to communicate by any means for five minutes.

abilities.description: So sweet the love sublime.
abilities.detail: A song of heartache and love, when your enemies hear this song they will become lovestruck. While not as potent as the true lovers curse, this will make the afflicted potentially forget someone is an enemy in any given moment(*). * All enemy checks have a chance to fail outright. When refrained: gives slickness. Finale: causes your foe to succumb to a love-wrought madness for thirty seconds. While succumbed to said madness, they will be unable to perceive the state of themselves (similar to recklessness) and all physical damage shall become unblockable.

abilities.description: Weep for the dead.
abilities.detail: This solemn song for the dead will lay the weariness of loss upon all who hear it. Each time an enemy hears your song, their celerity will be greatly reduced(*), and if they are already lethargic, it will be eliminated entirely(**). * Their celerity will be set to one movement below maximum to whatever they can normally move. ** They will have their celerity reduced to the lowest possible level. When refrained: gives lethargy. Finale: any blessing of the stars protecting your target will be removed, and any starburst tattoos upon their person will be removed.

abilities.description: Of grandeur most Divine.
abilities.detail: The Prosodion is a song about the Gods, and all your enemies that hear it shall be struck down with a sliver of that grandeur. * Deals some damage passively to all enemies. When refrained: gives sensitivity. Finale: transfixes the hearer with the power of the Accentato, making earworm incurable for twenty seconds.

abilities.description: Before the beginning.
abilities.detail: This movement which prepares the body of you and your allies shall grant some resistance to magical damage.

abilities.description: You'll keep this party going.
abilities.detail: This upbeat movement bolsters you and your allies, reducing all willpower and endurance use by around ten percent(*). * Some abilities are unmodified by anything when it comes to this cost. As with other enhancements, this movement will not help in these cases.

abilities.description: To lend keenness to blades unsheathed.
abilities.detail: This movement will lend the blows of you and your allies with greater precision, granting a small bonus to critical hits.

abilities.description: Through thick and thin.
abilities.detail: his fast paced movement will periodically regenerate your health and that of your allies. This operates independently of other regeneration sources (so stacks with artefacts and similar).

abilities.description: To unburden all with ears to hear.
abilities.detail: The movement of the sonata shall unburden you and your allies of their afflictions periodically, healing one at random.

abilities.description: To soothe the mind and soul.
abilities.detail: A tranquil movement to bring peace to you and your allies, all that are affected by the pastorale will have a small chance to resist being forced to act against their will.

abilities.description: Onwards we march.
abilities.detail: The rondo movement bolsters you and your allies for the march ahead, halving the time it takes to cross rough terrain and similar(*). * Rubble, for example. This does not apply to moving through Charnel crypts, however.

abilities.description: For silent you will be not.
abilities.detail: This greatest movement may be added to any performance, and then not even a silence vibration or similar shall stop all from hearing your masterful song.

abilities.description: Refine a piece of crystal out of the Master.
abilities.detail:
This ability must be done in the presence of the Master Crystal. It will refine one of the possible crystal shapes from the Master, reducing the Master Crystal by one facet. Possible shapes are:
PyramidTorusPentagon
CylinderCubeDiamond
SpherePolyhedronSpiral
EggDisc
In order to replenish the facets of the Master Crystal, you must find pearls, and FOLD PEARL INTO CRYSTAL.

abilities.description: Fold pearls into a master crystal.
abilities.detail: The ability to fold pearls into a master crystal allows a magi to refine for the crystals necessary for the crystal arts.

abilities.description: Embed crystalline vibrations.
abilities.detail: Once you embed a vibration, it will shortly activate.

abilities.description: Determine how many facets you may refine.
abilities.detail: When done in the presence of a Master Crystal, this will tell you how many facets it has.

abilities.description: Set crystals to spinning.
abilities.detail: Set a crystal to spinning.

abilities.description: Attempt to dampen a vibration, destroying it.
abilities.detail: This ability gives you the power to destroy a vibration. You may only destroy vibrations that you are capable of embedding.

abilities.description: See what vibrations are in a room.
abilities.detail: This ability will show you what vibrations are in a room.

abilities.description: Attack the mana of your enemies.
abilities.detail: This vibration will attack the mana of your enemies.

abilities.description: Cause small heart attacks in your enemies.
abilities.detail: This vibration will cause small heart attacks in your enemies, doing damage.

abilities.description: Fill a room with soothing warmth.
abilities.detail: This vibration will heat up the room around you, counteracting the normal effects of cold weather.

abilities.description: Be alerted to movements of your enemies.
abilities.detail: This vibration will notify you whenever one of your enemies leaves or enters the room it is in.

abilities.description: Cause ground-shaking quakes.
abilities.detail: A low, rumbling vibration, this is powerful enough to knock non-levitating enemies off of their feet. If the adventurer is levitating, it will strip the defence.

abilities.description: Protect your vibrations against some attacks.
abilities.detail: This vibration will protect your other vibrations in the room against most things which might destroy them, except the Dampen ability and the Retardation vibration.

abilities.description: Open a portal to someone.
abilities.detail: When you embed this vibration, a portal will appear soon after leading between you and your target.

abilities.description: Suck those around you into your room.
abilities.detail: The adduction vibration will attempt to pull in people from adjacent locations.

abilities.description: Transport yourself back to the Master Crystal.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to return automatically to your Master Crystal, with a short delay. Note: - You must belong to a House with a Master Crystal and be at least of House Rank 3 - Targossas and Eleusis may access their Master Crystal at City Rank 2

abilities.description: A soothing, healing vibration.
abilities.detail: This vibration will heal either your afflictions or health and mana. If you TUNE to HEALING, it shall do the former; if you Tune to RESTORATION, it shall do the latter.

abilities.description: Cause fear in your enemies.
abilities.detail: This unnerving vibration will cause shyness in your enemies.

abilities.description: A sound-negating vibration.
abilities.detail: This vibration alters itself constantly so as to cancel out most sound in the room.

abilities.description: Reveal those around you who may be concealed.
abilities.detail: This vibration will cause concealed adventurers to be revealed.

abilities.description: Root yourself to the ground.
abilities.detail: This vibration will root you to the ground, and make it difficult for you to be moved or move, provided you are not in a watery environment.

abilities.description: Discordant music to cause amnesia.
abilities.detail: By creating neurologically disruptive vibrations, this ability will periodically give amnesia to your enemies.

abilities.description: The ability to see your vibes worldwide.
abilities.detail: This ability will show you the status of all your active vibrations.

abilities.description: Draw your vibrations back to you.
abilities.detail: By producing a specific resonance, you may call one of each vibration you actively possess to your current location(*), though all others will be destroyed in the process. * Does not call the reverberation vibration.

abilities.description: Disorient your enemies with dizziness.
abilities.detail: By disrupting the inner ear, this vibration will cause periodic dizziness in your enemies.

abilities.description: Suck health from your enemies and use it.
abilities.detail: This ability will drain the health of your enemies, and store a portion of it. When you wish to use that health, you must do ABSORB ENERGY. This will, however, destroy the vibration.

abilities.description: Destroy the equilibrium of your enemies.
abilities.detail: Stridulation vibrations afflict your enemies with stridulating periodically. This affliction shall cause your hostile vibrations to periodically coalesce upon their frequency so long as it remains upon their person. * Note that the retardation and silence vibrations are excluded from the hostile vibrations which will do so.

abilities.description: Increase the power of gravity in the room.
abilities.detail: The oscillations of this vibration cause the downward pull of gravity to be increased in your room, pulling those in the trees and sky to the ground.

abilities.description: Cause a forest of sharp crystal to arise.
abilities.detail: This vibration causes a forest of small, very sharp crystals to arise, damaging anyone who falls in the room, provided they are not levitating.

abilities.description: Cause your enemies to become dissonant.
abilities.detail: Every person vibrates with a certain fundamental frequency. This vibration will cause damage in those vibrating at the normal frequency, but has a chance of causing enemies to vibrate dissonantly. In this case, the enemy in question will lose a defence periodically.

abilities.description: By your design, or none at all.
abilities.detail: Sometimes a magi may find that another seeks to set the tone of an engagement, creating vibrations to block the use of one's own. This unacceptable state of affairs is no true barrier to the accomplished sorcerer. You may DETUNE another magi, and all vibrations span by them in your location will become detuned. * Detuned vibrations hit the owner as well as their enemies. * Detuned vibrations inform all magi in the current location when they influence someone.

abilities.description: Afflict your enemies with debilitating effects.
abilities.detail: A powerful vibration, it will slowly kill your enemies who stand within it, giving a variety of afflictions before death.

abilities.description: Put your enemies to sleep.
abilities.detail: The powerful lullaby vibration will put your enemies to sleep.

abilities.description: Slow time in your location.
abilities.detail: The retardation vibration slows time in the location, giving the aeon effect to everyone in the room, including you. Unfortunately, due to its time-bending effects, this vibration will disable any crystalline vibrations in the room with it that offer passive effects, and affect any weapons or projectiles thrown from outside of the vibration's effect.

abilities.description: Unleash the fury of a team of magi.
abilities.detail: This is the most powerful of the vibrations. Two magi must each spin all eleven of the crystals before one can EMBED the CATACLYSM vibration. Once the vibration has been embedded, the second magi (who must also have transcendent Crystalism) must IMBUE the vibration with his power to complete the cataclysm. This vibration will only function outdoors. Once this has been done, anyone with STAFFCAST, FREEZE, or TRANSFIX in Elementalism will be able to cast them through the cataclysm vibration at anyone outdoors within a three room radius.
abilities.required: 300 mana shapes=Cylinder, Cube, Diamond, Disc, Egg, Pentagon, Polyhedron, Pyramid, Spiral, Sphere, and Torus (2 of each total, 1 of each spun per Magi)

abilities.description: he power to destabilise crystalline vibrations is formidable indeed.
abilities.detail: Your mastery over Crystalism grants insights into the exact tonal frequencies necessary to throw crystalline vibrations into disarray and causing them to become unstable. This will inevitably cause the vibration to be destroyed, but their instability will cause them to have various potent effects upon the location before they expire. Adduction: will attempt to draw all those in adjacent locations into the room. Alarm: informs you of all people in the local area. Creeps: afflicts everyone in the room with fear, agoraphobia, and claustrophobia. Disorientation: prones and gives dizziness to everyone in the room. Dissipate: drains mana from everyone in the room. Dissonance: breaks all magical shields protecting adventurer's in the location. Energise: restores some health for each person besides the destabiliser. Forest: causes nontrivial bleeding to everyone in the room. Gravity: forces all those in the sky above back to the ground. Grounding: launches everyone in the room into the sky. Harmony: will restore health to everyone in the room. Heat: deals fire damage and causes ablaze to everyone in the room. Lullaby: strips the metawake and insomnia defences. Oscillate: deals minor damage and afflicts everyone in the room with both epilepsy and stupidity. Palpitation: deals damage to everyone in the room. Plague: breaks the limbs of everyone in the room. Retardation: afflicts everyone in the room with the curse of Aeon. Reverberation: destroys all monolith, cube, knife, and eye sigils on the ground in your location. Silence: blocks all usage of communication channels for a short time by all present when used, even if they then leave the room. Revelation: strips the phase, astralform, or blackwind defences from everyone in the room. Stridulation: disrupts the mental equilibrium of everyone in the room. Tremors: creates rubble to block the exits of the room.

abilities.description: Instill great fear in your target.
abilities.detail: This ability works to instil fear in your victim.

abilities.description: Discern the severity of your victim's wounds.
abilities.detail: With a practiced eye, determine how severely your victim is bleeding.

abilities.description: Dampen an opponent's hearing.
abilities.detail: Remove the hearing of your victim.

abilities.description: Curse your opponent with uncontrollable bleeding.
abilities.detail: Induce bleeding in your target. This ability will work on Denizens as well as adventurers.

abilities.description: Your victim will fumble about.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to fumble about.

abilities.description: A devastating fear of heights.
abilities.detail: Afflict your target with a great fear of heights.

abilities.description: Inability to concentrate on focused tasks.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with an inability to concentrate on focused tasks.

abilities.description: Make your victim forget what he meant to do.
abilities.detail: Make your victim forget what he meant to do.

abilities.description: Fear of open spaces.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with a fear of open spaces.

abilities.description: Cut through an opponent's curseward.
abilities.detail: Rip down your opponent's cursewards.

abilities.description: Causes problems when trying to move.
abilities.detail: Afflict your target with severe dizziness.

abilities.description: Fear of being under cover.
abilities.detail: Afflict your target with a great fear of enclosed spaces.

abilities.description: They are out to get you, believe me.
abilities.detail: Instil a fear of other people in your victim.

abilities.description: Curse an opponent with blindness.
abilities.detail: Remove your poor victim's eyesight.

abilities.description: The love of your own pain.
abilities.detail: Make your victim love pain so much they will inflict it upon themselves.

abilities.description: Creates difficulty when breathing.
abilities.detail: Make it difficult for your victim to breathe.

abilities.description: The ability to drive your curses through magic shields.
abilities.detail: With the ability of truecurse, adventurer's magical shields will no longer get in the way of your dreaded curses.

abilities.description: A dangerous disregard for personal well-being.
abilities.detail: Give your target a dangerous disregard for their personal well-being.

abilities.description: Disrupt the nervous system of your victim.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to go into seizures.

abilities.description: Cause the victim's mana to bleed away.
abilities.detail: Sap away mana from your target.

abilities.description: Fill your enemy's mind with thoughts of peace.
abilities.detail: Fill your enemy's mind with thoughts of peace, granting the pacifism affliction.

abilities.description: Distorts the victim's perceptions of the world.
abilities.detail: Distorts the victim's perceptions of the world.

abilities.description: Freeze the limbs of your enemy.
abilities.detail: Cause your victims body to freeze with paralysis.

abilities.description: Curse someone with the voyria affliction.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with the deadly Voyria.

abilities.description: Creates a terrible addiction.
abilities.detail: Cause your target to become addicted.

abilities.description: The ability to deliver curses much more quickly.
abilities.detail: This potent defence will drastically speed up your next ten curses after initiation. Breach is excluded.

abilities.description: Make a victim dumb as a rock.
abilities.detail: Make a victim dumb as a rock.

abilities.description: A victim's health will slowly bleed away.
abilities.detail: Sap away your target's health.

abilities.description: Cause your victim to become extremely sensitive to pain.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to become extremely sensitive to pain.

abilities.description: Upset the stomach of your enemy.
abilities.detail: Induce severe vomiting in your hapless victim.

abilities.description: Put an enemy to sleep, or remove his sleep defences.
abilities.detail: Put an enemy to sleep, or remove their sleep defences.

abilities.description: Deny them respite from their wounds.
abilities.detail: Deny your victim the ability to clot their wounds.

abilities.description: A terrible condition, preventing one from eating.
abilities.detail: A terrible condition, preventing one from eating.

abilities.description: Weaken the body of your opponent.
abilities.detail: Weaken your opponent's body.

abilities.description: The most feared of the Curse abilities.
abilities.detail: A blight is a magical construction, sourced in the netherworld, wrapped around a traditional curse which will mask the effects of your attacks. Note that the use of the blight is more mentally draining than a traditional curse. Curse mana costs are increased by +120

abilities.description: Set a victim's very blood aflame.
abilities.detail: This potent curse will cause your target's blood to catch a flame. It requires that your victim first be bleeding; the more they suffer, the greater the potency of the curse.

abilities.description: Bring a most painful end to your victim.
abilities.detail: This requires at least one of the listed afflictions to pull off. Though once you have their mind in your grasp you can use the devastating Tzantza curse to shrink their head. Watch the fun as their skin draws tighter and their skull implodes upon itself. The more afflictions your victim suffers over, the faster the process will proceed. At six afflictions, death is instantaneous. Valid afflictions are: Agoraphobia, Amnesia, Claustrophobia, Confusion, Dementia, Dizziness, Epilepsy Impatience, Masochism, Paranoia, Recklessness, Stupidity, Vertigo, Addiction

abilities.description: The ultimate shamanic curse.
abilities.detail: This highest of the shamanic arts allows a practitioner to combine two curses into one assault, delivering both simultaneously. However, due to the extreme complexity of such an undertaking, the practitioner must prepare themselves to channel the malign energies, by utilising the lesser curses to build up a sufficient charge.

abilities.description: Look into the soul of someone.
abilities.detail: When performed upon yourself, this will reveal your current devotion levels. When performed on an adventurer, this will reveal their devotion levels if they have access to the Light. It will also reveal if they have accepted the true path of Good and have received a Preaching blessing.

abilities.description: Lay hands on a person to heal him.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to lay hands on yourself or another to heal some damage.

abilities.description: Water will pull apart to make way for your blessed self.
abilities.detail: In true religious tradition, you will now be able to part the water in a location, allowing safe and dry passage.

abilities.description: Show an adventurer the beauty of belief.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you the opportunity to preach to an adventurer. Should they accept the enlightened truth you offer, they will receive a blessing over their life that allows them to be targeted with the DELIVERANCE and RESURRECTION abilities.

abilities.description: Dispel illusions with the power of your devotion.
abilities.detail: This ability allows you to detect certain types of hidden adventurers in your room.

abilities.description: List what rites are active.
abilities.detail: This ability will show you what rites are operating in your room.

abilities.description: The Gods will provide for you.
abilities.detail: At the cost of some devotion, you may feed yourself with this ability. You need to be holding a bowl of some sort in order for this to work. Upon performing the rite, your bowl will be filled with Divine manna, which will provide you with great sustenance.

abilities.description: Gain an infusion of divinely-inspired strength.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause you to pray for divinely-inspired strength, effectively raising your strength +2 for a short time.

abilities.description: Give an adventurer a glimpse of paradise.
abilities.detail: This will give your companion a glimpse of Paradise. The vision will be so calming and refreshing that the target will receive many beneficial blessings.

abilities.cooldown: Rite: 5.00 seconds of equilibrium Travel: 3.50 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Travel to someone in a Rite of Pilgrimage.
abilities.detail: By performing the rite of pilgrimage, you are able to then pilgrimage to anyone standing in that rite.
abilities.syntax: PERFORM RITE OF PILGRIMAGE / PERFORM PILGRIMAGE <target>

abilities.description: Damage the Unholy.
abilities.detail: Call upon your faith to the Bloodsworn and assail a foe's soul with your righteousness and pious fury. This holy prayer will bypass any magical shields or prismatic barriers around your target. This ability does not cost devotion when used against denizens.

abilities.description: Condemn the unfaithful to eternal penance. unique=Yes
abilities.detail: Through your piety, you are able to force an individual to perform penance for their crimes. Upon granting redemption to this person through death, your works will be rewarded with an increase in your Devotional energies. When used against an adventurer, this will brand them and upon granting redemption to this person through death, your righteous work will be rewarded with an increase in your Devotional energies. Against denizens, this will scour your foe in righteous fire, forcing them to take ten percent more damage from your mace(*) and the weaponmastery attacks of your fellow Paladins(**). In this case, the devotion cost of this holy art will be reduced but its equilibrium cost will be slightly increased. * SPIRITUALITY SMITE. ** All weapon-based attacks in the WEAPONMASTERY skill when performed by a Paladin.

abilities.description: Attack the chaotic nature of a chaos entity, pacifying it.
abilities.detail: Chaos entities are the stuff of disorder, and your ordered, calm behavior is striking enough to drive them into submission for a short period of time.

abilities.description: Condemn your foe with horrific visions.
abilities.detail: Condemn your foe as an enemy of creation, striking them down to never know peace with the dementia and shyness afflictions.

abilities.description: Drive your enemies off with overwhelming fear.
abilities.detail: This ability will set up a rite that will ward off any of your enemies that enter the room, by giving them fear.

abilities.description: Make an adventurer follow your wish.
abilities.detail: Using your powers over those who are open to hearing the message, you may force an adventurer to bend to your will and carry out your commands.

abilities.description: Bind those around you with the force of ultimate piety.
abilities.detail: This rite will make it difficult for your enemies to leave the room. When it successfully prevents them from moving, they will suffer a balance penalty.

abilities.description: Confuse and dazzle an opponent.
abilities.detail: This will dazzle the mind of an adventurer with stupidity.

abilities.description: Summon demons to torment the unrighteous.
abilities.detail: This rite will cause your enemies to be tormented by vengeful demons.

abilities.description: The sin of sloth is yours to condemn.
abilities.detail: Condemn a target with the sin of sloth, giving them weariness.

abilities.description: Gain insight into all movement into and out of holy areas.
abilities.detail: When activated, this ability will inform you whenever any of your enemies enters or leaves the room that the Rite is in.

abilities.description: A powerful healing ability.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause a rite to spring into existence which will occasionally heal an affliction from you and your allies that are in the room.

abilities.description: A rite to keep those nearby fed and rested.
abilities.detail: The rite of well-being is a beneficial rite to all in the room. While in it, one will not grow any hungrier or sleepier. It lasts for quite a bit longer than the standard rite.

abilities.cooldown: Rite: 4.00 seconds of equilibrium Summon: 6.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Call to you someone in a Rite of Convocation.
abilities.detail: This powerful ability will allow you to create a Rite of Convocation. Anyone in a Rite of Convocation set up by you can then be summoned by you by doing PERFORM CONVOCATION <adventurer>, providing that adventurer does not have certain defences set up, such as the mass salve.
abilities.syntax: PERFORM RITE OF CONVOCATION / PERFORM CONVOCATION <target>

abilities.description: A rite to heal health and mana.
abilities.detail: This rite will heal a percentage of one's maximum health and maximum mana. It will affect everyone in the room who is not an enemy of the Devotionist who performed it.

abilities.description: Deliver a target unto you.
abilities.detail: This will allow you to summon an adventurer from any distance should they have been blessed with the PREACHING ability. It should be noted that a monolith sigil placed in the room of the summonee or summoner will prevent this from working. Be aware that delivering another adventurer out of combat may open you up for repercussion.

abilities.description: Rid your enemies of their unclean aspects.
abilities.detail: This relatively short-lived rite will begin slowly stripping the defences of any enemies in the room. It shall always strip the blackwind or astralform defences first.

abilities.description: Reclaim one of your rites.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to remove one of your rites from your location, regaining some of the devotion used to summon it.

abilities.description: Pray for the salvation of your congregation.
abilities.detail: To perform this rite, there must be at least eight people together in a room. Apprentices do not count and you may be the only person with Devotion there. All of the adventurers must KNEEL before the rite can begin and no adventurer may participate in this rite more than once every Achaean month. You will gain a certain amount of devotion for every adventurer present, and the members of the assembled congregation will gain experience also. 500 devotion is gained for each valid person present as the rite ends.

abilities.description: Send the unholy Chaos entities back to their hell.
abilities.detail: This rite will occasionally attempt to destroy a chaos entity, provided that a minion of chaos, sent by the Chaos Prince, Dameron, is not in the room. Also, it is rumoured that those occultists to have formed a pact with the greatest of the Chaos Lords may be capable of defeating this potent rite.

abilities.description: Rob them of their will to eat.
abilities.detail: Instill an antipathy for food in your target, giving anorexia.

abilities.description: Grant life anew to a slain believer.
abilities.detail: One of the holiest of abilities, this will grant life anew to the target adventurer. For this ability to work, the adventurer must have been preached to and accepted the blessing over their life or be under level 30.

abilities.cooldown: Illuminate: 1000 mana, and 1500 devotion Extinguish: 1000 mana, and 500 devotion
abilities.description: Illuminate your path.
abilities.detail: When you perform this ability, you will create an orb of light which will move off in the direction specified. The orb is unpredictable and will move erratically. Each time it moves, the orb will illuminate the room, giving a chance to strip the blackwind or astralform defences from adventurers in the room. In addition, you may extinguish the orb at any time to travel directly to the room the orb is currently in. It should be noted that the orb will only have enough energy to move a limited number of times, and it will fade if not extinguished a short while after it ceases moving.
abilities.required: Illuminate: 3.50 seconds of equilibrium Extinguish: 4.00 seconds of equilibrium

abilities.description: Cleanse the land of necromantic corruption.
abilities.detail: Drive out necromantic corruption, destroying the hands of the grave that may clutch at the living in a location. If a Necromancer stands guard over said hands, there is a delay during which the faithful may perform no other actions, so focussed on their task are they.

abilities.description: Bond with another via a blood oath.
abilities.detail: The bond of the bloodsworn is one of the most revered rituals of devotion-users. When a Priest and a Paladin feel strongly that they wish to become one, they bloodswear to each other, and from that moment on, have the capability to bond their very souls to each other. When the BLOODSWORN ON ritual is performed by both the Priest and the Paladin, their maximum health and manas will be 65% of the -sum- of both their normal maximum health and maximum mana respectively. Further, some portion of the health or mana healed by either the Priest or Paladin, when using elixirs of health or mana, will also be healed on his or her bloodsworn. The hands ability shall also heal an additional amount when performed on your bloodsworn. The bloodsworn ability will automatically turn off if the Priest and Paladin are away from each other for greater than approximately 60 seconds. As with many phenomena that grant great power unto the user, the power of the bloodsworn comes at a price. While the bloodsworn pact is activated, with BLOODSWORN ON, the mana of both the Priest and Paladin will drain away. Further, and far more seriously, if either dies while the ability is active, the other will be critically damaged in body. Such is the price of power. If you wish to break your blood bond, you may do so by rejecting your bloodsworn, but be aware that you will not be able to become bloodsworn to another until the New Year.
abilities.required: Bloodswear <target>: 1000 mana Bloodswear on: 1000 mana, 5 mana per second drain
abilities.syntax: BLOODSWEAR <priest or paladin> / BLOODSWORN ON/OFF / BLOODSWORN REJECT

abilities.description: Use the basic skills to interact with your falcon.
abilities.detail: The art of Falconry is a noble one indeed. It is a sport reserved solely for those of chivalrous breeding, for a bird as noble as the falcon would never respond to commands given by one without honour. When you initially gain Falconry, the first thing you must do is find a hatchery. At the hatchery, FALCON REQUEST. Hatcheries are located in: * the Mhojave desert near the Ruins of el'Jazira - the Ashtan resource hub - the Cyrene resource hub - the Eleusian resource hub - the Hashan resource hub - the Mhaldor resource hub - the Targossas resource hub - the manor of the Grand Merchant Collective, in Delos (*) this is the only public hatchery. Each hatchery gives out a different breed of falcon. The breeds vary in appearance only: capabilities are identical. Your falcon comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. If you cause your falcon to die, you will be refused another falcon. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your falcon. Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your falcon. FALCON ASSESS : See information about your falcon. FALCON RECALL : Recall your falcon to your wrist. Requires a falconry glove. FALCON SANCTUARY : Order your falcon to a sanctuary where it will be safe. FALCON LAND : Order your falcon to land on the ground. FALCON CIRCLE : Order your falcon to fly up into the skies. FALCON TRAIN : Order your falcon to go train, in order to raise a stat. FALCON REPORT : Gain information on where your falcon is. FALCON SLAY : Order your falcon to slay someone. FALCON HUNT : When your falcon is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. FALCON FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your falcon will flee battle. FALCON SLEEP : Order your falcon to sleep. FALCON FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your falcon. As your falcon gains in Stamina: its health will increase. Speed: it will attack more quickly as well as fly from place to place more quickly. Strength: it will attack with more power as well as be able to carry larger items.

abilities.description: Increase your ability to weather damage.
abilities.detail: Your budding control over your body will assist you in weathering the storm of life by increasing your constitution by one point.

abilities.description: Order your bird to seek out an adventurer.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may order your falcon to seek out another adventurer. Your falcon must be either on the ground or on your wrist to use this ability.

abilities.description: Look through the eyes of your bird.
abilities.detail: If your falcon is not inside someone's inventory, or inside something, this will let you see the location it is in.

abilities.description: Obstructing departure with your body.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to block a particular direction, preventing normal movement in that direction.

abilities.description: Controlling your breathing.
abilities.detail: With your mastery of your own body, you are able to purge yourself of the asthma affliction.

abilities.description: Order your falcon to aerially follow someone.
abilities.detail: You have established enough of a rapport with your falcon now that you may order it to follow, from the air, a particular adventurer. When the falcon loses the adventurer, generally because the adventurer goes indoors, it will stop following.

abilities.description: Grip your wielded items in a deathlock.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Barging your opponents.
abilities.detail: This ability will barge an adventurer to the direction you choose. To start the ability, you must be in a room adjacent to the room where the target adventurer resides, and you must choose to barge him in a direction that wouldn't take him into the room you are in. So, for instance, say that Isildur is in a room to the north of me, and that this room has another exit to the ne. I would do BARGE ISILDUR NE.

abilities.description: Stun a target with the power of your voice.
abilities.detail: Your battle cry is so powerful that when directed against another, it will blast him to the ground and stun him, provided he isn't deaf.

abilities.description: Use of the valued projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: Use one of the various bows to shoot an adventurer in a line-of-sight location from you.

abilities.description: Take full advantage of your quiver.
abilities.detail: Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver. When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver. Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver. To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.
abilities.syntax: ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom> / INSPECT QUIVER / DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour> / SWITCH <colour>

abilities.description: Further increase your accuracy through wind compensation.
abilities.detail: Once you have this ability, your accuracy with bowmanship will be increased.

abilities.description: Increase your accuracy in shooting.
abilities.detail: Increase the accuracy of your shooting.

abilities.description: Standing firm against attempts to move you.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: Order your falcon to deliver an object to someone.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: Reduce the damage taken from magical attacks.
abilities.detail: Due to your increased bodily control, you are able to reduce the damage from magical attacks.

abilities.description: A powerful projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: The crossbow is more powerful, but less accurate, than the longbow.

abilities.description: Reduce the level of your bleeding.
abilities.detail: This will permit you to partially clot your bleeding.

abilities.description: Throw off pacifying afflictions.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to cure certain pacifying afflictions, notably those that are normally cured by eating bellwort.

abilities.description: Command your falcon to strike with its talons.
abilities.detail: Command your falcon to fall upon a denizen opponent, raking them with its talons and dealing damage(*). Note that you can only command your loyal in this fashion every so often(**). * This damage is based on your falcon's trained strength and whether it is a warhawk (see AB DISCIPLINE WARHAWK). ** Every 30 seconds.

abilities.description: Command your falcon to fetch an object for you.
abilities.detail: Using this ability will cause your falcon to try and pick up an object (which musn't be too large) in the room that it is in, and deliver it back to you. Upon doing so, it would probably be appropriate to say some kind words to your falcon and maybe pet it a bit.

abilities.description: Order your bird to harass an opponent's steed.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow your falcon to startle an opponent's steed, tossing the poor rider off. Note that this works regardless of whether your opponent is on the ground, in the trees, or flying. You simply need be in the same room, and the falcon will fly to the correct elevation to startle your target's mount.

abilities.description: Order your falcon to follow and track someone.
abilities.detail: This ability is an improved version of falcon follow. With track, even if the falcon temporarily loses its target, because the target went indoors, the falcon will continue to follow the target once the target comes back outside.

abilities.description: Attempt to protect someone else with swordwork.
abilities.detail: Upon using this ability, you will attempt to take much of the damage from the blows that might otherwise harm the adventurer you are defending.

abilities.description: Your falcon can now report on the state of individuals.
abilities.detail: If your falcon is flying, it will report back to you the health levels of everyone who is in the local area and outdoors.

abilities.description: Using the infamous darkbows of Hashan.
abilities.detail: The famed darkbows of Hashan are both expensive and powerful. Only slightly less powerful than a crossbow, they are far more accurate.

abilities.description: Equip your falcon with talons of steel.
abilities.detail: If you have a set of steel talons, you may equip your falcon with them, allowing it to attack with more strength.

abilities.description: Damage a cowardly opponent.
abilities.detail: There is nothing more despicable and dishonourable than a coward, and this ability will allow you to punish cowards, as is their due. Once you have engaged an adventurer, if he is otherwise unhindered and tries to leave the room, you will get in an extra strike, whether you have equilibrium and balance or not.

abilities.description: Mount or vault your steeds at increased speed.
abilities.detail: You have reached such a level of training in the arts of Chivalry that you regain balance while Mounting a steed much more rapidly. Furthermore, if you have the ability Vault in Riding, you can use it without any loss of balance at all.

abilities.description: Temporarily raise your strength.
abilities.detail: This will allow you to temporarily raise your strength with 2 points, for no more than a total of 1/4th of each Achaean day. It can be used once a day without cost, but if you turn it off and turn it back on within the same Achaean day, you will incur a cost of 500 willpower each time you turn it back on. Your endurance losses will be significantly higher while Fury is active.

abilities.description: Skyrax, the Skyscourge.
abilities.detail: When you call upon the aid of Skyrax, he will send you a whirling dervish, which, when you command it will knock your target from the skies or trees.

abilities.description: Rixil, the spectre.
abilities.detail: Rixil, when summoned, will send to you a sycophant, which, when COMMANDed, will significantly increase the recovery time from your victim's next attempt to focus their mind. When primebonded, the sycophant shall drain the mana of your enemies; this mana is increased if they are shivering, and increased even more so if they are frozen.

abilities.description: Eerion, the demon jester.
abilities.detail: When you call upon Eerion, he will send to you a foul little gremlin, who will, when COMMANDed, shatter the magical shields surrounding your target. If your target labours under the whispering madness affliction, you will recover faster from this ability. When primebonded, the gremlin shall race around the legs of your target, inspiring dizziness in them; if they are already dizzy, it shall knock them off balance.

abilities.description: Arctar, the Defender.
abilities.detail: Arctar, the Defender. Enigmatic, skilful, Guardian of the Chaos Throne. When you summon him, he will send to you a chaos orb. This orb may then be COMMANDed to explode, granting you a temporary defence against that which would harm you.

abilities.description: Scrag, tender of the bloodleech pool.
abilities.detail: Scrag is the tender of the bloodleech pool upon the Plane of Chaos. When called upon, he shall send one of his servants to you: when commanded, it shall thin the blood of your foe, causing them to suffer from haemophilia. When primebonded, the leech shall coax out the blood of your foe, making them bleed. If their blood is thinned, the amount of bleeding will be increased.

abilities.description: Pyradius, the firelord.
abilities.detail: Pyradius will send his firelords to assist you. These Chaotic minions have the power to convert the afflictions your enemies labour into other conditions: - Whisperingmadness becomes recklessness. - Manaleech becomes anorexia. - Healthleech becomes psychic damage (this does not cure the healthleech). When primebonded, the firelords will strike down those in your location and adjacent ones with Pyradius' fire, burning them and setting them ablaze.

abilities.description: Golgotha, the Ascendant's Thrall
abilities.detail: Though a mere shadow of his former glory, Golgotha will pact with occultists. He will grant a protection from attempts to magically banish your chaotic servants back to the Chaos Plane, though it will only aid you when you are in the same location as the targeted entities.

abilities.description: Jy'Barrak Dameron, the Hand
abilities.detail: Jy'Barrak Dameron is the right hand of the infernal throne. The minion he shall send to aide you can be commanded to unravel the very mind of your target, slaying them instantly(*). The minion's of Dameron gain no benefit from being primebonded, though when one is present it will protect all of your other minions from being banished from the prime. * They must be enlightened, as with unravel via the occultism skill.

abilities.description: Palpatar, the Glutton of Glaaki.
abilities.detail: When you call upon the Glutton of Glaaki he shall send one of his vile worms to aide you. When commanded at a victim it shall infest them with the Glutton's maggots, which shall periodically leech away their health(*), though they wither and die given some time. When primebonded, the worm shall burrow into your target's belly, making them violently ill periodically(**). * Gives healthleech on a tick. ** Gives nausea.

abilities.description: Nin'Kharsag, the Slime Master.
abilities.detail: Summoning the Slime Lord will cause a chaos slime to be sent to you. When COMMANDed, it will envelop your victim and cause their next tree tattoo attempt to take longer to recover from. If they have asthma, they will also be paralysed; inhaling the Slime Lord's spawn is never good for one's health. When primebonded, the slime shall periodically damage your target; the amount of damage inflicted is increased if they are suffering from healthleech.

abilities.description: Istria, the pathfinder.
abilities.detail: When called upon, Istria, known as the Pathfinder, will send to you a pathfinder entity. Wherever you summon the pathfinder entity will be home to it. Later, you may simply ORDER PATHFINDER HOME to be taken back to where the pathfinder was summoned from.

abilities.description: Marduk, the eater of souls.
abilities.detail: Marduk will send to you a soulmaster entity. This entity may be ordered to POSSESS an adventurer. When it does, it will take a few seconds to gain control of the victim's mind. Once it has done this, you may ORDER <target> <command>. Doing this is quite difficult for the soulmaster though, so you will be restricted to doing it once every few seconds.

abilities.description: Agency upon the Prime.
abilities.detail: The minions the Chaos Court will send to you are limited in their agency given the constraints they labour under. No matter. A skilled user of Domination will find they are able to forge bonds with the various Chaos Lord's upon the Chaos Plane, and by doing so grant the minions those Lords will send greater freedom when summoned(*). You may only support up to four bonds at a time, so choose wisely. Bonds may only be forged in the presence of the Lord you seek to bond with; they may be severed from anywhere. * Entities benefitting from a prime bond will act passively in addition to retaining their active effects. See the ability files for relevant details for each entity.
abilities.syntax: PRIMEBOND / PRIMEBOND FORM <chaos lord> / PRIMEBOND SEVER <chaos lord>

abilities.description: Nemesis.
abilities.detail: When you call upon Lord Nemesis he shall send to you a humbug, which when commanded to strike your enemy shall inspire an insatiable addiction in them. When primebonded, the humbug shall drain some health; if they are suffering from said insatiable addiction, it shall also drain some mana as well as additional health.

abilities.description: Buul, the Chaos Chirurgeon.
abilities.detail: When you call upon Buul he shall send to you a chimera, which you may ride, and when commanded at a foe will deliver a most terrifying roar. If your target is not deaf, they shall suffer an affliction of the mind. When primebonded, the chimera shall periodically strike out with one of its heads at a target, causing one of the following effects: - A roar which will cure a target's deafness if such is present, or knock them prone with a stun if it is not. - A headbutt which will knock your foe prone. - An insidious blast of breath which shall inspire sleep in your enemy.
abilities.syntax: COMMAND CHIMERA AT <target> / MOUNT CHIMERA / SPUR CHIMERA SKYWARD

abilities.description: Cadmus, the cursed shaman.
abilities.detail: The plague lord will send to you a bubonis, which when commanded, will inflict such torment upon your foe with a single touch that their lungs will fill with fluid(*). If they are already suffering in such a way, they shall be struck down with slickness. When primebonded, the bubonis shall act of its own will, inflicting your foe with maladies of the mind. * Gives asthma.

abilities.description: Piridon, the shapechanger.
abilities.detail: When you summon Piridon, he will send to you a doppleganger. The doppleganger will look like you, though it must be referred to as 'doppleganger'. The doppleganger is much different from other entities in that it may be remotely commanded. CHANNEL <ab> : Allows you to channel certain Occult abilities through your doppleganger. These include: Ague, Devolution, Eldrichmists, Quicken, Shrivel, Timewarp, and Warp. CLOAK : Masks your doppleganger's entry and exit. EXITS : Shows the exits from the room your doppleganger is in. LOOK : Your doppleganger looks at the room it is in. MOVE <dir> : Your doppleganger moves in a specific direction. RETURN : Your doppleganger returns to you. SEEK <who> : Your doppleganger seeks a specific adventurer. If he is flying, it will go and wait underneath. Trees present no obstacle to this. Special note about channeling: the channel to your doppleganger is a two-way link, however briefly it may be in operation. Any backlash from an attack channeled through your doppleganger has a very high likelihood of continuing through that link and harming you directly.

abilities.description: Danaeus, the dark savant.
abilities.detail: Danaeus will send to you a Chaos Storm. You may command the storm to inflict your target with clumsiness. When primebonded, the storm shall periodically notify you of where its target is located, providing they remain in the local area and are not protected from forms of scrying.

abilities.description: Xenophage, keeper of the chaos gate.
abilities.detail: Xenophage will, when called upon, bring you instantly to the Chaos Plane. However, you must be on full health and mana to use this.

abilities.description: Lycantha, Keeper of the Hounds.
abilities.detail: The Keeper of the Chaos Hounds shall send one of his charges to serve you when called upon. When commanded to strike an adventurer, the hound shall inspire weariness in them. Against denizens, the hound will rend their flesh, dealing damage(*). When primebonded, the hound shall periodically break magical shields when such are present. * Commanding your hound against denizens requires and uses equilibrium, rather than entity balance.

abilities.description: Command your doppleganger to throw tarot cards.
abilities.detail: Willing your doppleganger to use a card in your possession, you'll be able to order it to fling it remotely! Note that not all of the tarots can be used by the doppleganger. For instance: Death and Hermit, among others.

abilities.description: Hecate, Mother of the Crones.
abilities.detail: Hecate will send to you a withered crone which can be commanded to wither the limbs of your victim. When primebonded, the crone will act to wither limbs on her own, though she will not always pick wisely.

abilities.description: You are known to the court.
abilities.detail: Having established yourself as a practitioner of the art, you are now able to make pacts on a greater scale than previously. While you have formed prime bonds with a cadre of the Chaos Lords, you may establish a covenant. You may have up to two covenants at once, and swap between them by manifesting the desired of the two. (*)This swaps your set of prime bonds. (**) This comes with a long equilibrium.
abilities.syntax: COVENANTS COVENANT ESTABLISH COVENANT DISBAND <covenant> COVENANT MANIFEST <covenant>

abilities.description: A transaction most profane.
abilities.detail: Melding your knowledge of Occultism with the bonds you have wrought with the Lord's of the Chaos Court, you may pour karma down one of these established connections to empower the servants of that Chaos Lord that stand alongside you. * Doubles the tick rate of that entity and forces a tick to happen very shortly after the empowerment, though that entity will be destroyed within 18 seconds. ** You may only perform this ability once per minute.

abilities.description: Glaaki, the Eldritch Ascendant
abilities.detail: Ancient; formidable; greatest of the Chaos Lords. The Eldritch Ascendant is all of these and many things left best unspoken. Ruthlessly pragmatic, Glaaki tore his rule from the hands of those thought untouchable. Any who pact with him beware, for slights can fester a thousand years or more. To those granted his grace, the Ascendant shall bestow the use of one of his abominable servants. This avatar, when commanded to violate a victim whose aura has been made sufficiently vulnerable to external assault, shall determine the fundamental nature of the target and grant the occultist the greatest weapon of all; knowledge of their subject's true name. (*) an aura can be made sufficiently vulnerable through the cleanseaura ability in Occultism. (**) truenames gained in this way have a much shorter lifespan than those gained through standard methods.

abilities.description: Your loyal nightmare.
abilities.detail: The hungering hounds of Lycantha are a gift to each of the Unnamables of Ashtan, part of the great pact between Imperator Glaaki and the Seat of Chaos. Your hound comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. If you cause your hound to die, you will be refused another hound. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your hound. Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your hound. HOUND ASSESS : See information about your hound. HOUND RECALL : Recall your hound to your side. HOUND SANCTUARY : Order your hound to a sanctuary where it will be safe. HOUND TRAIN : Order your hound to go train, in order to raise a stat. HOUND REPORT : Gain information on where your hound is. HOUND SLAY : Order your hound to slay someone. HOUND HUNT : When your hound is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. HOUND FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your hound will flee battle. HOUND SLEEP : Order your hound to sleep. HOUND FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your hound. As your hound gains in * Stamina: its health will increase. * Speed: it will attack more quickly as well as move from place to place * Strength: it will attack with more power. You will gain other abilities later on that are related to your hound. You must visit Lycantha on the Chaos Plane to request your hound.

abilities.description: Increase your ability to weather damage.
abilities.detail: Your budding control over your body will assist you in weathering the storm of life by increasing your constitution by one point.

abilities.description: Order your hound to find its prey.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may order your hound to seek out another adventurer. Your hound must be by your side for you to use this ability.

abilities.description: The sense of sight through a certain lens.
abilities.detail: Look through the eyes of your hound, seeing its immediate surroundings(*). * Does not work if it is in someone's inventory or similar.

abilities.description: Obstructing departure with your body.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to block a particular direction, preventing normal movement in that direction.

abilities.description: Controlling your breathing.
abilities.detail: With your mastery of your own body, you are able to purge yourself of the asthma affliction.

abilities.description: The hunt begins.
abilities.detail: Your hound has learned to serve you well enough that you may order it to follow a particular adventurer. When the hound loses the adventurer, generally because the adventurer goes indoors, it will stop following.

abilities.description: Grip your wielded items in a deathlock.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Barging your opponents.
abilities.detail: This ability will barge an adventurer to the direction you choose. To start the ability, you must be in a room adjacent to the room where the target adventurer resides, and you must choose to barge him in a direction that wouldn't take him into the room you are in. So, for instance, say that Isildur is in a room to the north of me, and that this room has another exit to the ne. I would do BARGE ISILDUR NE.

abilities.description: Stun a target with the power of your voice.
abilities.detail: Your battle cry is so powerful that when directed against another, it will blast him to the ground and stun him, provided he isn't deaf.

abilities.description: Use of the valued projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: Use one of the various bows to shoot an adventurer in a line-of-sight location from you.

abilities.description: Take full advantage of your quiver.
abilities.detail: Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver. When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver. Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver. To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.
abilities.syntax: ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom> / INSPECT QUIVER / DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour> / SWITCH <colour>

abilities.description: Further increase your accuracy through wind compensation.
abilities.detail: Once you have this ability, your accuracy with bowmanship will be increased.

abilities.description: Increase your accuracy in shooting.
abilities.detail: Increase the accuracy of your shooting.

abilities.description: Standing firm against attempts to move you.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: A courier of a more reliable kind.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may order your hound to deliver a small item or group of items from your inventory into the inventory of another adventurer.

abilities.description: Reduce the damage taken from magical attacks.
abilities.detail: Due to your increased bodily control, you are able to reduce the damage from magical attacks.

abilities.description: A powerful projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: The crossbow is more powerful, but less accurate, than the longbow.

abilities.description: Reduce the level of your bleeding.
abilities.detail: This will permit you to partially clot your bleeding.

abilities.description: Throw off pacifying afflictions.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to cure certain pacifying afflictions, notably those that are normally cured by eating bellwort.

abilities.description: A snap of the jaws can vex all kinds of plans.
abilities.detail: using this ability will cause your hound to try and pick up an object in the room that it is in, and deliver it back to you.

abilities.description: They won't see this coming.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow your hound to startle an opponent's steed, tossing the hapless fool off.

abilities.description: The hounds of Lycantha are relentless
abilities.detail: This ability is an improved version of the follow ability. With track, even if the hound temporarily loses its target, because the target went indoors, it will continue to follow the target once the target comes back outside.

abilities.description: Attempt to protect someone else with swordwork.
abilities.detail: Upon using this ability, you will attempt to take much of the damage from the blows that might otherwise harm the adventurer you are defending.

abilities.description: Sniff out victims.
abilities.detail: Your hound can sniff out all in the local area, informing you of their location and current health.

abilities.description: Using the infamous darkbows of Hashan.
abilities.detail: The famed darkbows of Hashan are both expensive and powerful. Only slightly less powerful than a crossbow, they are far more accurate.

abilities.description: A superior state of being.
abilities.detail: As you shall achieve the transcendent state of being, it is only appropriate that your loyal companion shares in your transformation. Though fine tuned manipulation of such matters are beyond you, with sufficient application of karma you can somewhat overcome this lack. * This improves your hound's offensive capabilities rather significantly.

abilities.description: Damage a cowardly opponent.
abilities.detail: There is nothing more despicable and dishonourable than a coward, and this ability will allow you to punish cowards, as is their due. Once you have engaged an adventurer, if he is otherwise unhindered and tries to leave the room, you will get in an extra strike, whether you have equilibrium and balance or not.

abilities.description: Mount or vault your steeds at increased speed.
abilities.detail: You have reached such a level of training in the arts of Chivalry that you regain balance while Mounting a steed much more rapidly. Furthermore, if you have the ability Vault in Riding, you can use it without any loss of balance at all.

abilities.description: Temporarily raise your strength.
abilities.detail: This will allow you to temporarily raise your strength with 2 points, for no more than a total of 1/4th of each Achaean day. It can be used once a day without cost, but if you turn it off and turn it back on within the same Achaean day, you will incur a cost of 500 willpower each time you turn it back on. Your endurance losses will be significantly higher while Fury is active.

abilities.description: Open conduits to the Elemental Realms.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may open a channel to one of the four basic elemental realms. Keeping these channels open has a cost in willpower. SEVER AIR/WATER/EARTH/FIRE will close that channel. CHANNELS will list what channels you have open.

abilities.description: Light up your surroundings.
abilities.detail: With the illuminating power of fire, you may momentarily reveal those in the room who may be hiding.

abilities.description: Protect your open channels from attack.
abilities.detail: Using this ability will provide you protection against abilities that may attack your open elemental channels. These abilities will first have to attack your fortification before destroying your channel. However, fortify does have a regular willpower cost associated with it. If you choose to fortify all, the mana and eq costs will be the cost of fortifying a single channel multiplied by the number of channels you have open.

abilities.description: Locate another adventurer.
abilities.detail: By summoning up an image in a pool of water, you are able to scry for the location of a target.

abilities.description: The Elemental Planes are at your fingertips.
abilities.detail: Certain Elemental Spells cause a form of resonance with the Elemental Planes upon which they draw(*). As your resonance grows, the last target of the spell you cast to cause that increase in resonance will suffer various affects, listed below. Resonance is fleeting and will fade over time. Air: -Minor resonance: gives asthma. -Moderate resonance: gives sensitivity. -Major resonance: gives healthleech. Earth: -Minor resonance: breaks a random limb (it will always pick an unbroken limb). -Moderate resonance: stuns the target for a short time and gives paralysis. -Major resonance: gives cracked ribs (it does not increase the number of cracked ribs a target has - only ever gives the base affliction). Fire: -Minor resonance: both strips and gives an effect which prevents the raising of the temperance defence.. -Moderate resonance: scalds the target. If the target is already scalded, sets the target ablaze and deals some damage. -Major resonance: gives the blistered affliction. If they're already blistered, gives a stack of the ablaze affliction. Water: -Minor resonance: gives the frostbite affliction. If it is already present, does some damage. -Moderate resonance: gives the stuttering affliction and deals some cold damage. -Major resonance: gives the anorexia affliction. * These are listed under AB ELEMENTALISM. ** Note that resonance is only generated if your spell is targeted against an adventurer who is directly within your location when it resolves (i.e. ranged firelash will not generate resonance, but in room will). *** You can set your verbosity for seeing resonance messages to none, low or high. The default is low.

abilities.description: Destroy the defences of your opponent.
abilities.detail: With the destructive fury of all the elements at your command, you may destroy a defence on an opponent. This spell will strip the first defence it does not find from the below list, and if none are present strip any random defence. You may also specify one of the listed defences and target that on in particular: Shield, chargeshield, insulation, and temperance. * Note that this spell is special in that while instead of increasing resonance, when you successfully strip a defence all resonance you possess is decreased by one level unless you specify the MAINTAIN argument.
abilities.required: 75 mana channels=Air, Earth, Fire and Water

abilities.description: The magic of channel binding.
abilities.detail: Like fortification, binding provides protection against losing your channels due to others attacking them. If a channel that is unfortified is attacked, binding will protect that channel a large percentage of the time. It has a willpower loss associated with it, however.
