If you choose to BIND ALL, the mana and equilibrium costs will be what it costs for a single channel binding, multiplied by however many channels you have open.

abilities.description: Cast a spell of extreme cold at your enemies.
abilities.detail: This spell is a magnified version of the freeze spell, except that it is not targetable. It will attack all those in the room who are your enemy.

abilities.description: Cast an illusion of your choosing.
abilities.detail: With this spell, you can create an illusion of your choosing in the room about you. You may embed a single newline by using the character sequence \n in your illusion. For limitations and restrictions, please refer to HELP ILLUSIONS in full.

abilities.description: Parallel channeling.
abilities.detail: Using this fine ability, you will simultaneously open channels to the Air, Water, Earth, and Fire realms.

abilities.description: Call down the wrath of the storm upon multiple enemies.
abilities.detail: This powerful attack can cast a lightning bolt at one, two, or three adventurers or denizens.

abilities.description: A sliver of Primal Fire.
abilities.detail: When dealing with a sufficiently weakened foe(*), you will be able to unleash the wrath of Kkractle directly upon them, destroying them. * They must be afflicted with a conflagration and have 40% of their health or less. ** You must be wielding an elemental staff to perform this ability. *** While this ability may be cast normally, if you also possess an ashbeast it will be enhanced, and will bypass starburst protections and similar in this case.

abilities.description: Create a delayed explosion of immense power.
abilities.detail: This extremely powerful spell creates a magical bomb with a timer on it. When the time runs out, the bomb will explode in a massive, fiery holocaust.

abilities.description: A delayed eruption of magmatic fury.
abilities.detail: This powerful spell creates a sphere of magma that, after some time has elapsed (specified by you), will violently explode. The flying stone has a chance to break the limbs of any in the current location in addition to the significant damage that it will always deal.

abilities.description: The freezing touch of Sllshya.
abilities.detail: With this higher order spell, if your enemy is already frozen, you may bring a terrible cold down upon him or her, removing their ability to heal their frozen state. * This affliction is cured via the restoration salve.

abilities.description: A downpour of stone.
abilities.detail: This higher order earth spell will summon up a storm of rocks to periodically pummel your victim(*). For every two times the rocks pummel a victim, your resonance with the Elemental Plane of Earth will decrease. The storm will cease once your resonance is gone entirely. * This will do damage and break a random limb of your victim if your victim is unshielded. If they are shielded, it will break the shield.

abilities.description: The very world shall burn at your command.
abilities.detail: This formidable higher order fire spell will call a rampant firestorm into being. This will spread to all adjacent rooms and will periodically sear the flesh of any who stand within said locations. Be warned. Fire is truly an indiscriminate force. You shall not be spared from a firestorm, even if you were the one to call it forth.

abilities.description: A doom of Maklak's make.
abilities.detail: This higher order spell will inflict terrible damage upon those that are already frozen.

abilities.description: Summon forth a terrible conflagration.
abilities.detail: This higher order fire spell will cause a conflagration to engulf your target. This conflagration will deal periodic damage until the person is able to extinguish it. The only way to do this is to remove all traces of the ablaze affliction from their person. For the purposes of this spell, suitably vulnerable requires that the target has two or more stacks of the ablaze affliction.

abilities.description: The elements unleashed.
abilities.detail: This higher order spell will allow you, when you are majorly resonant with one of the Elemental Planes, to unleash all of your accumulated power in a single devastating strike. This clears any resonance you have with the given Plane, and each type has a various affect: Air: your target will be struck down with paralysis and dizziness, as well as being stunned for a short time. If they already have dizziness, they will be given asthma instead. Earth: your target's torso will become calcified. Additionally, if cast against someone with serious internal trauma, your foe shall be slain outright. Fire: your target will be given two stacks of the ablaze affliction. Water: your target will be given a level of freeze (or have the insulation defence stripped), and will be disrupted along with being afflicted with stuttering. All emanations deal damage.
abilities.required: 100 mana channels=Air, Earth, Fire, and Water

abilities.description: Life's water will ever run clear.
abilities.detail: With major resonance to the Elemental Plane of Water achieved, you may cast this higher order to keep your blood and body ever clean of many malign forces(*). This removes all of your resonance with all Elemental Planes, lasts ten seconds and carries a long cooldown. * You will become immune to many afflictions (primarily those cured by herbs and minerals) while this defence lasts.

abilities.description: Unbounded arcane might.
abilities.detail: This formidable higher order spell requires that your victim has progressed to the fourth stage of the dissonance affliction and requires moderate resonance to all of the Elemental Planes at a minimum. You may then place this mark upon your target, and thus spell their doom. A target you have converged is vulnerable to your staffcast magic no matter where they might flee upon your current plane, and your scrying magic will incur no equilibrium when seeking them out. Additionally, they will become very vulnerable to all forms of elemental and magical damage coming from your arcane personage, and your magic will bypass any shield or prismatic barrier they may attempt to raise(*). * Or similar defences.
abilities.required: 300 mana channels=Air, Earth, Fire, and Water

abilities.description: Blow someone in a direction with a gust of wind.
abilities.detail: By channeling the element of air, you can either blow a fog or cloud out of the room, or blow an adventurer in a particular direction.

abilities.description: Attack with elemental fire.
abilities.detail: By lashing out with fire, you may damage an adventurer or a denizen, melt an icewall, clear an overgrowthed totem, or melt ice-covered ground. Note that you can hit adventurers with this from an adjacent room, and when cast in room against an adventurer it will also set them ablaze.

abilities.cooldown: Ground: 4.00 seconds of equilibrium Targetted: 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Chill another adventurer.
abilities.detail: When casting freeze at the ground, you will cause a coating of ice to cover it, causing others to slip occasionally. When casting it at another adventurer, you will first strip the insulation defence if the target has it, then cause the target to shiver, and finally freeze him. If you successfully cast this upon a target (for example, a heat vibration does not stop it), it also causes damage.
abilities.required: Ground: 200 mana Targetted: 100 mana channels=Air and Water

abilities.description: Knock someone out of the trees or the sky.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may knock a flying or treed adventurer out of the sky or trees. If you have major resonance with the Elemental Plane of Water, your target will also be disrupted.

abilities.description: Make them vulnerable to the consuming flame.
abilities.detail: This working of fire and water will sap the excess moisture from your victim, making them become dehydrated for a time(*) and suffer some damage. * Gives the nausea and weariness afflictions. ** If they already have weariness, they will be given a stack of burning. If they already have nausea, gives a stack of freeze. If they have both, it gives burning (not both freeze and burning).

abilities.description: Fry your enemies with awesome bolts of lightning.
abilities.detail: Strike down an adventurer with a sizzling bolt of lightning. * Gives the fulminated affliction. If they already have this affliction, gives the epilepsy affliction. If they have both, gives the paralysis affliction. ** Also deals damage.

abilities.description: A trivial application of Air and Earth.
abilities.detail: This trivial application of Air and Earth summons up a flurry of small rocks to bombard and disorient a foe. * Gives the clumsiness affliction.

abilities.description: A sludge to send them sprawling.
abilities.detail: Summon up a sticky tide of mud to knock your foe sprawling and leave them covered in sludge. * Deals some damage, and gives the slickness affliction as well as knocking the target prone.

abilities.description: Rock to boil and bubble.
abilities.detail: Summon up a boiling tide of magma to scald the flesh of your foe with(*). * Gives the scalded affliction and deals some damage.

abilities.description: Mesmerize your target into inaction.
abilities.detail: By creating a mesmerising pattern of fire, you may transfix an opponent into inaction. Blindness will prevent this, but this will remove the blindness in the process. When the blindness is removed, if you are moderately resonant with both the Elemental Planes of Air and Fire, your target will also be afflicted with stupidity. * Note that you only gain resonance and the associated affects when transfix unblinds. When it transfixes proper, your resonance decay will be reset but you will not gain any of the associated benefits on that cast.

abilities.description: Create a distracting illusion of yourself.
abilities.detail: By focusing the light of fire through a prism of elemental air, you can create a magical reflection of yourself, which will absorb one attack before being destroyed. You may only have one reflection at a time.

abilities.description: Coat your fists with rock and punch with more power.
abilities.detail: By coating your fists in elemental earth, you'll find yourself better able to grip your staff against attempts to pull it from your grasp.

abilities.description: Create a protective but supple layer of stone around you.
abilities.detail: Similar to the manner in which stonefist coats your fists in stone, stoneskin coats much of your body in stone, providing some protection against physical attacks (more from blunt than from cutting damage). As your skill in elementalism increases, so will the protection this ability affords you.

abilities.description: Create a magical shield to resist electric damage.
abilities.detail: The chargeshield is a defensive spell which will provide you with some protection from electric attacks.

abilities.description: Boil off that which afflicts you.
abilities.detail: Through the purifying powers of fire, and the recuperative powers of water, you may cure yourself of an affliction with this spell. If you suffer under the haemophilia affliction your blood will be too thin for this spell to take affect, and if you have both major resonance with the Elemental Planes of Fire and Water this ability will have a chance to cure a second affliction.

abilities.description: Give your skin diamond-like hardening.
abilities.detail: Greatly increase your resistance to cutting damage, and modestly increase your resistance to blunt damage, by adding diamond-like hardness to your skin. The protection afforded increases with your skill in elementalism.

abilities.description: Create a wall of elemental fire.
abilities.detail: Channeling the power of elemental fire, you will create walls of burning flame.

abilities.description: Conjure up obscuring fog.
abilities.detail: With the powers of air and water, you may cause an elemental fog to fill your surroundings.

abilities.description: Create choking fumes in your surroundings.
abilities.detail: This spell will create a noxious cloud in your location, choking those around you.

abilities.description: Drown a location in water.
abilities.detail: Channel the power of elemental water to flood the room you stand in.

abilities.description: Open cracks in the ground to drain away water.
abilities.detail: By summoning forth a minor earthquake, you are able to drain away any water that may be flooding your location.

abilities.description: Conjure up an obstructing icewall.
abilities.detail: This spell will create a wall of elemental ice, blocking the passage of those who would seek to pass by.

abilities.description: Call down a hailstorm to pummel everyone else in the room.
abilities.detail: With this spell, you may rain hailstones down upon all your enemies in your location.

abilities.description: Luck is a power all its own.
abilities.detail: The study of luck was one that bore many benefits, but the most wildly acclaimed one was that which granted the ability to deal even more devastating critical blows. While protected by this beneficial defence you will be able to potentially deal up to plane-razing critical strikes(*). * Does not stack with the artefact paragon that grants a similar effect.

abilities.description: The might of the raging waters.
abilities.detail: Call upon the might of the waves to carry you away. This shall throw you between 1 and three rooms in a random direction. There is a delay before you may call upon this after doing so previously.

abilities.description: Some marks cannot be washed away.
abilities.detail: The study of the soul was one many Aldar felt uncomfortable with pursuing. For this reason there was very little advancement in this field until quite late comparitively, and many of the techniques discovered were considered lackluster. However, one that fell into wide spread use by the Aldar was the ability to place a mark upon someone's very soul, able to locate that person where ever they might be on any plane of the multiverse. There were no protections against such an enactment, even changing one's phase with reality or assuming incorporiality being insufficient. Unfortunately, the true scale of this marking process is lost to time. To achieve this effect you will first require the corpse of the person whose soul you wish to mark, and said marking shall fade after some Achaean days.
abilities.syntax: ENACT SOULMARK <corpse|name of person> / ENACT SOULMARK

abilities.description: Tremors and tribulations.
abilities.detail: At your command the very earth shall quake and tremble, cracks opening and forming great piles of rubble to block some of the exits from your location.

abilities.description: Before the fall.
abilities.detail: The Servitors that wander the city of Nur were once the hands of the Aldar in every day life. Not truely of the living, these constructs handled everything from crafting to maintaining the wildlife. Alas, no more true servitors shall be created, for the Finality upon his throne is unlikely to return to such a passtime in the modern age. Yet for all that some scraps of knowledge remain, and you may bring forth one of these servitors at a time: Aklan: causing this servitor to act shall have it inform you of everyone in its local area. Kindler: causing this servitor to act shall cause it to flood its room. Varthiis: causing this servitor to act will cause it to strike all in the room with its blades, inflicting a very small amount of damage. You may cause a servitor to act when it stands or with you, or remotely if you have stationed it. Causing it to act remotely will make it return to your side. Note that imperfect as these servitors are, they shall not fight on your behalf: all they come into being with is their directive to perform their core function.
abilities.syntax: ENACT COMPANION <servitor type> / SERVITOR ACT / SERVITOR STATION / SERVITOR RETURN / ENACT COMPANION DISMANTLE

abilities.description: Elemental fury to ravage and rage.
abilities.detail: The study of the elements was somewhat of an unfortunate field to be engaged in historically. In the early days there were concerns about intruding upon the realm of Agatheis, as he was somewhat of a mysterious god even to the Aldar. Later, said gods betrayal in the War of Humanity made most Aldar avoid this field at all costs. Nevertheless, some advancements were made, particularly when trying to replicate the destructive power of the newly met Dragon's breath. By calling upon elemental destruction, you will send a blast of power to ravage a foe you can see in your line of sight. Focussing on the elements in this way is unpredictable, and your results may vary: Ice shall deal damage and freeze the target. Fire shall do damage and set the target ablaze. Lightning shall deal more damage than the other two, but has no secondary effect.

abilities.description: Your word against their will.
abilities.detail: The act of imposing one's will on others was somewhat of a divisive topic among the Aldar. Nevertheless, there were those that felt the mind was the key to all understanding, and bending the mind to one's will was a natural step in that exploration. Though the terrible dominion of the Protean mind ring was never fully emulated, progress was made. You may command a target to obey your command, and some time later(*) they will carry out that action. * The higher the intelligence of your target, the greater their ability to resist, and the longer the action shall take before it is carried out.

abilities.description: There is power in such things.
abilities.detail: The golden sovereign has been the currency of Sapience long before modern civilisation, but even before the metal held power. The specifics are likely beyond all but the Logos and perhaps the Lord Merchant, but the Aldar did make certain discoveries. By extracting the power in the metal, they were able to restore themselves greatly(*), though it did result in the metal being destroyed. Many considered this a failed experiment as the costs became so high, but there were some that felt it was a worthwhile discovery nevertheless. * You may destroy a specified amount of gold and restore your endurance by an equivalent amount.

abilities.description: A fluxing of chaotic power.
abilities.detail: There were very few forays into this field of study before it was simply agreed upon to be abandoned. The affects were simply too unpredictable, even if sometimes benefitial. By enacting this power, you will change the health of everyone in your location to better over represent the whole. * There is only so much this can modify a person's health by, and only so much a given person can influence the overall result.

abilities.description: Bleed them dry.
abilities.detail: Enhancing your vision will allow you to perceive where blood flows most strongly even through the barrier of your foe's skin, enabling you to target your attacks with devastating precision(*). * Your next three blows shall all deal significantly increased bleeding.

abilities.description: Mind over all.
abilities.detail: To enhance thought is to enhance all. By bolstering your mental clarity, you will greatly speed your equilibrium recovery for a short time.

abilities.description: Its not over yet.
abilities.detail: Resurrection. Such a long-studied field and so many disasters therein. Though the art was long since mastered, all forms that exist utilise some external force; doing so through pure force of will and power is something that many Aldar's strove for, but never could realise. Perhaps the final reason for the end to this line of study was the terrible act which came to become known as the reprise. When a mutual ally falls in battle, providing you have their corpse upon the ground at your feet you may enact the reprise. They shall return to life immediately, ready to continue the battle. However, after only a short while the power that drew them back to their mortal shell shall be exhausted, and their soul will be torn away and sent plunging into the Halls of Death. This death is unavoidable; no secondary affects can prevent it from occurring. Perhaps most cruelly of all, when the individual dies for this second and most final time, their blood shall fall upon the hands of their resurrector. Note that you may not perform this act while recovering from/maintaining a lifebond due to the conflicting nature of the methodologies involved.

abilities.description: Unleash your fury.
abilities.detail: The rageblade was a weapon so terrible in its potential that no wielder has ever truely mastered it. It is of no surprise that there was relentless study into discovering its secrets, and yet such discoveries were rare and strangely divergent in their affects. When sufficiently weakened(*), you may unleash your fury, bolstering your health and granting you both the clarity and rupture defences. This is extremely taxing, and you may only do it every so often(**). * You must be below half of your maximum health. ** Every three minutes.

abilities.description: Some things must not walk free.
abilities.detail: Though the Aldar could never replicate the desired functionality of the golden chain, they did determine a way to bind someone quite effectively. By summoning bonds of light, you may chain a person to you. They will find it difficult to move away until they get at least some distance(*). * The bonds fail after the two people are not in the same or adjacent rooms.

abilities.description: The martyr's calling.
abilities.detail: You may bond yourself to a comrade(*), and in the eventuality that said comrade should tragically fall in battle, you will give up your very life in their stead. Be warned, not even the vilest of necromantic magics or chaotic manipulations will spare you from this death, and neither shall the stars shine upon your soul. Falling in this manner shall instantly hurl you into the Halls of the Finality. * You may only place one of these bonds so often, and there is a cooldown on the target (that is placed once they are resurrected via this bond) as well.

abilities.description: Your pain, your gain.
abilities.detail: The redirection of lethal injuries was a universally studied field, as many among the Aldar had no love for the arts of war. Unfortunately, the greatest knowledge remaining of that era is not one to enhance those of a pacifistic nature: indeed, quite the opposite. By focussing on a target for a short while during while you may perform no other actions, you may create a sympathetic bond with them for a short time(*). While this bond is active any damage you take from almost all sources shall be redirected to this person, providing they remain in the same location as you. Note that performing any action will cause the sympathetic bond to snap, and this will not protect you from blows that will slay you outright.

abilities.description: The shadow of the Battlemaster.
abilities.detail: The war veil. When empowered, an ultimate defence that could not be penetrated. In an age where conflict was on the rise and death had suddenly become a real concern for the Aldar, this was the relic that they most vigourously wished to emulate the powers of. It was also the one where they failed almost entirely. Though much research was done into a way to replicate the ultimate defence, it was never achieved. Yet something else emerged from those experiments: a way to allow ones miriad images to instinctively react to throw themselves in harms way. Though it was a bitter defeat in the eyes of those that had striven so hard, certain infamous Aldar made this into a truely terrible thing to behold. Each miriad image can take only so many(*) hits before it will shatter, and they will not always react. * Three strikes per image.

abilities.description: Instill great fear in your target.
abilities.detail: This ability works to instil fear in your victim.

abilities.description: Dampen an opponent's hearing.
abilities.detail: Remove the hearing of your victim.

abilities.description: Inability to concentrate on focused tasks.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with an inability to concentrate on focused tasks.

abilities.description: Your victim will fumble about.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to fumble about.

abilities.description: A devastating fear of heights.
abilities.detail: Afflict your target with a great fear of heights.

abilities.description: Curse your opponent with uncontrollable bleeding.
abilities.detail: Induce bleeding in your target. This ability will work on Denizens as well as adventurers.

abilities.description: Make your victim forget what he meant to do.
abilities.detail: Make your victim forget what he meant to do.

abilities.description: Fear of open spaces.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with a fear of open spaces.

abilities.description: Inflict multiple ailments simultaneously.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may crush an opponent with two simultaneous evileyes. This ability also becomes faster the greater your skill in evileye.
abilities.required: Mana cost is the combined cost of each evileye.

abilities.description: Cut through an opponent's curseward.
abilities.detail: Rip down your opponents cursewards.

abilities.description: Causes problems when trying to move.
abilities.detail: Afflict your target with severe dizziness.

abilities.description: Fear of being under cover.
abilities.detail: Afflict your target with a great fear of enclosed spaces.

abilities.description: They are out to get you, believe me.
abilities.detail: Instil a fear of other people in your victim.

abilities.description: Curse an opponent with blindness.
abilities.detail: Remove your poor victim's eyesight.

abilities.description: The love of your own pain.
abilities.detail: Make your victim love pain so much they will inflict it upon themselves.

abilities.description: Creates difficulty when breathing.
abilities.detail: Make it difficult for your victim to breath.

abilities.description: A dangerous disregard for personal well-being.
abilities.detail: Give your target a dangerous disregard for their personal well-being.

abilities.description: Disrupt the nervous system of your victim.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to go into seizures.

abilities.description: Befuddle the minds of your enemies.
abilities.detail: Befuddle the minds of your enemies.

abilities.description: Fill your enemy's mind with thoughts of peace.
abilities.detail: Fill your enemy's mind with thoughts of peace.

abilities.description: Distorts the victim's perceptions of the world.
abilities.detail: Distorts the victim's perceptions of the world.

abilities.description: Restoring your sight.
abilities.detail: By focusing your will on your sight, you are able to clear your eyes of blindness after a brief period of concentration.

abilities.description: Bring down disease upon them.
abilities.detail: This potent curse shall afflict your subject with paralysis. If they already have paralysis, this curse shall deliver manaleech; if they have both paralysis and manaleech it shall deliver slickness, and if they have all three it shall deal damage.

abilities.description: Curse someone with the voyria affliction.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with the deadly Voyria.

abilities.description: Creates a terrible addiction.
abilities.detail: Cause your target to become addicted.

abilities.description: Rob the courage from a victim.
abilities.detail: This ability, which works on both adventurers and denizens, will cause the target to move in a random direction.

abilities.description: Make a victim dumb as a rock.
abilities.detail: Make a victim dumb as a rock.

abilities.description: A terrible curse of the mind.
abilities.detail: Sap away your targets mana.

abilities.description: Cause your victim to become extremely sensitive to pain.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to become extremely sensitive to pain.

abilities.description: Upset the stomach of your enemy.
abilities.detail: Induce severe vomiting in your hapless victim.

abilities.description: Put an enemy to sleep, or remove his sleep defences.
abilities.detail: Put an enemy to sleep, or remove their sleep defences.

abilities.description: A terrible condition, preventing one from eating.
abilities.detail: A terrible condition, preventing one from eating.

abilities.description: Weaken the body of your opponent.
abilities.detail: Weaken your opponent's body.

abilities.description: Cast the evil eye through magical shields.
abilities.detail: With the ability of truestare magical shields will no longer get in the way of your evil eyes. In addition, you may activate a defence which will allow you to enhance all of your ocular techniques to such a degree that you may utilise them while blind.

abilities.description: A sword against the wicked.
abilities.detail: Your righteous wrath is a thing to behold. Wielded as both sword and shield against the enemies of Creation, it fuels much of your abilities in Excision. These abilities can be performed independent of balance and equilibrium, though your wrath will be diminished by each used in such a way (and there is a recovery time before you may use another one)(*). * You will regenerate wrath over time.

abilities.description: You will stand unmoved.
abilities.detail: Though your fellows from the other schools of weaponmastery may block directions, none of them have quite the steadfast vigour you possess. By blocking a direction in a steadfast way, you will be much more formidable in this aspect(*). * Functionally, blocking a direction with the steadfast argument appended will cause you to serve as two people blocking said direction, instead of just one.

abilities.description: Let no evil go unchallenged.
abilities.detail: Rousing your wrath against an enemy of creation, you may denounce his wicked ways, shattering defences that may try to keep you from excising the corruption that stands before you(*). * Destroys rebounding if present. If your target is burning, it will also strip any prismatic barrier present. ** The wrath cost of this ability is reduced against an ablaze target.

abilities.description: The armour which does not rust or break.
abilities.detail: Your foes will come at you with sword and spell, but they will not avail them: for you are clad not only in plate and chain but beneath the aegis of your faith. * Grants damage resistance to cutting, blunt, and magic damage. Less so in the case of magic.

abilities.description: They cannot escape their sins.
abilities.detail: Show a heretic their sins, over and over again. * Gives the hallucinations affliction. ** This ability is faster against a prone target.

abilities.description: Your sword shall cleave the shadows.
abilities.detail: You may now strike with flame as well as steel; after preparing to do so, for the next 20 seconds or three strikes of your weapon(*) your weapon shall set your target ablaze (or increase their burning) when it strikes. * On skills that strike twice such as doubleslash or doublewhirl, this will only fire once per use.

abilities.description: Misdirection is no refuge.
abilities.detail: Your foes may cloak themselves in deception and secrecy, but your eyes will not be so easily deceived. Seek out an individual and know where they may be.

abilities.description: The Lightbringer guides your hand.
abilities.detail: The Lightbringer will guide your hand, bolstering your strength. * Grants +1 strength. ** At dawn, grants +3 instead.

abilities.description: You will give your life for the cause.
abilities.detail: By giving up your own health, you may heal another. When used for your bloodsworn's benefit, the amount given up is far reduced and the amount they are restored by is increased. When healing an adventurer, you will restore both health and mana, though the amount of mana restored is lesser.

abilities.description: For Creation, you stand.
abilities.detail: This defence will grant you a great surge of health when you enter a drastically wounded state, similar to a monk's vitality. Notably however, your faith is so strong that unlike a monk, this ability will even save you from blows that would otherwise slay you(*). * Excluding if the damage was unblockable. *** There is a cooldown after this fires before you may raise the defence again.

abilities.description: The Anathema will not go unchallenged.
abilities.detail: Pray to the Bloodsworn gods to strike down one of the Anathema(*), punishing the heretic for their transgressions. * This ability is used against members of the Unnamable class. ** It shall decrement their amount of chaotic manifestation, as well as dealing damage to them.

abilities.description: Of singular focus and relentless drive.
abilities.detail: Sometimes a particular enemy of Creation will require your singular focus to destroy. You may now focus your crusade upon him or her, and by doing so enable you to perform various higher abilities against their person. See relevant ability files for details.

abilities.description: The light shines on all.
abilities.detail: You may hunt the enemy of Creation that you have begun your crusade against, immediately transporting yourself to their location. * This ability is stopped by a monolith on the caster's end. It is also stopped by a monolith on the target's end, but not if they are ablaze. ** This ability only works if your target is in the same area, unless said target is ablaze: then it requires the same continent/plane. *** There is a cooldown before you may perform this ability again, though not if used against an ablaze target.

abilities.description: They shall not leave this holy place.
abilities.detail: You may declare a location to be hallowed ground, bringing forth a rite of piety. This rite will cause it to be difficult for any of your enemies to leave the location.

abilities.description: Cleansed in holy fire.
abilities.detail: Beckon forth the cleansing fire to scour away an enemy of Creation(*). * Gives the tenderskin affliction.

abilities.description: By Their mandate.
abilities.detail: Speak your holy decree, and an enemy of Creation shall struggle not to obey. * This will force a target to perform the action you specify.

abilities.description: They will be avenged.
abilities.detail: By swearing to avenge any of your comrades(*) that fall in battle, any time one of them is slain by an enemy of Creation(**), you will immediately recover balance. * Any member of Targossas or one of the Bloodsworn's orders. ** Anyone not from the above groups.

abilities.description: To ever greater heights.
abilities.detail: By entering a meditative trance, you may stoke your fervour to greater heights, rapidly restoring your holy wrath(*). * This is a channel.

abilities.description: Consign them to the flame.
abilities.detail: Begin consigning a heretic to the flame, purging Creation of their blight(*). * Gives the pyre affliction. This makes it impossible to cure ablaze below the level of the pyre (so if you have level 3 pyre, you cannot cure ablaze lower than level 3).

abilities.description: Her radiance finds all.
abilities.detail: Direct the light to shine upon an enemy of Creation; no doubt they shall be found wanting. * Gives the darkshade affliction.

abilities.description: Deliver one of the faithful to your side.
abilities.detail: This will allow you to summon an adventurer from any distance should they have been blessed with the PREACHING ability by a priest. It should be noted that a monolith sigil placed in the room of the summonee or summoner will prevent this from working. Be aware that delivering another adventurer out of combat may open you up for repercussion.

abilities.description: First to fight, last to fail.
abilities.detail: Lead the charge into battle from an adjacent location(*), shattering through any icewall that may bar your path(**), and shocking the enemy of Creation you engage at your coming(***). * This is a channeled action with a windup period, and people will follow you when you move. ** This will break icewalls, but not stonewalls, and no totems will strike you or your comrades on entering the new room. *** Your target will be disrupted if you are successful.

abilities.description: Corruption shall be burned away.
abilities.detail: You may burn away necromantic corruption, ridding a location of any hands of the grave that may have been called forth by a servant of evil. Priests are somewhat more adept at this particular holy working, so you will find that while still capable, you will complete this working somewhat slower under all conditions(*). * This ability takes significantly longer to perform if a necromancer is within the location, and it is an interruptable action.

abilities.description: The vanguard, always.
abilities.detail: Confront an enemy of Creation and strike them down. * Deals damage to a denizen or adventurer, bypassing but not stripping magical shields and similar. ** If your target is ablaze, they shall also suffer some mana loss (though less than their health). The amount of mana is increased the more they are burning. *** This does magical fire damage normally. If the target adventurer is ablaze, it does unblockable damage instead.

abilities.description: With the last breath, and after.
abilities.detail: Even after you fall in battle, you will fight on for the cause. With the final vestiges of your strength you may suffuse one of the yet living faithful with strength, restoring them greatly. However, your soul shall be immediately sent tumbling into the Finality's grasp when doing so. * Must be done very shortly after dying. ** You will forcefully embrace death when you perform this ability.

abilities.description: Victory is at hand.
abilities.detail: When driven by divine fervour, any time someone in your room burns via the ablaze affliction while also being afflicted with the pyre affliction, you will be passively healed of an affliction. Additionally, any time someone suffers from darkshade that you have afflicted them with, the damage they will suffer from shall be more significant.

abilities.description: You are the judge, and you find them wanting.
abilities.detail: Condemn an enemy of Creation to burn. * A condemned target may not cure ablaze below one stack, but a paladin may also no longer raise the burning level. ** Condemnation can take the place of the pyre requirement where the Fervour ability is concerned in regards to its healing aspect. The bonus to darkshade will not function under condemnation (see AB EXCISION FERVOUR). *** You may not hunt a heretic who is condemned (see AB EXCISION HUNT for details).

abilities.description: The fate that awaits their deeds.
abilities.detail: Make it known to a heretic the fate that awaits their malign misdeeds. The costs are significantly reduced if used on a target you are CRUSADING against. * Gives the hellsight affliction.

abilities.description: Bond with another via a blood oath.
abilities.detail: The bond of the bloodsworn is one of the most revered rituals of those that protect Creation. As the Lady Aurora and Lord Deucalion did, a priest and paladin (or two priests) bloodswear to each other, and from that moment on, they have the capability to bond their very souls to each other. When the BLOODSWORN ON ritual is performed by both parties, their maximum health and mana will be 65% of the -sum- of both their normal maximum health and maximum mana respectively. Further, some portion of the health or mana healed by either of the Devotionists, when using elixirs of health or mana, will also be healed on his or her bloodsworn. The hands ability shall also heal an additional amount when performed on your bloodsworn by a priest, and sustain in the case of a paladin. If your Bloodsworn falls in battle and is holding any holy rites, they will shift to you, so you may yet seek to triumph. The bloodsworn ability will automatically turn off if the Priest and Paladin are away from each other for greater than approximately 60 seconds. As with many phenomena that grant great power unto the user, the power of the bloodsworn comes at a price. While the bloodsworn pact is activated, with BLOODSWORN ON, the mana of both of the Devotionists will drain away. Further, and far more seriously, if either dies while the ability is active, the other will be critically damaged in body. Such is the price of power. If you wish to break your blood bond, you may do so by rejecting your bloodsworn, but be aware that you will not be able to become bloodsworn to another until the New Year.

abilities.description: The time to act is now.
abilities.detail: There is a time for condemnation, and there is a time for action. You may withdraw your condemnation of an enemy of Creation if you deem that they must know the true meaning of purification by flame.

abilities.description: Let Creation be healed.
abilities.detail: Consign the very soul of an enemy of Creation to die, burning their corruption from your charge(*). * Slays a target outright who has a broken head and either: Two of pyre, guilt, and spiritburn. or Level five burning.

abilities.description: Craft yourself a protective mask.
abilities.detail: Possibly the most important of all, this vital item of clothing, when secured, will filter the air that passes through to you and allow you to avoid many hazards when working with dangerous substances.

abilities.description: Combine minerals to create potent compounds.
abilities.detail: With the right mineral reagents, you are able to create various potent compounds to alter your own physiology and create various effects.

abilities.description: Soothe the body with a potent endorphin.
abilities.detail: This compound produces a gas which, when inhaled, will heal the body of some damage.

abilities.description: A potent nutritional supplement.
abilities.detail: This compound is a potent nutritional supplement. It is rumoured that many alchemists have found themselves able to sustain their bodies off of this almost indefinitely.

abilities.description: An acid to eat away at various defences.
abilities.detail: This potent acid reacts violently when it comes into contact with certain defences, chief among them magical shields.

abilities.description: Partial petrification comes with many advantages.
abilities.detail: This compound alters the physiology of the alchemist. By partially turning one's bones into a dense, iron-like substance, the user shall find themselves slowed but more able to resist physical damage. However, they should be wary of attacks that draw their power from lightning, as they will be particularly vulnerable to such. If the compound is highly volatile, its effects shall expire after five minutes.

abilities.description: Sear flesh from bone with this lethal compound.
abilities.detail: This deadly compound clings to the skin of those that it comes into contact with, burning until either all fuel is exhausted or the victim manages to scrub away the reactant.

abilities.description: Modify various properties of your compounds.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your training where you are able to more directly alter the compounds that you create. Your mastery is such that you will be able to alter the potency, stability, or volatility. Although the true alchemist shall find experimentation to be the best guide, as a general rule volatility shall cause a faster reaction, stability shall allow the compound to react for a longer period of time, and potency shall cause a more concentrated effect. You may also specify the potency, stability and/or volatility of a compound at the time you AMALGAMATE it.
abilities.syntax: ENHANCE POTENCY|STABILITY|VOLATILITY OF <compound> / DILUTE POTENCY|STABILITY|VOLATILITY OF <compound> / AMALGAMATE <compound> <type> <amount> <type> <amount>...

abilities.description: Determine specifics about your compounds.
abilities.detail: You are now able to determine specifics about how volatile, potent, or stable a compound is.

abilities.description: This compound will allow you to convert water into oxygen.
abilities.detail: This compound will alter your physiology, allowing you to convert foreign substances into oxygen. For the most part this can be used to allow one to breathe under water.

abilities.description: The air itself turns against your victims.
abilities.detail: This experimental compound is insidious indeed. Those that inhale it shall find that over time their maximum health reserves shall steadily decrease, and they will be unable to recover such until they have separated themselves from the substance for a time. The alchemist should be especially wary, as at this point all attempts to create a filter via their protective mask have failed.

abilities.description: Paralyse the lungs of the unprotected.
abilities.detail: This airborn substance will cause paralysis of the lungs if inhaled.

abilities.description: A compound that reacts violently with water.
abilities.detail: This powder reacts violently with water, able to boil away liquid or turn ice to steam.

abilities.description: A compound to create a blinding flash.
abilities.detail: When exposed to the open air, this compound will produce a blinding flash. The blindness induced is so damaging that not even the mindseye tattoo can allow one to see until they have recovered.

abilities.description: A gas to disorientate your subjects.
abilities.detail: This potent gas causes those who inhale it to become extremely disorientated. If flung from an adjacent room, any who breathe the gas in shall find themselves periodically falling to the ground. If flung at the ground, those that inhale it shall also suffer an immediate balance loss.

abilities.description: Death with a single breath.
abilities.detail: A single breath of the gas released by this compound is enough to produce the most deadly of reactions, striking down the unfortunate individual with the voyria plague.

abilities.description: A compound that reacts violently when exposed to the air.
abilities.detail: This compound will cause a violent explosion. While it lacks much damaging potential, it will cause a concussive wave, able to launch any who do not have themselves suitably secured from the location. When the alchemist is at the centre of the detonation, he or she is able to be more accurate, allowing for the explosion to occasionally bypass defences which would otherwise hold a subject in place.

abilities.description: The culmination of the Mayan experiment.
abilities.detail: This serum is possibly the most potent compound of those discovered by modernday alchemists. Able to drive the consumer's body far beyond mortal limits, rumour has it that it was an attempt to replicate the divine miracle performed by Maya which raised the adventurers of Sapience to partial divinity in the battle with the Worldreaver, but through the application of science. Although the experiment inevitably failed, the result was a serum which could speed up the alchemist's balance and equilibrium to an incredible degree. However, the price is high indeed. Any who consume this compound shall find their body will break down under the strain, resulting in certain death shortly after. For this reason it is dismissed as a failure in many circles, although as a last resort it is without compare.
abilities.required: 1 plumbum, 1 aurum, 1 potash, 1 ferrum, 1 argentum, 1 cuprum, 1 realgar

abilities.description: An experimental agent.
abilities.detail: This experimental compound has little practical use, as it only seems able to kill certain species of vines.

abilities.description: A formula to enhance your physiology.
abilities.detail: This formula is yet another attempt to achieve a superior state of being through the application of science. Although not as potent as some previous attempts, the changes tend to persist for a greater period of time, as well as providing far less danger to the user. The changes make the alchemist both more durable, as well as granting potential for greater control over their own internal processes. The only known drawbacks as of current research is that the subject tends to suffer from a state of heightened aggression, and the backlash when the changes revert can induce minor discomfort.

abilities.description: Force your body beyond its limits.
abilities.detail: This potent ability allows an alchemist who has imbibed the enhancement formula to drive their body into a state of advanced healing. Even the most terrible injuries can be healed, although the toll upon the alchemist's mental reserves is excessively high. It is also theorised that extended use of this ability will cause the backlash from the alchemists physiology reverting from an enhanced state to be exponentially more dangerous.

abilities.description: The pinnacle of Alchemical learning.
abilities.detail: The Philosopher's Stone is the pinnacle of Alchemical learning and mastery. The Stone is created in four steps, with each step providing increased power and insight to the Alchemist who creates it. The nigredo, or blackening comes first. Following this is the albedo, the whitening. Then the citrinitas, or yellowing. The final step is the rubedo, or reddening. Most Alchemists will only be able to ever complete the nigredo, and none have ever completed the final step of rubedo. What powers it ultimately holds is unknown, but many theories have been whispered in the vaunted halls of the Cauda Pavonis.

abilities.description: Choose a forest location as your grove.
abilities.detail: Once you have discovered a vacant forest or jungle location, this ability may be used to claim it as your own. Be warned: this bond is nearly permanent, and nobody but you may undo it.

abilities.description: Determine if a forest area has been claimed as a grove.
abilities.detail: Use this ability to discover if a forest location has been claimed as a grove or not.

abilities.description: Erase your imprint permanently from your grove.
abilities.detail: This ability will permanently sever the link with your grove. All sunlight energy in your grove will be lost.

abilities.description: Determine how much sunlight your grove has stored.
abilities.detail: By communing with your grove, you may discover how much sunlight energy remains.

abilities.description: Sense who is in the forest.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause the forest itself to report on the presence of other adventurers that are in it.

abilities.description: Discover information on the status of your grove.
abilities.detail: Use this ability to discover various pieces of information on the status of your grove.

abilities.description: See through the eyes of a forest into a distant location.
abilities.detail: Use this ability to view a wooded location that another adventurer is located in.

abilities.description: Send a tremor throughout your grove.
abilities.detail: Send a tremor through ground and trees alike in and near your grove. Nearby mounted adventurers will find themselves on the ground, while those in the trees may experience rapid loss of altitude combined with injury.

abilities.description: Ascend into the treetops.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may rise into the trees. Once there, you may travel normally, using DOWN to leave the trees.

abilities.description: Command your grove to report certain activity within it.
abilities.detail: This strange ability will allow you to share a mental kinship with others in your grove. It will cause you to receive much information that would normally be seen only by the individual adventurers in your grove. UNWATCH will stop you watching again.

abilities.description: Toss all but yourself out of your grove.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may cause the wilderness in your grove to throw out all in it, save for yourself and your allies.

abilities.description: Return instantly to your grove from anywhere in the forest.
abilities.detail: When activated, this ability will cause you to return to your grove from any wooded area.

abilities.description: Locate everyone in the forest.
abilities.detail: Grove eyes will, like GROVE WHO, tell you who is in the forest, with the added advantage of telling you where in the forest they are.

abilities.description: Know all entry and exit from the forest.
abilities.detail: This ability will inform everyone in your grove every time an adventurer enters or exits the forest.

abilities.description: Prevent night-time draining sunlight from your grove.
abilities.detail: For one Achaean month, this ability will seal off your grove from nighttime energy loss.

abilities.description: Lovingly caring for your grove.
abilities.detail: Though this is only useable once an Achaean year, it will add ten percent to the sunlight energy in your grove.

abilities.description: The ability to see who last harvested in a room.
abilities.detail: Whenever a plant is harvested, or, indeed, anything that is alive is changed, traces are left in the fabric of life-energy that sustains all living beings. The lastharvest ability allows you to tap into those energies for a short time to see who last harvested from each plant in your location.

abilities.description: Discover who exterminated a room last.
abilities.detail: Naturalism allows you to detect the foul stain of a Necromancer's soul on an exterminated room, letting you see who did it.

abilities.description: Raise a screen against telepathy within your grove.
abilities.detail: While this ability is active, your grove will be safe from those attempting to gain a telepathic lock on anyone within.

abilities.description: Secure yourself to the ground with tree roots.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will be secured to the ground and none of the various abilities that attempt to lift a target will succeed on you.

abilities.description: For one year, shield your grove from damage.
abilities.detail: For one Achaean year, this ability will render your grove immune to damage from certain abilities.

abilities.description: Remove ground-based runes from your grove.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may command your grove to remove a rune from itself.

abilities.description: Summon a powerful quarterstaff from your grove.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you will gain a quarterstaff from the heart of a tree in your grove. You may then SHARPEN QUARTERSTAFF to sharpen it. Once sharpened, you may STAB <target>. You may also SPIN QUARTERSTAFF to conjure an aura of protection against physical and magical damage. TAP QUARTERSTAFF will turn your quarterstaff into a source of light. WHIRL QUARTERSTAFF will reveal many hidden or cloaked people that may be in your location. It is rumoured that there are other abilities that may be performed with your quarterstaff, including one to create a slightly more powerful aura of protection.
abilities.syntax: GROVE QUARTERSTAFF / SHARPEN QUARTERSTAFF / SPIN QUARTERSTAFF / TAP QUARTERSTAFF / WHIRL QUARTERSTAFF / SWING QUARTERSTAFF [target]

abilities.description: Call your loyal creatures back to your grove.
abilities.detail: This ability will call all creatures loyal to you back to your grove.

abilities.description: Constantly track the movement of anyone in the forest.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may track an adventurer's movement through the forest. GROVE TRACK OFF will cease this tracking.

abilities.description: Open a portal to your grove for anyone in the forest.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you can create a portal to any adventurer in the same area, who may then come to you through the portal. The portal is one-way: it may not be used to go to the adventurer.

abilities.description: After a time, bring anyone in the forest to your grove.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may begin the process of summoning any adventurer in a forest to your grove. It will take a small amount of time, during which the adventurer may escape the summoning by moving. Also any actions on your part during the summoning process will halt the summons.

abilities.description: Slip instantly from your grove to anyone in the forest.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may instantly travel from your grove to anyone in forest or jungle.

abilities.description: Infuse your quarterstaff with the power of sunlight.
abilities.detail: Imbue your quarterstaff with the light of the sun. You must be standing in a sunlit place to EVOKE SUNLIGHT. Be aware that empowering a quarterstaff in this way may cause some personal damage. The capacity of your quarterstaff to store light will grow with your skill in Groves. EVOKE STATUS will inform you of its current charge and capacity. When in your grove, you may GROVE IMBUE to charge your quarterstaff rapidly, be it day or night, at a severe drain to your grove.
abilities.syntax: GROVE IMBUE / EVOKE SUNLIGHT / EVOKE STATUS

abilities.description: Reform a sharpened quarterstaff.
abilities.detail: Through the power of imbued sunlight, you may return a sharpened quarterstaff to its full length.

abilities.description: Cure someone of an affliction.
abilities.detail: Cure will allow you to cure yourself or an adventurer of a random affliction.

abilities.description: Transport yourself to the Glade of Isolation.
abilities.detail: This powerful ability will take you, and anyone following you to a secret grove with exits to many places in the land. Be warned though, that it is quite expensive in sunlight energy.

abilities.description: Transfer energy to the grove of another.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to transfer sunlight energy from one grove to another. Both you and the target adventurer must be standing in your respective groves. This can be a useful ability though it should be noted some energy is lost maintaining the channel.

abilities.description: Call on the invigorating warmth of sunlight.
abilities.detail: By showering yourself or another with sunlight, you may encourage regeneration of health for a brief period. The benefit experienced by another will not be as significant as that felt when this ability is used on one's self.

abilities.description: Heal another of maladies and ailments.
abilities.detail: This technique can heal another adventurer of a single affliction at a time. It may not be used on one's self. Not all afflictions may be remedied.

abilities.description: Conjuring a magical shower of rejuvenating rain.
abilities.detail: By calling a refreshing rain into your grove, you will cause everyone in the grove to experience relatively rapid refreshing of endurance and willpower.

abilities.description: Perform the rites of fertility.
abilities.detail: The rites of fertility will temporarily bolster plant growth wherever they are performed.

abilities.description: Hide all those within your grove from prying eyes.
abilities.detail: Use this ability to conceal your grove from the prying eyes of all but the Gods Themselves.

abilities.description: Granting the use of your grove to your allies.
abilities.detail: Grove sharing will allow any grove user on your allies list to use your grove as if it were his own. GROVE WITHDRAW will disable grove sharing.

abilities.description: Illuminate the surroundings with a revealing flash of light.
abilities.detail: By channeling your sunlight reserves, Flash has the chance to reveal the presence of all hidden adventurers in the room, save for the Divinities.

abilities.description: Open a gateway of light.
abilities.detail: Grove gate will allow you to open a two-way portal between you and any adventurer, anywhere on the same continent as yourself. It is also possible to evoke a portal from an imbued quarterstaff, though the range of this gateway will be limited to the local area.
abilities.required: GROVE: 150 sunlight EVOKE: 150 imbued sunlight and 250 mana

abilities.description: Lash your prey with Nature's fury.
abilities.detail: Tap into Nature's fury and command your grove to lash at a denizen, dealing significant cutting damage to them. The potency of this invocation is determined by the Druid or Sylvan casting it(*). * The damage dealt by this ability will scale with the higher of your strength or intelligence stat.

abilities.description: Seek Nature's blessing through absolute harmony
abilities.detail: When standing in one of several natural environments, a Druid may attempt to harmonise him or herself to that environment with EVOKE HARMONY. Once three Druids are in harmony with the same environment, all Druids* will be able to bestow a blessing associated with that harmonisation on him/herself or another adventurer**, using EVOKE HARMONY <ME|target>. Only one environment may be fully harmonised at a time, and this harmonisation will last until the end of the year. EVOKE HARMONY STATUS will show the current state of harmony of the various environments. The effects of each environment are: Forest: Increased health regeneration. Ocean: Increased mana regeneration. Mountains: Increased willpower and endurance regeneration. Desert: Increased damage versus denizens. Tundra: Increased effectiveness of frost and venom elixirs. * This ability is available to Druids of Eleusis and cityless Druids who are also members of the Heartwood Kin and the Scions of the Ithmia. ** Harmony blessings may be granted to members of Eleusis and cityless members of the Heartwood Kin and the Scions of the Ithmia.

abilities.cooldown: GROVE HIVE: 6.00 seconds of equilibrium TAP HIVE: 4.8 seconds of balance CALL BEES: 4.00 seconds of equilibrium CALL NEW SWARM: 5.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Create a hive of stinging bees to defend your grove.
abilities.detail: Hive will create a hive of bees in your grove that will live there and protect it. TAP HIVE will call forth the bees, who will proceed to attack your enemies in your grove. Bees are also capable of following you around Sapience (see HELP DENIZENS for more commands). An added benefit to this magical hive is that you may HARVEST HIVE. Doing this will not only feed you and heal your mind and body fully, but it will also attempt to increase a random skill of yours slightly. If the random skill happens to be Transcendent already, then no benefit will be gained. This ability may only be used infrequently.
abilities.required: GROVE HIVE: 120 sunlight CALL NEW SWARM: 500 mana
abilities.syntax: GROVE HIVE / HARVEST HIVE / TAP HIVE / CALL BEES / CALL NEW SWARM

abilities.description: Return a totem to the embrace of Nature.
abilities.detail: This ability must be performed in a location where a totem is implanted. By ensconcing the totem with an overgrowth of dense greenery, you may conceal its runes from view, rendering it powerless. A well-placed lash of fire may destroy the obscuring plantlife, returning the totem to full function.

abilities.description: Restore an exterminated room to its natural state.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to rejuvenate land that has been exterminated by a foul Necromancer. It requires the presence of a cube of elemental ice in your inventory.

abilities.description: Spread the white cloak of winter across the land.
abilities.detail: This technique will conjure up a blizzard to temporarily blanket the area, every bit as fierce and cold as a naturally occurring snowstorm. The effects of the heat vibration may interfere with this evocation.

abilities.description: Ensnare your enemies with tenacious plantlife.
abilities.detail: On using this technique, wild growth will sprout from the earth wherever you go for a short period of time. Any personal enemies attempting to leave your location by most conventional means risk being hindered by this plantlife.

abilities.description: Form an impenetrable barrier of light itself.
abilities.detail: By forming a wall of solid light around yourself, or another adventurer, you may create a powerful defensive barrier able to withstand most attacks. While largely impenetrable, the barrier will dissolve should whomever it protects perform an action (with some exceptions).

abilities.description: Prevent all entry and exit from the forest.
abilities.detail: This powerful ability will prevent entry to and egress from the forest that is bound for all those not in an organisation aligned with Nature. Only one forest may be bound at a given time. The grove energy cost is doubled after the first use, if used again within 24 Achaean days.

abilities.description: Restore yourself or a friend to life.
abilities.detail: This very costly ability will grant life to the corpse of any adventurer you specify, provided the corpse is in your grove. The second form is used for yourself. The forest will resist attempts to resurrect its enemies. If you wish to proceed with the resurrection, you will be required to FORCE the attempt at a much higher personal cost. Note that forcing your grove to resurrect an individual will ALWAYS have a higher cost. Those grove users who are truly devoted to Nature are also able to resurrect the souls of others, so long as they too are adherents to Nature's worship and protection. Those who are citizens of Eleusis, or members of the Scions of the Ithmia and Heartwood Kin Houses fall into this category.

abilities.description: Summon an earth golem to guard your grove.
abilities.detail: So strong is your bond with your grove that you are able to reach down into the roots of the earth and call forth one of the fabled earth golem Guardians to stand guard over your grove. It will protect your grove, attacking anyone on your enemies list who comes in, and will stay until dead. Note, however, that there is a very high grove energy cost.

abilities.description: Put an end to aural interferences.
abilities.detail: With a swirling rush of leaves, you may dampen the complex tonal structures that bind vibrations and harmonics together, immediately putting one to an end.

abilities.description: Strike your foes with nature's fury.
abilities.detail: Harnessing the wrath of the sky, you may direct a powerful bolt of lightning to strike a foe. Your target must be a sufficient distance away from you, and within your line of sight. Lightning is a mercurial force, and may occasionally leave your target plagued with ailments, or fizzle out harmlessly.

abilities.description: Bring forth life from blight.
abilities.detail: The Blighted Isle upon which the city of Mhaldor stands is an affront to Nature and her ilk. While standing upon the tainted land you may perform this act of cleansing, calling forth growth to drive back the corruption. The servants of Evil shall find that their mastery of necromantic essence grows weaker, the more of their domain becomes cleansed. Take note: prolonged use of vivification will take a heavy toll on your sunlight reserves. You will find each subsequent cleansing incurs a higher cost than the last.

abilities.description: Nature's touch can heal all ills.
abilities.detail: Through your quarterstaff, you may focus the restorative powers of Nature on yourself. For a time, you will be healed of afflictions at regular intervals.

abilities.description: The ultimate expression of the bond with your grove.
abilities.detail: This, the most powerful of all grove abilities, allows you to temporarily move your grove to any forest or jungle location where there is not already a grove or temporary grove. Planting a quarterstaff in such a location will move your grove there, though only temporarily. With time, your grove will return to its home. If you wish to prematurely move your grove back to its original location, simply GROVE UNIFY. It should be noted that a few abilities will not work in a temporary grove. Channel     Sever     Guardian     Sharing     Hive     Forestbinding

abilities.description: Summon the swarm to defend a natural location.
abilities.detail: Formicaries are used to spread the influence of the swarm throughout Eleusis and beyond. Each formicary holds a small portion of the swarm, empowered by the raw energy of Nature itself, to defend the land from the enemies of Nature. All formicary skills will consume a portion of the swarm, and all formicaries will consume a small portion of the swarm each month. CREATE - At a cost of 20 fibre, 10 wood, and 2 bone commodities, create a new formicary to house the swarm. RECLAIM - Destroy a formicary. EMPOWER - Call upon the raw power of Nature to empower a formicary. TUNE - Tune a formicary to react against the enemies of either Eleusis or Forest enemies. INFECT - Infect the swarm housed in a formicary with either murrain or fetter. Murrain will cause the swarm to infect enemies with painful afflictions. Fetter will cause the swarm to hinder enemy movement.
abilities.syntax: EVOKE FORMICARY RECLAIM / EVOKE FORMICARY EMPOWER / EVOKE FORMICARY TUNE ELEUSIS | FOREST / EVOKE FORMICARY INFECT MURRAIN | FETTER

abilities.description: Sense the size of the swarm.
abilities.detail: Using this skill will allow you to sense the number of insects that have infested the foetid pool in Eleusis.

abilities.description: Their minds are yours.
abilities.detail: This ability is the basis for all hypnotic manipulation. First you must hypnotise a victim, to seize control of his or her mind. This can take several seconds. Once a trance is secured, you may begin implanting hypnotic suggestions, and finally seal the victim's trance. Once this is complete, you may snap your victim to trigger their trance, and the hypnotic suggestions shall begin to fire in rapid succession.
abilities.syntax: HYPNOTISE <target> / SUGGEST <target> <suggestion> / SEAL <target> <delay in seconds> / SNAP <target>

abilities.description: Poised to strike.
abilities.detail: The act of sealing a hypnotic trance primes it for use. You may seal your trance at any time for three seconds and upwards, and suggestions tick periodically every four seconds there after. However, if you seal your trance while your victim suffers from a deadened mind, the trance will sink more deeply into their psyche, tying itself more intrinsically and becoming vastly more potent when triggered(*). * The delay can be set as low as one second, and the suggestions trigger every three seconds there after.

abilities.description: Discover the implanted suggestions in someone.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may analyse a person's state of mind (including your own), to determine any hypnotic suggestions that may be implanted.

abilities.description: Some pressure here, some manipulation there.
abilities.detail: It is one thing to sink your mark into a hypnotic trance and set their mind into a downward spiral, but quite another to simply lay them low with a glance. Nevertheless, you are now equal to both tasks. By triggering impulses in the mind of your victim, you may inflict them with one of the trivial suggestions(*) that are known to you. * See ab hypnosis for the list of trivial suggestions.

abilities.description: Clean yourself or another of suggestions.
abilities.detail: This ability allows you to cleanse hypnotic suggestions from an individual. You may also cleanse yourself, but in this instance you can only remove suggestions that would force you to carry out a physical action.

abilities.description: Much subtler, near-undetectable hypnosis.
abilities.detail: By mesmerising a victim, you will be able to greatly increase the chance of them overlooking your attempts to remove their hard earned possessions via pickpocketing.

abilities.description: Store the mental state of your subject.
abilities.detail: This greatest of the hypnotic arts allows you to store the mental state of a subject, greatly increasing the speed of future hypnosis attempts against that person. Note that you may only hold up to five imprints at any one time.
abilities.syntax: HYPNOTIC IMPRINT <target> / HYPNOTIC IMPRINT FORGET <person> / HYPNOTIC IMPRINT FORGET ALL / HYPNOTIC IMPRINT LIST

abilities.description: Causes the victim to forget to do his next action.
abilities.detail: Causes the victim to forget to do his next action.

abilities.description: They are out to get you, believe me.
abilities.detail: They are out to get you, believe me.

abilities.description: Fear of being left on your own.
abilities.detail: Fear of being left on your own.

abilities.description: Fear of enclosed spaces.
abilities.detail: Fear of enclosed spaces.

abilities.description: Anxious difficulty with speech.
abilities.detail: Anxious difficulty with speech.

abilities.description: Vivid hallucinations to plague your foe.
abilities.detail: Vivid hallucinations to plague your foe.

abilities.description: Hugely distorts victim's perception of the world.
abilities.detail: Hugely distorts victim's perception of the world.

abilities.description: Weakening of the mind.
abilities.detail: Weakening of the mind.

abilities.description: Throw your victim's nervous system into disarray.
abilities.detail: Throw your victim's nervous system into disarray.

abilities.description: Fear of open spaces.
abilities.detail: Fear of open spaces.

abilities.description: The love of your own pain.
abilities.detail: The love of your own pain.

abilities.description: Ignorance of health and disregard for well-being.
abilities.detail: Ignorance of health and disregard for well-being.

abilities.description: Fear of heights.
abilities.detail: Fear of heights.

abilities.description: Causes the mind to become confounded.
abilities.detail: Causes the mind to become confounded.

abilities.description: Abject, stumbling idiocy.
abilities.detail: Abject, stumbling idiocy.

abilities.description: Inability to use weaponry effectively.
abilities.detail: Inability to use weaponry effectively.

abilities.description: A terrible addiction.
abilities.detail: A terrible addiction.

abilities.description: Loss of desire to cause anyone harm.
abilities.detail: Loss of desire to cause anyone harm.

abilities.description: A condition that prevents insomnia.
abilities.detail: A condition that prevents insomnia.

abilities.description: A distinct lack of energy.
abilities.detail: A distinct lack of energy.

abilities.description: Loss of desire to eat.
abilities.detail: Loss of desire to eat.

abilities.description: Destroy your opponent's mental equilibrium.
abilities.detail: This potent suggestion will knock the target off equilibrium briefly, or fully disrupt them if confusion is also present at the time it triggers.

abilities.description: Indiscriminate, overwhelming generosity.
abilities.detail: Indiscriminate, overwhelming generosity.

abilities.description: The ability to suggest an action of your choice.
abilities.detail: This potent suggestion will allow you to directly implant a command into the mind of your victim, which they will have no choice but to perform once their trance is activated.

abilities.description: The conviction that one is constantly afflicted.
abilities.detail: The conviction that one is constantly afflicted.

abilities.description: Increase your ability to weather damage.
abilities.detail: Your budding control over your body will assist you in weathering the storm of life by increasing your constitution by one point.

abilities.description: Call upon a rush of adrenaline to heal you.
abilities.detail: You may only activate this ability when very near full health and mana. Once active, when you drop to less than twenty-five percent of your maximum health without dying, you will get a sudden rush of adrenaline that will heal you significantly.

abilities.description: Standing firm against attempts to move you.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: Increased resistance to physical attacks.
abilities.detail: By increasing the density of your skin, you are able to decrease the amount of damage you will take from physical cutting attacks.

abilities.description: Blocking out sound by force of will.
abilities.detail: This simply allows you to enter a short trance and deafen yourself.

abilities.description: Restoring your hearing.
abilities.detail: Instantly restores your hearing.

abilities.description: Reduce the level of your bleeding.
abilities.detail: This will permit you to partially clot your bleeding.

abilities.description: Regain health through strength of mind.
abilities.detail: At an ongoing mental drain, you are able to channel your mental energy into healing yourself.

abilities.description: Restoring your sight.
abilities.detail: You have sufficient control over your body to instantly repair your eyes when blinded.

abilities.description: Blinding yourself to prevent optical damage.
abilities.detail: A few seconds after using this ability, you will blind yourself.

abilities.description: Reduce the damage taken from magical attacks.
abilities.detail: Due to your increased bodily control, you are able to reduce the damage from magical attacks.

abilities.description: Gain the ability of infravision.
abilities.detail: You will gain the ability to see in normal darkness.

abilities.description: Controlling your breathing.
abilities.detail: With your mastery of your own body, you are able to purge yourself of the asthma affliction.

abilities.description: Healing damaged limbs by force of will.
abilities.detail: By channeling mental power into healing, you can heal any broken limbs you may have at one time. Listed are the base costs, these increase with 1/2/3/4 limbs broken.

abilities.description: Avoiding many projectiles.
abilities.detail: At the cost of some mana, you are able to heighten your reflexes and dodge many projectiles.

abilities.description: Avoiding attacks from the sky.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to dodge attacks from the air.

abilities.description: Maintaining your intestinal equilibrium.
abilities.detail: This ability will gain you a stomach of steel.

abilities.description: Constant meditation by splitting your consciousness.
abilities.detail: By splitting your consciousness into dual parts, you will lose part of your maximum mana level, but will effectively meditate constantly in your second mind, gaining you mana constantly and speeding up meditation.

abilities.description: Holding your breath.
abilities.detail: This ability will grant a short-term immunity from anything doing asphyxiation damage. However, any offensive activity or consumption of balance or equilibrium will cause you to begin breathing once again.

abilities.description: The ability to stay conscious at all times.
abilities.detail: Your power of concentration is such that you will be able to maintain a grasp on consciousness where you might normally lose it.

abilities.description: Immunity from most poisons.
abilities.detail: Your power of concentration is such that you will be able to maintain a grasp on consciousness where you might normally lose it.

abilities.description: Increasing your rate of regeneration.
abilities.detail: This ability, when used in conjunction with Regeneration, alters the rate of regeneration to a more favourable mana-to-health ratio.

abilities.description: Instantly convert mana into health.
abilities.detail: This will instantly turn the specified amount of mana into health, minus a bit that is lost in the transfer.

abilities.description: Delaying the effects of damage.
abilities.detail: With a very clever method of concentration, you are now able to numb yourself to damage received, at least temporarily. When the numbness wears off, all the damage you would have taken, minus 40%, will be received in one blow.
