abilities.description: Entering the mystical Kai Trance.
abilities.detail: This is the basis for the most powerful Kaido abilities. It is the ability which allows you to gather Kai energy to use in later abilities. Everytime a person on your enemies list does something offensive in your location, you will gain Kai energy from it. How much you gain depends on how much energy the ability generates. While you are in a Kai Trance, you will lose Kai energy relatively quickly, as well as losing some mental energy. When you BREAK TRANCE, you will lose all your accumulated Kai Energy.

abilities.description: Crush a victim's windpipe remotely.
abilities.detail: By manipulating the Kai energy that flows around us all, you are able to choke the life out of any adventurer in your line of sight, dealing increased damage to those suffering under certain afflictions(*). If instead you turn your focus onto a denizen, this skill becomes much simpler to perform but can only be used on those foes in the same location as you(**). * This deals increased damage to targets that have one of: a damaged/mangled head, a damaged/mangled torso, or are mind clamped. ** This skill requires and consumes no kai energy when used against a denizen but requires the target to be in the same location as the monk in these cases.

abilities.description: Cripple your target completely.
abilities.detail: By sending out a crushing whip of Kai, you can crush the limbs of your target.

abilities.description: Healing yourself with Kai energy.
abilities.detail: Although this may only be performed at yourself, it is a very powerful healing ability.

abilities.description: A blast of focussed power.
abilities.detail: By directing a surge of pure kai energy into an enemy, you may set their muscles to violently spasming. This will prevent them from being able to remount, as well as slightly disrupting tumble attempts(*). This ability also prones and causes some damage. The effect will fade over time. * Each damaged limb currently extends the length of a tumble attempt; the kai surge status will increase this penalty. Tumble with no damaged limbs is unaltered.

abilities.description: When the external will not supply.
abilities.detail: Sometimes there will be no simple way to take in kai energy the conventional way. Though the highest workings of kaido may be out of your reach in these situations, by sending a burst of uncontrolled kai energy outward you may somewhat mitigate this limitation(*). This is taxing however, and may only be done every so often, as well as stripping any active kai boost defence you may have established(**). * This fills your kai to a little under half. ** Once every 90 seconds, and you cannot reraise your boost defence until this time has expired. *** Note if you're above a certain kai threshold you can't use this ability (i.e. when it would be pointless to do so).

abilities.description: Increase your receptiveness to Kai energy.
abilities.detail: As you become more efficient in the art of handling Kai, you gain the ability to double the amount of Kai energy you get.

abilities.description: Unleash a massive blast of kai energy at your opponent.
abilities.detail: This ability will throw a massive shockwave of kai energy at your opponent, cutting his current health and mana in half. If your opponent does not lie prone before you, this will be reduced to a 25% reduction in health and mana.

abilities.description: Grant your enemies release from this mortal coil.
abilities.detail: Once activating this ability, there will be a short delay. After this time, anyone who attempts to harm you for the next thirty seconds from close by will die instantly in a massive backlash of Kai energy.

abilities.description: A vicious agent of the Inferno.
abilities.detail: The vicious demonic Hyenas of the Inferno are bound to one of Lord Sartan's infernal warriors. These vicious predators know not the frailties of mercy or kindness, and only their dark masters may ever be safe from the rending of their jaws Your hyena comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. If you cause your hyena to die, you will be refused another hyena. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your hyena. Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your hyena. HYENA ASSESS : See information about your hyena. HYENA RECALL : Recall your hyena to your shoulder. HYENA SANCTUARY : Order your hyena to a sanctuary where it will be safe. HYENA TRAIN : Order your hyena to go train, in order to raise a stat. HYENA REPORT : Gain information on where your hyena is. HYENA SLAY : Order your hyena to slay someone. HYENA HUNT : When your hyena is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. HYENA FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your hyena will flee battle. HYENA SLEEP : Order your hyena to sleep. HYENA FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your hyena. As your hyena gains in Stamina: its health will increase. Speed: it will attack more quickly as well as fly from place to place more quickly. Strength: it will attack with more power as well as be able to carry larger items. You must visit the summoning chamber within the Mhaldor cathedral to request your hyena.

abilities.description: Increase your ability to weather damage.
abilities.detail: Your budding control over your body will assist you in weathering the storm of life by increasing your constitution by one point.

abilities.description: Order your hyena to seek its prey.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may order your hyena to seek out another adventurer. Your hyena must be by your side for you to use this ability.

abilities.description: See as the beast sees.
abilities.detail: If your hyena is not inside someone's inventory, or inside something, this will let you see the location it is in.

abilities.description: Obstructing departure with your body.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to block a particular direction, preventing normal movement in that direction.

abilities.description: Controlling your breathing.
abilities.detail: With your mastery of your own body, you are able to purge yourself of the asthma affliction.

abilities.description: To find the prey.
abilities.detail: Your hyena has learned to fear you enough that you may order it to follow a particular adventurer. When the hyena loses the adventurer, generally because the adventurer goes indoors, it will stop following.

abilities.description: Grip your wielded items in a deathlock.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Barging your opponents.
abilities.detail: This ability will barge an adventurer to the direction you choose. To start the ability, you must be in a room adjacent to the room where the target adventurer resides, and you must choose to barge him in a direction that wouldn't take him into the room you are in. So, for instance, say that Isildur is in a room to the north of me, and that this room has another exit to the ne. I would do BARGE ISILDUR NE.

abilities.description: Stun a target with the power of your voice.
abilities.detail: Your battle cry is so powerful that when directed against another, it will blast him to the ground and stun him, provided he isn't deaf.

abilities.description: Use of the valued projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: Use one of the various bows to shoot an adventurer in a line-of-sight location from you.

abilities.description: Take full advantage of your quiver.
abilities.detail: Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver. When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver. Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver. To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.
abilities.syntax: ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom> / INSPECT QUIVER / DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour> / SWITCH <colour>

abilities.description: Further increase your accuracy through wind compensation.
abilities.detail: Once you have this ability, your accuracy with bowmanship will be increased.

abilities.description: Increase your accuracy in shooting.
abilities.detail: Increase the accuracy of your shooting.

abilities.description: Standing firm against attempts to move you.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: Reduce the damage taken from magical attacks.
abilities.detail: Due to your increased bodily control, you are able to reduce the damage from magical attacks.

abilities.description: A powerful projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: The crossbow is more powerful, but less accurate, than the longbow.

abilities.description: Reduce the level of your bleeding.
abilities.detail: This will permit you to partially clot your bleeding.

abilities.description: Throw off pacifying afflictions.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to cure certain pacifying afflictions, notably those that are normally cured by eating bellwort.

abilities.description: Take it for the Lord.
abilities.detail: Using this ability will cause your hyena to try and pick up an object in the room that it is in and deliver it back to you.

abilities.description: The beasts of burden need a brutal hand.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow your hyena to startle an opponent's steed, tossing the wretch off.

abilities.description: Evil gives no quarter.
abilities.detail: This ability is an improved version of follow ability. With track, even if the hyena temporarily loses its target, because the target went indoors, the hyena will continue to follow the target once the target comes back outside.

abilities.description: Attempt to protect someone else with swordwork.
abilities.detail: Upon using this ability, you will attempt to take much of the damage from the blows that might otherwise harm the adventurer you are defending.

abilities.description: Sniff out the heathens.
abilities.detail: Your hyena can sniff out all in the local area, informing you of their location and current health.

abilities.description: Using the infamous darkbows of Hashan.
abilities.detail: The famed darkbows of Hashan are both expensive and powerful. Only slightly less powerful than a crossbow, they are far more accurate.

abilities.description: Take of the Lord into your beast.
abilities.detail: Feed the corpse of a Baalzadeen to your bast, and she will know the Lord's touch(*). *This makes your hyena much more offensively capable.

abilities.description: Damage a cowardly opponent.
abilities.detail: There is nothing more despicable and dishonourable than a coward, and this ability will allow you to punish cowards, as is their due. Once you have engaged an adventurer, if he is otherwise unhindered and tries to leave the room, you will get in an extra strike, whether you have equilibrium and balance or not.

abilities.description: An exercise in logistics.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may order your hyena to deliver a small item or group of items from your inventory into the inventory of another adventurer.

abilities.description: Mount or vault your steeds at increased speed.
abilities.detail: You have reached such a level of training in the arts of Chivalry that you regain balance while Mounting a steed much more rapidly. Furthermore, if you have the ability Vault in Riding, you can use it without any loss of balance at all.

abilities.description: Temporarily raise your strength.
abilities.detail: This will allow you to temporarily raise your strength with 2 points, for no more than a total of 1/4th of each Achaean day. It can be used once a day without cost, but if you turn it off and turn it back on within the same Achaean day, you will incur a cost of 500 willpower each time you turn it back on. Your endurance losses will be significantly higher while Fury is active.

abilities.description: From which your will shall spring.
abilities.detail: The ritual blade of the practitioner of Memorium is key to almost all higher works of the art. Walk forth to the endless sands(*) and forge your focus for the trials to come. * Any desert room, under the light of the sun.

abilities.description: A crude but necessary step.
abilities.detail: Collecting the blood of your foe is the first step to overcoming them. Your ritual blade can retain the blood of one you let for later workings; you may also let your own blood, either for emergencies or specialised rituals. Probing your ritual blade shall show whose blood it currently retains, if any.

abilities.description: A basic application of the craft.
abilities.detail: A basic application of your arcane craft: wrack the blood in the veins of your foe, and they will suffer(*). The suffering is increased for each of the plagues of pestilence ravaging your target. * Does damage. ** Sanguinehand will activate off this ability.

abilities.description: Strike when they are vulnerable.
abilities.detail: The process of chaining together logographs comes with many benefits, but there is always a residual amount of arcane energy wasted when performing this process. You are now at a point in your studies when you can turn this to your advantage. When chaining together logographs, you can direct said excess energy through the blood upon your ritual blade. Whomever said blood belongs to will find themselves weakened for a short time and vulnerable to your sorcery(*). The blood does not necessarily need to be that of the person you are tracing against. * Exposing someone to your sorcery means you can perform abilities that fall under higher sorcery against them at no equilibrium cost. Performing an ability in this way will remove said exposure.

abilities.description: The arcane guides your hand.
abilities.detail: You have become sufficiently in tune with the arcane flows that now, when your sorcery causes blood to diverge from its standard pathways, you may stand ready to collect such if your ritual blade is clean(*). * If your ritual knife possesses no blood, certain abilities will result in you immediately catching the blood of someone you utilise those abilities against. These will be noted in their relevant ability files.

abilities.description: Blood calls to blood.
abilities.detail: Once you have gathered blood upon your ritual blade, the unfortunate donator shall find that its medium can conduct rather a great deal back to the host. If you possess a vial of most venoms(*), you may transpose it through said medium, delivering it to your victim no matter where they may be. Unfortunately, this does ruin the blood for future purposes, and you will need to collect it once again. * Certain venoms cannot be transposed: typically if it can't be envenomed, it cannot be transposed. ** Transpose clears any epitaph you have currently formed.

abilities.description: A little goes a long way.
abilities.detail: With blood such an important medium, it is always worth having some on hand. The practiced Pariah will store the blood of their most dangerous foes on their person for rapid use; the truly great will also keep an extra reserve within the depths of their crypt. JAR FILL: wipe the blood from your ritual blade into a jar. CRUX BLOODY <person>: immediately bloody your ritual blade with the blood from a jar on your person. JARS CARRIED: see what jars you are carrying, and how many applications you will be able to derive from their sanguine contents. JARS STORED: in your reliquary, see what jars you have stored. JAR STORE <jar ID|person name>: store a jar in your reliquary. JAR RETRIEVE <jar ID|person name>: retrieve a jar from your reliquary. JAR CLEANSE <person name|jar ID>: cleanse a jar you are holding of blood. You may carry five jars on your person at a given time, and your reliquary may hold up to ten in addition.
abilities.syntax: JAR STORE <jar|person> / JAR RETRIEVE <jar|PERSON> / JARS CARRIED / JARS STORED / JAR FILL / CRUX BLOODY <person> / JAR CLEANSE <person name|jar ID>

abilities.description: Their pulse shall sound their end.
abilities.detail: When tracing your logographs, you can now alter them in very minor ways, causing their effects to manifest later rather than immediately. This time is measured in the beats of your enemy's heart. For this reason, the accelerate ability shall also reduce the delay time when used in combination with this. The delay must be between 1 and 5 heartbeats.

abilities.description: Bound in blood and fate besides.
abilities.detail: Higher mastery with your ritual blade will enable you to both bind and let in a single stroke. When you ensorcell your foe, they will find it difficult to flee from your arcane power(*), and you shall claim the life which sustains them in preparation for higher workings(**). * They have a chance to fail to leave on movement attempts. ** You will gain their blood upon your ritual blade, similar to let.

abilities.description: Blood settles all disputes.
abilities.detail: Your hands may be denied the weapons of war, but to walk your path is to make of denial a tomb and destiny both. Wielding your own blood, you may craft arrows to strike at your enemies, each imbued with a logograph that is known to you. * All logographs may be used except the fissure. ** This attacks damage, accuracy, and balance scales to any artefact bow in your inventory that has the shooting upgrade.

abilities.description: Ever closer to the end.
abilities.detail: Blood in the veins of your enemy is far more difficult to manipulate, though difficult does not mean impossible. Some minor applications of sorcery are available to you even then, and acceleration is one such working. By making the heart of your foe beat ever faster, you will cause your logographs that are tied to said beating to manifest more swiftly(*), and in addition cause some particularly deadly diseases of the blood to manifest more rapidly(**). * Logographs delayed with the heartbeat ability will have their timers reduced when using this ability. ** If your target suffers from the voyria affliction when you use this ability, said affliction will immediately advance to a very late stage.

abilities.description: Until the well runs dry.
abilities.detail: The ritual of Subversion is both the pinnacle of Memorium and the ultimate expression of the depths that the art can be twisted to by one of the Accursed. With mastery of the Logographs and the unhallowed will of the Accursed combined, blood and sorcery may be combined in a ritual better left lost. After you have laid claim to the blood of your victim within one of your stone jars, you may take up knife to craft the manner of their doom in the Ritual Chamber of your crypt. Only freshly obtained blood will suffice: stored blood may be sufficient for lesser works, but this is no such working. You will require a full jar, for the work is long and complex. The ritual of subversion will take an ability of your victim and make it yours as well, for a time. * Each class has an ability or abilities associated for subversion. If there are multiple choices, it is random which you will receive, though there is a subtle suggestion during the ritual that this might be the case. ** The class of the target at the time blood was taken is the one targeted by the ritual. You may find some classes do not have abilities to subvert, most obviously other Pariahs. *** There is a cooldown on this ability, and it is a channel to activate.
abilities.syntax: ACCURSED PERFORM THE RITUAL OF SUBVERSION <target>

abilities.description: Blood as ink and air as canvas.
abilities.detail: The ancient script of the desert people has little power on its own, but such cannot be said for the blood of adventurers. When traced in the blood of an adventurer by a talented sorcerer, all manner of curses can be brought down upon an enemy.

abilities.description: Of deadly fangs and poison.
abilities.detail: The striking serpent shall sink its ethereal fangs into the neck of a foe when traced, paralysing them with its power. In addition, this logograph is unique in the fact that when traced in an epitaph following the logograph of the scorpion, your enemy will also find that the voyria plague has been introduced into their bloodstream(*). * See AB MEMORIUM EPITAPH for details.

abilities.description: To ward against the wicked.
abilities.detail: One of the lesser logographs, the shield cannot be worked into an epitaph, though is one of the most useful logographs all the same. When traced for your person it shall convey resistance to injury; the wiser the tracer, the greater the benefit(*). * The amount of damage resistance this conveys is related to your intelligence stat.

abilities.description: That which sunders.
abilities.detail: One of the crudest of logographs, the fissure possesses two properties of interest. The former is its ability to sunder the magical shields protecting your enemies; the second is that it does not chain from or to anything. Notably however, it also does not interrupt the chaining of other logographs, for reasons the ancient sorcerers were never able to uncover.

abilities.description: Of rot and decay.
abilities.detail: Home. Safety. Grave. A nest can be all these and more. When traced against an enemy this logograph shall instill a great sense of weariness in them(*). * Gives weariness.

abilities.description: Balance in all things.
abilities.detail: The symbol of the scales represents balance. Yet when traced against an enemy imperfections can be introduced in such a way as to make them unbalanced, and the ruin this brings upon your foe shall leave them reeling(*). * Gives clumsiness.

abilities.description: To go beyond the singular.
abilities.detail: The truly gifted wielder of Memorium does not deal in the singular logographs that compose the basic workings. As the wielder learns the script, they realise over time that the logographs flow together; one logograph can flow into one or more other logographs, speeding up the process of tracing. When tracing an epitaph in this way, it is said that the knife of a master can become little more than a blur. In addition, you may fix a set of logographs in your mind, your hand so practiced at tracing that you may advance to the earliest in your epitaph that will maintain an unbroken chain(**). * Use the EPITAPH command to see what logographs flow into which. The balance bonus is cumulative so long as you continue to chain logographs, but it does have a limit. ** EPITAPH FOCUS and EPITAPH ADVANCE are purely for convenience; you may trace epitaphs individually if you prefer.

abilities.description: The unravelling thread of life.
abilities.detail: The thread of life ever unwinds, and all that lives comes to its eventual end. This logograph signifies such, though with a well placed cut in its tracing the practitioner can instill a realisation of your foe's own mortality and the ephemeral nature of the time remaining to them(*). * Gives impatience.

abilities.description: To draw out the poison.
abilities.detail: One of the lesser logographs, the leech cannot be worked into an epitaph, though it is useful all the same. When traced for yourself or another this logograph shall periodically draw out the afflictions which plague you(*). * Roughly every ten seconds, and lasting for five minutes.

abilities.description: Insatiable. Without mercy.
abilities.detail: The ravenous guardians of the Charnel tombs are insatiable. When traced against your foe, so too will they share in the endless hunger(*). * Gives addiction.

abilities.description: Protector. Destroyer.
abilities.detail: The Sun which both nourishes and destroys. All are equal beneath its brilliant glare, though not all can withstand that which it reveals. When traced against a foe, their minds will be pushed to breaking beneath its power, their thoughts thrown into disarray(*). * Gives epilepsy.

abilities.description: The claws that rend and tear.
abilities.detail: The mighty bear shall rend and tear your foe when traced, spilling blood and ensuring that it shall ever flow out with their life. * Gives haemophilia and bleeding. The bleeding is increased in the case where they already have haemophilia when you trace this logograph.

abilities.description: The jaws which snuff the vital.
abilities.detail: The jackal's bite is not something to be underestimated, and such is reflected in the logograph which depicts it. Tracing this logograph against your foe shall let them experience that moment before the fangs definitively close upon them. * Gives asthma.

abilities.description: The striking predator of the sands.
abilities.detail: This logograph is unique in that it takes more power to imbue than blood alone can provide. For this reason, it requires some preparation: it can only be traced as the final logograph in your epitaph, and said epitaph must be sufficiently long(*). However, such preparation comes with expected results: the scorpion shall inflict your foe with a terrible curse, thinning their blood(**). Notably, this logograph is so complex that it does not suffer alterations of any kind: you cannot utilise the scorpion with the heartbeat ability. * At least a length of four. ** Gives the thinned blood affliction (similar to the scytherus venom).

abilities.description: Lists the powers you possess when morphed into a creature.
abilities.detail: While morphed, this command will show you what animal-specific abilities you have available to you.

abilities.description: A cute, bushy-tailed woodland creature.
abilities.detail: A cute, bushy-tailed woodland creature. Powers: Forage, Digging

abilities.description: A small untamed feline. Alert and perceptive.
abilities.detail: A small untamed feline. Alert and perceptive. Powers: Alertness, Nightsight, Scratch

abilities.description: The wary white wolf.
abilities.detail: The form of the wary white wolf. Powers: Bite, Fitness, Howl, Nightsight, Scent

abilities.description: The aquatic turtle.
abilities.detail: The aquatic turtle. Powers: Fluidswim, Snap

abilities.description: The black jackdaw.
abilities.detail: The black jackdaw. Powers: Fly, Land

abilities.description: A creature quick of eye and fleet of foot.
abilities.detail: The Cheetah is quick of eye and fleet of foot. Powers: Alertness, Bite, Fitness, Leap, Nightsight, Scent, Sprint

abilities.description: The wise bird of prey.
abilities.detail: The wise bird of prey. Powers: Fly, Land, Nightsight, Spy, Swoop

abilities.description: A vicious, stealthy creature with a chilling howl.
abilities.detail: A vicious, stealthy creature with a chilling howl. Powers: Alertness, Claw, Elusiveness, Fitness, Howl, Leap, Nightsight, Scent, Stealth

abilities.description: The swift and mighty bird of prey.
abilities.detail: The swift and mighty bird of prey. Powers: Fly, Land, Nightsight, ScanArea, Spy, Swoop, Traverse, View

abilities.description: A cute, burrowing animal.
abilities.detail: A cute, burrowing animal. Powers: Burrow, Digging, Sniff

abilities.description: A slow, ponderous creature.
abilities.detail: A slow, ponderous creature. Powers: Rest

abilities.description: The mighty grizzly bear.
abilities.detail: The mighty grizzly bear. Powers: Alertness, Block, Scent, Shred, Vitality

abilities.description: Increased rapport with the animal spirits.
abilities.detail: When you bond with the spirit that you have metamorphosised into, your chance of being forced back to your mortal form is greatly decreased. The downside of this is that you will lose endurance more quickly from the increased strain.

abilities.description: A delicate, beautiful bird with an exquisite song.
abilities.detail: A delicate, beautiful bird with an exquisite song. Powers: Fly, Land, Melody

abilities.description: Largest of the land mammals.
abilities.detail: Largest of the land mammals. Powers: Block, Fitness, Stampede, Trumpet, Vitality, Yank

abilities.description: The ability to morph from form to form.
abilities.detail: The power you wield allows you to morph directly from one animal to another, without changing back to regular form first.

abilities.description: Pound for pound, one of the most vicious animals.
abilities.detail: Pound for pound, one of the most vicious animals. Powers: Burrow, Digging, Claw, Ambush, Elusiveness, Nightsight, Sniff

abilities.description: A powerful, quick, and stealthy beast.
abilities.detail: A powerful, quick, and stealthy beast. Powers: Alertness, Ambush, Bloodscent, Discernment, Dismember, Elusiveness, Fitness, Leap, Maul, Might, Nightsight, Resistance, Scent, Sprint, Stealth, Vitality

abilities.description: A mythical creature of awesome, magical power.
abilities.detail: A mythical creature of awesome, magical power. Powers: Alertness, Icebreath, Maul, Might, Nightsight, Scent, Sprint, Temperance, Vitality

abilities.description: The king of all flighted birds.
abilities.detail: The king of all flighted birds. Powers: Fly, Hoist, Land, Nightsight, ScanArea, Spy, Swoop, Track, Traverse, View

abilities.description: An agile yet powerful primate.
abilities.detail: An agile yet powerful primate. Powers: Alertness, Pound, Leap, Swinging

abilities.description: Obtaining a greater affinity with an animal spirit.
abilities.detail: The gift of spiritual affinity indicates a level of proficiency at which metamorphosis is so second-nature that it takes a lesser toll on you. The endurance loss rate for all spirit forms is greatly decreased from the time that this ability is activated.

abilities.description: The cousin of dragons themselves.
abilities.detail: The cousin of dragons themselves. Powers: Sting, Alertness, Blaze, Fitness, Flame, Fly, Frenzy, Hoist, Incinerate, Ignite, Inferno, Land, Leap, Maul, Might, Nightsight, ScanArea, Scent, Shred, Spy, Swoop, Temperance, Track, Traverse, View, Vitality, Wreathe

abilities.description: A fearsome creature steeped in mystery.
abilities.detail: A fearsome creature, shrouded in mystery. Its multiple heads are capable of a varied number of abilities. Powers: Alertness, Block, Fitness, Furor, Might, Nightsight, Resistance, Scent, Stampede, Temperance, Vitality, Secretion Group 1 abilities: Bite, Flame, Freeze Group 2 abilities: Snap, Roar Group 3 abilities: Sting, Negate, Armclamp, Legclamp, Bind, Shatter Group abilities can be used in conjunction with each other to unleash a devastating flurry of blows on your opponent. Abilities in group 1 are accessed like normal, while abilities in group 2 can be accessed while off-balance if your previous attack was an ability from group 1. Group 3 abilities are on their own balance, and can be used any time that it is available.

abilities.description: The silent, magical beast of lore.
abilities.detail: The silent, magical beast of lore. Powers: Elusiveness, Bite, Flame, Glare, Negate, Gaze, Resistance, Stealth, Petrify

abilities.description: Instantaneous metamorphosis.
abilities.detail: So attuned are you to the animal spirits, that you are able to morph instantaneously.

abilities.description: Bear, Cheetah, Gorilla, Hydra, Hyena, Icewyrm, Jaguar, Wildcat, and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Your sense of hearing is heightened enough to allow you to detect movement in adjacent locations.

abilities.description: Jaguar and Wolverine
abilities.detail: When performed towards a target in an adjacent location, you spring out, knock them to the ground, stunning them briefly, and cause damage as well. This ability cannot be used from the trees or when flying, for either the ambusher or the target.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: Using your many hydra heads, you can clamp down on the arm of an adventurer.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: Bind an adventurer up in your many hydra heads, preventing most forms of action.

abilities.description: Basilisk, Cheetah, Hydra and Wolf
abilities.detail: Sink your jaws into an unruly opponent. When utilised in the basilisk morph, against adventurers, this has a chance to deliver the loki venom. * Hydra morph only: Delivers your secreted venom into the bloodstream of your adventurer foe.

abilities.description: Wyvern
abilities.detail: This formidable power of the wyvern allows you to coat yourself in fire, at the cost of some of your inner flame. While empowered, your mauls will drive any they strike to the ground. Additionally, while you are ablaze in this manner, your prey will find it impossible to parry your mauls or frenzies so long as they are also afflicted with the darkshade affliction.

abilities.description: Bear, Elephant and Hydra
abilities.detail: This will allow you to block much movement in a particular direction.

abilities.description: Jaguar
abilities.detail: Once you have the scent of your prey's blood in your nose, nothing will stop you from tracking them down(*). * When you strike a tumbling target who is already bleeding with your spear, you will gain the bloodscent defence. This permits you to bypass most forms of room hinder while it lasts (approximately ten seconds - this timer does not refresh).

abilities.description: Gopher and Wolverine
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may, in many environments, burrow underground. While underground, you will be unable to do most actions. You will be able to drop, get, score, stat, def, i, burrow, and morph. As a gopher, you will only be able to burrow quite shallowly. However, once the wolverine morph is attained, you may burrow up to nine levels deep. In fact, you will find that you can burrow underneath many things that you can not normally burrow into. For example, though you cannot burrow down through a highway, you can, if you go at least six levels deep, burrow underneath it. Be warned, however, that anything which you cannot burrow into cannot be burrowed out of. Thus, if you decide to try burrowing underneath a large area which provides you no way of reaching the surface, be very careful, lest you become lost, for you will have no way of getting out. Remember, to go up or down levels, use BURROW ABOVE, or BURROW BELOW. It is rumoured that there are other races living beneath the earth, and if you leave items buried at any depth beyond the first level down, these races may seek out and steal whatever you left deep in the earth.

abilities.description: Hyena and Wolverine
abilities.detail: Attack an opponent with your claws.

abilities.description: Squirrel, Gopher and Wolverine
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may use your little claws to dig up buried things, and to bury things.

abilities.description: Jaguar
abilities.detail: You will be able to quickly assess the wounds of your prey, gauging roughly how severe their bleeding is.

abilities.description: Jaguar
abilities.detail: The savage spirit of the jaguar is ferocious indeed. Once you have bound and impaled an opponent, you can fall upon your helpless prey, ending their life in a bloody frenzy.

abilities.description: Basilisk, Hyena, Jaguar and Wolverine
abilities.detail: With this ability, you cannot be easily followed, allowing you to roam about the land in more safety.

abilities.description: Cheetah, Elephant, Hydra, Hyena, Jaguar, Wolf and Wyvern
abilities.detail: With your mastery of your own body, you are able to purge yourself of the asthma affliction.

abilities.description: Basilisk, Hydra and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Before this ability may be used, you must build up fire inside you. Type SUMMON FIRE to begin this process. When you are ready to breathe yellow fire, you may FLAME <target> or FLAME <icewall-direction>. BELCH or RELAX FLAME will get rid of the flame prematurely. * Hydra morph only. Unleashes a devastating blast of magical fire towards your target. This version can be used against denizens.
abilities.syntax: SUMMON FIRE / FLAME <target> / FLAME <icewall-direction> / FLAME GROUND / BELCH / RELAX FLAME / HYDRA FLAME <target>*

abilities.description: Turtle
abilities.detail: Move across flooding, rivers, lakes, and oceans with confidence and speed.

abilities.description: Condor, Eagle, Jackdaw, Nightingale, Owl and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Soar up into the heavens and fly above the land. LAND to come back to the earth once again.

abilities.description: Squirrel
abilities.detail: Attempt to scamper about forestal locations, searching for food.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: Release a bone-chilling blast towards your foe, freezing them to the core. * Against denizens this deals cold damage.

abilities.description: Wyvern
abilities.detail: Unleash a frenzy at your prey, first plunging your venom-filled stinger into them before ripping at them with your claws. You may sting with: darkshade, vardrax, euphorbia, or sumac(*). You must have a vial of venom on hand to envenom your claws with. * You may only sting with sumac every so often: your venom sacks have a limited amount and take time to refill after each use.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: Tear at one of your prey's limbs with two of your serpentine heads, afflicting them with whatever venom you have secreted.

abilities.description: Basilisk
abilities.detail: The gaze of the basilisk is a powerful and fearful one indeed. With it, you may paralyse or confuse an adventurer or deal psychic damage to a denizen.

abilities.description: Basilisk
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may curse your foe with stupidity or impatience.

abilities.description: Eagle and Wyvern
abilities.detail: From within the skies, you may swoop down on an opponent and HOIST them off the ground. Once you have them clasped within your mighty talons, you can move about with them and either RELEASE them, causing them great damage if they are unfortunate enough not to be able to fly, or DEPOSIT them on the ground somewhere.

abilities.description: Hyena and Wolf
abilities.detail: Drain the mental strength of an opponent with your blood-curdling howl.

abilities.cooldown: GROUND: 3.00 seconds of equilibrium Target: 2.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Icewyrm
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may freeze another adventurer, or the ground beneath you. The first time you freeze an adventurer, he will begin shivering violently, causing him to occassionally lose his equilibrium. The second time you do it, he will become stiff with the cold. If you freeze the ground, a coat of ice will form which will hinder those moving in and out.

abilities.description: Wyvern
abilities.detail: This ability will allow the wyvern to instantly increase their inner flame by two levels, but has a fairly long recovery period.

abilities.description: Wyvern
abilities.detail: After building up white fire within you, you may turn your thermal destruction on an opponent, causing him massive damage and possibly instant death. BELCH will get rid of the flame prematurely. * Kills if the target is below 40% of maximum health, this threshold rising based on how badly they are on fire (50% at one stack of burning, 55% at two, 60% at three).
abilities.syntax: SUMMON FIRE / INCINERATE <target> / BELCH / RELAX FLAME

abilities.description: Wyvern
abilities.detail: Once you have summoned forth blue fire, you may let loose with an armageddon of flame, searing all of those in your location. This is no simple fire, however; even if extinguished, it shall reignite upon the unfortunate individual after a short time.

abilities.description: Cheetah, Gorilla, Hyena, Jaguar and Wyvern
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to leap over various obstacles in your way.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: Using your many hydra heads, you can clamp down on the leg of an adventurer.

abilities.description: Icewyrm, Jaguar and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Rend your victim with your claws and teeth. * In order to target a specific body part, you must have the targeting ability.

abilities.description: Nightingale
abilities.detail: While you are singing this gorgeous melody, people will not be able to attack through the prismatic barrier. However, due to the difficulty of this, you cannot do anything else and maintain your song at the same time.

abilities.description: Hydra, Icewyrm, Jaguar and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Using the power of your naturally strong body, you can heal certain afflictions.

abilities.description: Basilisk and Hydra
abilities.detail: Attempt to strip away the defences of your target. This attack will always strip the caloric salve defence first if it is present. * Hydra morph only.

abilities.description: Cheetah, Condor, Eagle, Hydra, Hyena, Icewyrm, Jaguar, Owl, Wildcat, Wolf, Wolverine and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Use your sensitive eyes to see in the dark.

abilities.description: Basilisk
abilities.detail: The gaze of the basilisk is truly terrible to behold. If your victim lacks the blindness defence, and suffers from four of hallucinations, dizziness, recklessness, confusion, paranoia, epilepsy, and impatience, you may turn them into little more than a living statue. They will be unable to do anything in this time, although the petrification is short-lived. Note that you must be the originator of an affliction for it to count.

abilities.description: Gorilla
abilities.detail: Pound your opponent's body with an enormously powerful blow that is even more devastating if the poor victim is frozen.

abilities.description: Basilisk, Hydra and Jaguar
abilities.detail: Gain resistance to magical attack.

abilities.description: Sloth
abilities.detail: Use this ability to regain endurance at a vastly increased rate.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: The sheer power of your roar can knock those that hear it from their feet.

abilities.description: Condor, Eagle and Wyvern
abilities.detail: While you are flying, you will detect everyone in your local area who is visible and not indoors (suitable for TRAVERSE-ing to). This will not show specific locations, just names.

abilities.description: Bear, Cheetah, Hydra, Hyena, Icewyrm, Jaguar, Wolf and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Attempt to discern the location of an adventurer by his scent.

abilities.description: Wildcat
abilities.detail: Scratch your opponent with your small claws.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: By channeling toxins from the pit of your stomach, the hydra can naturally secrete the following venoms: xentio, darkshade, prefarar, vernalius, aconite, gecko and nechamandra.

abilities.description: Hydra
abilities.detail: Your many heads will strike out at your target, shattering any protective shield found.

abilities.description: Bear and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Using your formidable claws, you're able to shred the flesh of your opponent, causing more than normal bleeding damage.

abilities.description: Hydra and Turtle
abilities.detail: Snap at an adventurer opponent with your beak or maw. * Hydra morph only. ** When using HYDRA SNAP <target>, this skill can be used against denizens to deal damage.

abilities.description: Gopher and Wolverine
abilities.detail: While burrowed down to the first level, sniff will tell you who is above you.

abilities.description: Cheetah, Icewyrm and Jaguar
abilities.detail: Quickly sprint in a chosen direction.

abilities.description: Condor, Eagle, Owl and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Using your lofty vantage point in the sky, you attempt to spy on an outdoors adventurer.

abilities.description: Elephant and Hydra
abilities.detail: From an adjacent location, you may use your elephantine bulk to stampede over someone.

abilities.description: Basilisk, Hyena and Jaguar
abilities.detail: This will allow you to sneak about the land in a very stealthy manner.

abilities.description: Hydra and Wyvern
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may use your deadly tail to sting a hapless victim, delivering the loki venom. * Hydra morph only.

abilities.description: Gorilla
abilities.detail: When in a forest location, you will be able to swing up into the trees.

abilities.description: Condor, Eagle, Owl and Wyvern
abilities.detail: While you are flying, you may swoop down on an adventurer on the ground, causing him damage with your claws.

abilities.description: Hydra, Icewyrm and Wyvern
abilities.detail: Bestow fire resistance on yourself.

abilities.cooldown: TRACK: 4.50 seconds of equilibrium PURSUE: 1.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Eagle and Wyvern
abilities.detail: While flying, you will be able to fly to an adventurer very quickly using TRACK. PURSUE is a complementary ability, and allows you to aerially pursue someone. Your target must be on the ground, and you will follow him from the air while he moves.

abilities.description: Condor, Eagle and Wyvern
abilities.detail: From within the heavens, you may move instantly to the skies above an adventurer that is nearby.

abilities.description: Elephant
abilities.detail: With your mighty bulk, you are able to blast a wall of sound at someone, attempting to knock them to the ground even from the trees or air.

abilities.description: Condor, Eagle and Wyvern
abilities.detail: While you are flying, you may locate all who are nearby and below you.

abilities.description: Bear, Elephant, Hydra, Icewyrm, Jaguar and Wyvern
abilities.detail: You may only activate this ability when very near full health and mana. Once active, when you drop to less than twenty-five percent of your maximum health without dying, you will get a sudden rush of adrenaline that will heal you significantly.

abilities.description: Wyvern
abilities.detail: Using some of your inner flame(*), you may wreathe your hands in fire for a short time. When mauling an adventurer, this will deliver the ablaze affliction; if they are already on fire, it will do significantly increased damage and add a stack of burning. When mauling a denizen, your damage will increase and be dealt as fire damage rather than cutting. * This ability will decrease your inner flame by one level.

abilities.description: Elephant
abilities.detail: From an adjacent location, you may yank an adventurer into your location with your trunk, providing that the adventurer isn't being held there by some means.

abilities.description: Attune yourself to the Underworld.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you will attune yourself to the realm of Death. While doing so, you will be alerted whenever anyone dies.

abilities.description: Send the cold of the grave to plague an opponent.
abilities.detail: Use this ability to freeze an adventurer in two or three stages. If the target has a caloric salve applied, this will nullify the caloric salve. If he doesn't, then it will set him shivering, which will regularly cause him to lose equilibrium. If you chill a shivering adventurer, you will freeze him completely. Additionally, you may target this in a given direction, destroying any firewall that may be blocking that exit.

abilities.description: Seek out the life force of another being.
abilities.detail: You will seek out the very life essence of an adventurer, gaining you the knowledge of his location.

abilities.description: Causing your opponent's flesh to decay.
abilities.detail: You have gained the standard attack of the Necromancer. Your touch is enough to cause the flesh of your victim to wither. It does magical damage.

abilities.description: Create darkness in the room.
abilities.detail: Cast a shroud of darkness over a location.

abilities.description: Perform many actions in secret.
abilities.detail: This will draw a shroud of concealment over your actions.

abilities.description: The shriek of the banshee.
abilities.detail: You have gained the power of the banshee. Your very scream will drive those who can hear you out of the location.

abilities.description: Attack those with pure souls.
abilities.detail: Summon the malignity of the Lord and strike down a foe's soul with raw, necromantic power. This dark prayer will bypass any magical shields or prismatic barriers around your target.

abilities.description: Derive sustenance from another being.
abilities.detail: Essence: 1.5% You are now able to literally drain the nourishment from another adventurer in a display of cruelty.

abilities.description: Leech away the mental energy of your target.
abilities.detail: This is the skill of draining another's mental energy to add to your own.

abilities.description: Allows you to see many hidden beings.
abilities.detail: You are attuned to the life essences of all living beings, and with this power, you will see through many illusions and hiding defences.

abilities.description: Cause your opponent's limbs to shrivel up.
abilities.detail: By grabbing onto the limb of an adventurer, you can destroy its marrow, rendering it useless.

abilities.description: Rip out and consume the heart of your victims.
abilities.detail: This is truly the joy of the Necromancer. If there is a corpse on the ground that has not already been victimised by a fellow Necromancer, you may DRAW HEART. Then, in an orgy of gastronomic pleasure, you may CONSUME HEART. The greater the experience of the adventurer who provided the heart, the greater your gain in life essence will be. Enjoy this pleasure, my murderous friend, for there are few greater in life or death. It is important to note that how much life essence you get is modified by the experience of your victim.

abilities.description: Sense about how much life essence you have.
abilities.detail: This will tell you how much life essence you possess.

abilities.description: Draw upon your essence to increase your mana.
abilities.detail: You draw on your life essence to boost your mana.

abilities.description: Draw upon your essence to increase your health.
abilities.detail: You draw on your life essence to boost your health.

abilities.description: Cause your flesh to decay and melt.
abilities.detail: By turning your flesh into a semi-liquid, rotting state, you gain some measure of immunity from both blunt and edged weapons.

abilities.description: Drain your life essence into another Necromancer.
abilities.detail: With this ability you can transfer life essence from yourself to another necromancer. Unfortunately, it is not a perfect transfer and some life essence will be lost in the process. You can avoid this imperfect aspect if carrying out the transfer upon Mhaldor Isle (or within Mhaldor city proper), as these are locations so closely tied to the necromantic arts that the working becomes far easier.

abilities.description: Spew forth a noxious gas.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to belch forth a cloud of foul, poisoning gas that will hurt anyone breathing it in, except you.

abilities.description: Surround yourself in a miasma of evil.
abilities.detail: This ability will create, for a sixth of an Achaean day, and at a cost of life essence, an aura of death and evil that will harm all enemies who are in your location.

abilities.description: Curse someone with the visage of a rotting corpse.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you will cause your opponent's visage to become so horrific that even his closest allies will turn on him. The chaos and fickleness of emotion and sentiment is a wonderful thing, is it not?

abilities.description: Driving animal spirits away.
abilities.detail: Unleash your necromantic essence in a deadly soulstorm, cruelly assaulting the soul of your foe. This ability will attempt to force a metamorphosized adventurer back into his mortal form. Against denizens, you will instead profane their soul with malign energy, causing them to take ten percent more damage from necromantic abilities(*), the curses of evileye(**), and the weaponmastery attacks of your fellow Infernals(***). In this case, the equilibrium and essence costs of this dark art shall be greatly reduced. * NECROMANCY DECAY and TAINT. ** EVILEYE BLEED. *** All weapon-based attacks in the WEAPONMASTERY skill when performed by an Infernal.

abilities.description: Summon the hands of the grave to hinder your opponents.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause rotting hands to rise up from the ground to grab at the ankles of any who try to leave the location. The only ones who will not be affected are those who serve Evil in the city of Mhaldor.
abilities.syntax: SUMMON HANDS OF THE GRAVE / BANISH HANDS OF THE GRAVE

abilities.description: Spread disease to all around you.
abilities.detail: By filling your body with the unclean, you can infect many others in the room with you, be they friend or foe, causing random limbs to shrivel up. Useful against a group.

abilities.cooldown: 6.00 seconds of equilibrium and 12.00 upon completion
abilities.description: Destroy all plant life in a location.
abilities.detail: Using your command of the energies of death, you are able to wipe a forest area clean of plant life, replenishing some of your essence. Be warned though, there is an essence cost to this ability, and unless there is a sufficient amount of plant life in the room, you may lose essence using it. It should also be noted that an exterminated room is no longer considered a forest room, so many Druidic abilities will not work in such a room. Take note: prolonged use of extermination will take a toll on your essence reserves, and you will find that each subsequent attempt incurs a greater cost in essence than the last to perform.

abilities.description: Revenge with your dying breath.
abilities.detail: At the cost of a fair amount of life essence, you will exact revenge on everyone in the room when you are killed, in most circumstances.

abilities.description: Meld soul-matter from the dead into a physical weapon.
abilities.detail: Soulspear allows the skilled Necromancer to form a weapon forged in the soul of the dead. By taking an adventurer corpse, you can form the soulspear. A corpse from an adventurer level 30 and under has too weak a soul to form such a powerful weapon out of. Beyond that, the higher the level of the victim, the more powerful the soulspear. Once you have it, you may throw it at someone who is outside your room, anywhere in your line-of-sight. It will shatter shields and prismatic barriers, or, if the person lacks one of those, the necromantic energy will be released, summoning forth hands of the grave in your victim's location.
abilities.syntax: EVOKE SOULSPEAR FROM <target corpse> / THROW SOULSPEAR AT <target> <direction>

abilities.description: Cross vast distances in a single step.
abilities.detail: This ability allows for swift travel across the land. You must initiate the activation from a room where hands of the grave have been summoned forth. If your target also stands in a room where the hands grasp at the living, this travel is instantaneous. If the hands are not present, the target is required to be a practitioner of necromancy, and the travel will be delayed.

abilities.description: Assume the form of the deadly blackwind.
abilities.detail: This allows you to take the form of the deadly blackwind. While in this form, your freedom is severely limited, but your ability to be harmed is also severely restricted. After you have become the blackwind, you have the nefarious ability to slip down a victim's throat and CHOKE him. While in blackwind form, you will lose willpower very quickly as you strain to hold your nebulous form together. HUMAN is the command to return to your normal form. In addition, you may SURGE in a direction to bypass closed doors, though this is a channeled action and will not bypass doors that are locked.
abilities.required: 5% life essence, 500 mana and willpower drain

abilities.description: Banish the holy rites of the Bloodsworn Gods.
abilities.detail: Using your Necromantic essence, you may sever any devotional rites from the location in which you stand. If the layer of the rite is present, this ability takes some time, during which you may make no actions.

abilities.description: Rip your victim's chest open and torture him to death.
abilities.detail: Evil as you are, you find yourself enjoying live experimentation, preferably on people you know. Once your victim is splayed out and helpless, meaning all four of his or her limbs are withered, you may perform your experiments, killing your victim in horrifying agony. Successful completion of this ability will thwart the ressurective capability of the starburst tattoo.

abilities.description: Harness your life essence to escape death itself.
abilities.detail: This is perhaps the greatest of the necromantic abilities, and carries with it the greatest life essence cost. It allows you to spin a web of life essence around your very soul, protecting it from death. Soulcage may only be used once every 6 Achaean days. The soulcage can be deactivated by raising a barrier of life essence between it and your soul, preventing it from saving you from death. It may be reactivated later for a much lower essence cost. SOULCAGE STATUS will show the current state of your soulcage, if any.
abilities.required: New soulcage (30% life essence), Reactivate (3%), Deactivate (2%)
abilities.syntax: SOULCAGE ACTIVATE / SOULCAGE DEACTIVATE / SOULCAGE STATUS

abilities.description: A chill that enters from the aura to the body.
abilities.detail: You can afflict a person's aura with an ague. This will cause the unfortunate wretch to freeze in two or three stages. If the target has a caloric salve applied, this will nullify the caloric salve. If not, then it will set him or her shivering, which will regularly cause a loss of equilibrium. If you chill a shivering person, you will freeze him or her completely. If two of their limbs are broken to the point of needing a restoration salve, it will perform this freeze twice in a single cast.

abilities.description: Seek out another in your mind's eye.
abilities.detail: Using the power of your will, you can seek out the location of anyone's aura.

abilities.description: Cause your enemy's body to warp beyond recognition.
abilities.detail: Your power to warp reality can be focused on a single individual, causing horrific mutations and cancerous growths that are ultimately quite lethal.

abilities.description: Create darkness in the room.
abilities.detail: Cast a shroud of darkness over a location.

abilities.description: Perform many actions in secret.
abilities.detail: This will draw a shroud of concealment over your actions.

abilities.description: Warping your own body is not for the faint of heart.
abilities.detail: You can warp your own form into an unspeakable image, causing a primal fear even in the most hardy so long as they can see you(*). * The victim must be unblind.

abilities.description: The Hymn to Glaaki will raise strange mists.
abilities.detail: By singing the Hymn to Glaaki, you may call up eldrich mists out of the ground itself, harming all adventurers present except yourself.

abilities.description: Conceal the movement of your chaos entities.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause all the chaos entities in your entourage to become cloaked. While cloaked, their movement in and out of rooms will not be seen. To remove the cloak, use UNMASK.

abilities.description: Force your students to pay attention.
abilities.detail: Using the power of your will, you can exert your aura and force your students to attend to their studies, curing them of deafness and blindness. Alternatively, when used against a denizen, you can lash their minds with karmic energy, dealing psychic damage to any who have enough vitality to pay attention(*). * This skill only deals damage to denizens at 100% health or higher.

abilities.description: Suck the strength from your enemy's aura.
abilities.detail: Using the power of your aura, you can send forth a tendril and suck out the energy from the aura of another, thereby draining another's mental energy to add to your own. If your subject is afflicted with manaleech or they are frozen, the amount of their mental strength you drain will be increased.

abilities.description: Hide your writings from prying eyes.
abilities.detail: Secrecy is one of the hallmarks of Occultism. In order to guard your writings from the uninitiated, you can hide your writings in a cipher. TRANSLATE will decipher the text so anyone may read.

abilities.description: A small time warp around your enemy makes them hungry.
abilities.detail: Your power over reality and time is such that you can create a small warp in the time field around an individual, who will not notice any time pass, though his or her body will suddenly feel the effects.

abilities.description: Your aura gives insights into that which is around.
abilities.detail: You are an Occultist, attuned to the aura of all living beings and able to seek out their lifeforce. With this power, you will gain both deathsight and lifevision.

abilities.description: Cause your opponent's limbs to shrivel up.
abilities.detail: By grabbing onto the limb of an adventurer, you can destroy its marrow, rendering it useless.

abilities.description: Reading another's aura will reveal their secrets.
abilities.detail: Your knowledge of auras is such that you may read the auras of others, seeing any anomalies and enchantments attached to the auras, or sense any presence that protects or affects the aura. This ability requires equilibrium, but not balance.

abilities.description: Sense how much karma you have accumulated.
abilities.detail: You may now utilize karma by probing the occult mysteries found in various valuable items found across the land. KARMA will tell you how high your karma level is. When you STUDY <item>, your karma level will rise, and the karmic value of the item you are studying will be slowly consumed by this thirst for knowledge.

abilities.description: Create a figurine of your heart to help give you mana.
abilities.detail: Using your karma, you can create a heartstone, which stores mana that will be drawn upon until the heartstone cracks.

abilities.description: Create a figurine of yourself that absorbs damage.
abilities.detail: Using your karma, you can create a simulacrum that stores health. Whenever you take damage, a portion of that damage will be absorbed by the simulacrum until it cracks.

abilities.description: Sense the whereabouts of Chaos Entities in the land.
abilities.detail: The disruptions in reality caused by entities of Chaos are quite distinctive to one trained in the sublime arts of Occultism. By reaching out with your consciousness, you may find the locations of these disruptions throughout the Prime Material Plane. Unlike those of lesser, uninitiated minds, you are able to perform this feat from any plane, and even pinpoint those entities loyal specifically to you whether on the Prime Material Plane or otherwise.

abilities.description: Warping time in a location will move vibes.
abilities.detail: You are a master of time itself and can warp the field of time in your location. If there are any vibes in your location, one will be randomly dislocated outside of time.

abilities.description: Distorting your aura will protect you from physical harm.
abilities.detail: Tapping into your karma, you can distort your own aura, causing a portion of physical damage meant for you to be fed back on the attacker. Your mana reserves will be constantly drained as long as your aura is distorted. NORMALAURA will return your aura to its natural state. A distorted aura additionally mitigates some damage from denizens, though not from players.

abilities.description: Surgically alter your patient's aura.
abilities.detail: You have become exceptionally expert in the study of auras. Indeed, now you can surgically alter an individual's aura, removing one of the following defences: cloak, speed, caloric, frost, levitation, insomnia, kola.

abilities.description: Impart your karmic knowledge to others with Occultism.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to transfer some of your own karma to another Occultist. It should be noted that this is not an even exchange - more karma is lost by you than is gained by the recipient of the transfer.

abilities.description: Open a gateway to the Plane of Chaos.
abilities.detail: Open a gateway to the Chaos Plane, allowing you to go there and bargain for the services of the Chaos Entities. Once the gate is opened, ENTER GATEWAY to enter the Chaos Plane. Once there, you can either wait the quarter part of an Achaean day (in which case you will be unceremoniously ejected), or you can seek the exit, which is hidden in the Whirlpool of Chaos.

abilities.description: Hear what cannot be named, or see what cannot be imagined.
abilities.detail: From your studies of occult lore, you can use karma to actually speak the Unnamable's name or cause a vision of the Unnamable to appear to everyone in a location. For any who are not trained in occult studies, those hearing the name or seeing the vision will be afflicted with various insanities. The insanities bestowed by this will not duplicate with existing maladies upon the unfortunate witness or listener.

abilities.description: Devolving your enemy will make them unrecognizable.
abilities.detail: You have the power to terribly curse your opponent so that his or her appearance de-evolves into a primitive state, causing any allies to turn on him or her in disgust and to crush their own opinion of their worth(*). * Gives disloyalty and shyness.

abilities.description: Cleanse away those pesky animal spirits from an aura.
abilities.detail: This obscure occultic ability allows one to strip away the natural defences of a target's aura, exposing them to more invasive assaults. When used against an adventurer, you will require your target's mana be 40% or lower to be successful. In this weakened state, certain eldritch entities will be able to exploit the victim's aura to great effect(*). Against denizens, this will cause your foe to take ten percent more damage from occult abilities(**), chaos hounds(***), and the weaponmastery attacks of your fellow Unnamables(****). In this case, the equilibrium and karma cost of this occultic art shall be greatly reduced. * See AB DOMINATION GLAAKI for details. ** OCCULTISM WARP and ATTEND. *** DOMINATION LYCANTHA. **** All weapon-based attacks in the WEAPONMASTERY skill when performed by an Unnamable.

abilities.description: Master your body and create tentacles of your own.
abilities.detail: You can warp your body so that it sprouts tentacles, which seek out your enemies of their own accord, holding them in your location.

abilities.description: Pure chaos will strike all in a location.
abilities.detail: Transmuting your karma into pure chaos, you can summon forth the Seven Rays to blast a location, hitting everyone in the room except yourself with random rays of chaos.

abilities.description: They shall warp under your will.
abilities.detail: Through extensive study of the Unnamables, the Occultists of Ashtan have determined how to mutate the bodies of others in a more controlled manner than previously believed possible(*). This greater working builds upon the lesser forms of warping, though it requires a far greater degree of finesse. However, it comes with the unique benefit that lesser occultic workings(**) may be introduced into the process. * Does limb damage and a minor amount of health damage. The limb damage is increased against a limb that is already broken to requiring a mending salve. ** Lesser works which can be combined are: ague, shrivel, and regress.

abilities.description: Instill your victim's aura with diseases of the body.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to instill your victim's aura with various afflictions. You may select from: asthma, clumsiness, healthleech, sensitivity, slickness, paralysis, or darkshade. This process inflicts a minorly taxing influence upon the subject(*), though the influence is more significant if you are in possession of a truename derived by the power of the Imperator(**). * Does some small amount of health and mana damage. ** From the Glaaki ability in Domination.

abilities.description: A curse of madness not soon forgotten.
abilities.detail: Having one of the following insanities: dementia, stupidity, confusion, hypersomnia, paranoia, hallucinations, impatience, addiction, agoraphobia, lovers, loneliness, recklessness, and masochism, weakens the mind enough to afflict that person with the dreaded curse of whispering madness. Once afflicted, your victim will find that attempts to focus their mind take far longer to recover from.

abilities.description: The Mark of the Devil grants great power.
abilities.detail: You can give yourself the mark of the devil. When flinging the tarot DEVIL card, the devil is bound to you by your will for a longer period of time up to a possible three services. The mark of the devil vanishes as soon as this term of service expires. You may also wipe the devilmark from your body to prematurely end the services of a devil.

abilities.description: Find the truename of your enemy.
abilities.detail: Your occult knowledge has grown to such an extent that you can discern the truename of an individual, the name that vibrates to that person's soul, from his or her corpse. TRUENAMES will tell you whose truenames you have and how many times you may utter it. If the truename of a person is uttered in front of him or her, that person will be harmed in body and mind and be inflicted by the Aeon curse. Once uttered, that particular truename will be forgotten. Due to the mental strain of remembering an individual's truename, you are only able to remember up to three for each person, for a total of fifty people.
abilities.syntax: TRUENAME CORPSE / TRUENAMES / TRUENAMES FORGET <target> / UTTER TRUENAME <target>

abilities.description: Turn yourself into a being of pure energy.
abilities.detail: Having mastered all facets of your aura, you can now become pure spirit, though you will moderately lose willpower as you strain to hold your nebulous form together. HUMAN is the command to return to your normal form. In addition, you may ASTRALISE in a direction to bypass closed doors, though this is a channeled action and will not bypass doors that are locked.

abilities.description: Reveal the truth to the uninitiated.
abilities.detail: Perhaps the cruelest curse imaginable, you can reveal the occult mysteries to a non-initiate as you have learned it. Their minds must be sufficiently open for the revelation to be received. In other words, they must have six(*) of: claustrophobia, agoraphobia, lovers, dementia, epilepsy, hallucinations, confusion, stupidity, paranoia, vertigo, shyness, addiction, recklessness, or masochism. If such is the case, you may give that target the revelation of what the nature of the universe is as you see it, which will unfortunately make their insanities permanent until death. * This number drops to five if they are suffering from the curse of whispering madness.

abilities.description: Destroy the psyche of the uninitiated.
abilities.detail: Once you've enlightened the mind of a non-initiate to the mysteries of the Occult, you may draw upon the latent energies of Entropy and Discord throughout Creation. Focusing these Chaotic ripples upon your target's already battered psyche, you may completely unravel his mind, slaying him instantly. Slaying an individual in this manner will release a potent karmic aura, buffering your own karma.

abilities.description: They will hear and be silent.
abilities.detail: The mysteries of the multiverse are many and great, but the fragile mind of the unenlightened ever shies away from such possibility. Yet when you have seized upon the fundamental nature of such a mortal derived from their yet living person(*), you will find that more delicate opportunities open up before you. You may command such a student to observe one of these mysteries. If they are adequately prepared for the revelation therein, various results will be made manifest: Discord: Requires: the target have the healthleech and asthma afflictions. Result: their mind will be greatly strained, causing them to be struck down with the loneliness and dizziness afflictions. Entropy: Requires: the target has the haemophilia and addiction afflictions. Result: the subject will contemplate the nature of time, losing the speed defence if it is present and being struck down with the curse of the Aeon if it is not. Potential: Requires: the target be afflicted with all four of their limbs being broken or is frozen. Result: if the target's limbs are broken, they will suffer a short-lived blackout. If they are frozen, they will suffer damage. * It must be a true name acquired via the Glaaki ability in Domination. ** Compelling carries its own internal cooldown, and though it requires both balance and equilibrium, it consumes neither.

abilities.cooldown: Activate: 12.00 seconds of equilibrium Deactivate: 5.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Reincarnate as a Chaos Lord.
abilities.detail: Congratulations! Your studies have now reached the plateau wherein your mastery of the occult is so great that you can now prepare your body and aura for true transformation. Instead of dying, you will transmogrify into a being of pure chaos--you will become a Chaos Lord. You will receive one change of the body, skin and a very odd miscellaneous change which correspond to the effects listed below. MUTATIONS will show you exactly what the functions of the mutations you have are. It will not show useless mutations (see below). By raising a barrier between yourself and the Chaos Lord's spirit, you may prevent your transformation from occuring upon death. This barrier can be lowered in the future at a much smaller cost. TRANSMOGRIFY STATUS will show the state of the Chaos Lord within your soul, if any. You may only use this ability once every 3-9 (random) Achaean days. * Note: The chance for positive changes outweighs the chance for negative changes by nearly a 2-1 margin. It is also possible to get a useless mutation. For instance, bulging muscles that give no strength advantage, or blotchy skin that does not subject you to greater magical damage.
abilities.syntax: TRANSMOGRIFY ACTIVATE / TRANSMOGRIFY DEACTIVATE / TRANSMOGRIFY STATUS / MUTATIONS

abilities.description: Rise in His service.
abilities.detail: The Infernal knights are blessed by the Lord of Evil with the arms profaned by His dark will. Visit the forge within his temple upon the western isle, and forge yourself a new. Profaned arms are tied so closely to the Lord of Evil that acts of Necromancy channeled directly through them can be performed without feeding upon the life essence of the wielder(*). There are two types of abilities that may be utilised in this way: Armour-based abilities are channeled and you may only have two active at a given time. Weapon-based abilities are invested and typically take the place of a venom when they strike a target, though there are exceptions (see relevant ability files for details). * Hellforge-based Oppression abilities cost no life essence due to this, though the scope is far narrower than the traditional art of necromancy. As a price for this, an Infernal knight will struggle with traditional Necromancy, and techniques from said school of the black art will be far more draining on their life essence than for a true practitioner. In addition, they regain life essence at a much reduced rate naturally than true Necromancy practitioners.
abilities.syntax: HELLFORGE STATUS / HELLFORGE CALL <WEAPON|ARMOUR> / HELLFORGE CHANNEL <effect> / HELLFORGE INVEST <effect> / HELLFORGE PROFANE <armour|weapon> / HELLFORGE STRIP <armour|weapon>

abilities.description: Brand the heretic.
abilities.detail: When standing within a location that has been vivified, you may uncover the lingering trace of the heretic who dared defile His Isle.

abilities.description: His legion will not falter.
abilities.detail: Empower your hellforged armour with the relentless endurance of the Master, and you will be unswayed by those effects which would attempt to inspire fear in you(*). * You still receive the afflictions, but you will not be affected by them.

abilities.description: The Lord's dominion shall expand.
abilities.detail: Using your command of the energies of death, you are able to wipe a forest area clean of plant life, replenishing some of your essence. Be warned though, there is an essence cost to this ability, and unless there is a sufficient amount of plant life in the room, you may lose essence using it. It should also be noted that an exterminated room is no longer considered a forest room, so many Druidic abilities will not work in such a room. Take note: prolonged use of extermination will take a toll on your essence reserves, and you will find that each subsequent attempt incurs a greater cost in essence than the last to perform.

abilities.description: Summon vile maggots from the depths.
abilities.detail: This ability will summon a horde of foul maggots from the depths of the earth. For a limited duration, all enemies in the room will be afflicted with varying ailments as the vile creatures burrow into their skin. This will not duplicate an existing affliction.

abilities.description: Then serve in death.
abilities.detail: If they will not serve in life than they shall in Death. By drawing the hearts of the fallen, you may consume them to restore your reserves of life essence.

abilities.description: Mercy is a disease.
abilities.detail: When disemboweling a heathen with your blade, if they have the impudence to survive you will twist your blade as it comes free, causing internal trauma (or serious internal trauma if they already have a damaged torso).

abilities.description: Let the heathens suffer for their blasphemy.
abilities.detail: Imbue necromantic energy into your blade, replacing a venom application on the next blow. Your blade shall corrupt their blood, causing haemophilia.

abilities.description: Surround yourself in a miasma of evil.
abilities.detail: This ability will create, for a sixth of an Achaean day, and at a cost of life essence, an aura of death and evil that will harm all enemies who are in your location.

abilities.description: Their weakness shall not go unanswered.
abilities.detail: Imbue your blade with necromantic energy, taking the place of a venom application. On your next blow you shall cause terrible suffering to the heathen that dares oppose you(*). * This damage scales to the number of mental afflictions your victim suffers from.

abilities.description: They shall bend the knee.
abilities.detail: Channel great amounts of necromantic energy through your profane weapon, and call forth the hands of the grave to claw at the living(*). * This calls gravehands and also prones all non-mhaldorians in the location.

abilities.description: Go forth in His name.
abilities.detail: Each time you slay an adventurer you will immediately regain balance (though not equilibrium) and will also gain a surge of health. When you slay a denizen you will gain the health, but not regain balance. This is an ongoing hellforge armour effect.

abilities.description: To hide is futile.
