abilities.detail: Seek out a heathen with your oppressive gaze, detecting them where ever they may be on your current plane.

abilities.description: The flaws of the heathens are known to you.
abilities.detail: Imbue necromantic energy into your blade, taking the place of a venom application. Upon your next blow the heathen will be struck down with both weariness and paranoia.

abilities.description: Banish the holy rites of the Bloodsworn Gods.
abilities.detail: Using your Necromantic essence, you may sever any devotional rites from the location in which you stand. If the layer of the rite is present, this ability takes some time, during which you may make no actions.

abilities.description: Crush their hope.
abilities.detail: It is expected that the weak shall seek to flee your wrath. You may rampage against these feckless cowards. If there are hands of the grave in your location and in the target's location, your rampage shall resolve immediately. If there are not, you shall rampage more swiftly against one in an adjacent location, though anyone in your local area cannot escape your reach.

abilities.description: Until the last breath.
abilities.detail: His chosen warriors do not fear to die in His name, no price is too high and no life is greater than the cause. When suffused with bloodlust you will be unable to determine the value of your health or mana, but for each heathen(*) that falls in your location you will be empowered(**). * Non-mhaldorian. ** You will have a surge of healing to both health and mana and an affliction will be cured from your person.

abilities.description: There can be but one.
abilities.detail: All serve the Lord, but only one can be the strongest. All are the Lord's tools, but only one can be the sharpest. All are the Lord's army, but only one can be His sword. In his wisdom the Lord of Evil has granted his most faithful knights to pit themselves against one another. There is no surrender. There is no mercy. There is no second chance(*). Many may enter the infernal arena but only one shall leave unbowed. Visit the arena within the Lord of Evil's temple upon the western Isle and you may issue an apotheosis challenge to another knight of Evil that also stands there. To take up the Infernal arms is acceptance enough(**). The knight of Evil who triumphs over the most of his fellows shall be elevated above all others come years end(***). * You may only face a given person once per Achaean year. There are no do overs! ** Standing in the acceptance location leaves you open to be challenged. You will not have the option to refuse and the battle is to the death. *** The Apotheosis reward is awarded at each years end.

abilities.description: In body and mind.
abilities.detail: Imbue necromantic energy into your blade, taking the place of a venom. When your blade strikes your foe it shall give the healthleech affliction; if they are already leeching their health away, they will become confused.

abilities.description: Put them back in their place.
abilities.detail: Sometimes a welp will think to rise above their station. They are simply educated with a blow of the hand; no need to bloody the whip when your own body will suffice. * This deals damage, and will strip any magical shield your target may possess.

abilities.description: They shall bleed for the Lord.
abilities.detail: Your hellforged weapon will now feed upon the blood of your target. When it strikes a heathen bleeding 100 or more you will be healed in body, and if it strikes a heathen bleeding 200 or more you will additionally be cured of an affliction. Additionally, any heathen that suffers from the healthleech affliction delivered by you will cause you to be cured of an affliction when their strength is drained(*). This is passive and always active so long as you are wielding your hellforged weapon. * This effect has a 12 second cooldown. It does not lockout the bleed requirement, but it also does not stack with it.

abilities.description: They shall serve as example.
abilities.detail: Evil as you are, you find yourself enjoying live experimentation, preferably on people you know. Once your victim is splayed out and helpless, meaning all four of his or her limbs are withered, you may perform your experiments, killing your victim in horrifying agony.

abilities.description: Death is no barrier to His triumph.
abilities.detail: When channeling the pitiless focus of the Lord through your hellforged armour you shall strike out at all of your enemies with His vengeance when you fall. This is similar to the necromantic method of doing so, though with a single difference: any who are truely slain by your vengeful blow shall immediately plunge into the Halls of the Finality. This is an ongoing hellforge armour effect.

abilities.description: You will overcome.
abilities.detail: Your understanding has progressed to such a degree that the Lord will grant you resistance to damage, so that you may fight on passed the point when lesser soldiers would fall. This is a passive effect always in play when you are clad in your hellforged armour.

abilities.description: Pain is nothing before your will.
abilities.detail: Draw upon the fires of the Inferno, weaving them into your armour. Though the searing heat will periodically cause you to suffer, if the unthinkable happens and you fall in service to the Lord you will return through the Halls of the Finality with greater swiftness, so as to rejoin in His work with all haste.

abilities.description: Break the body, forge the spirit.
abilities.detail: Sometimes a whelp will require you to get a little more hands on when it comes to discipline. Take them up by two of their limbs and show them how generous you were previously to allow them the use of said limbs. * Breaks both limbs and deals some minor damage.

abilities.description: That which may fall under your sway.
abilities.detail: The intrepid sorcerer will require a swarm to do their bidding, and in the early days a more hands-on process is required. While wandering the land you may detect what insect life is nearby that you may enthrall; different insects may be found in different locations, and some locations will be more bountiful than others.

abilities.description: You are the nightmare that crawls and flies.
abilities.detail: While in a location that you have detected sufficient insectoid life, you may bend your arcane art to the task of bringing your soon-to-be minions under your sway. SWARM ENTHRALL: bring insects under your control. If there are multiple types of insects in the location, you will need to specify which ones you wish to enthrall. SWARM BUILD: break your enthralled insects up into swarms. SWARM NAME: give a personalised name to a swarm, for easy reference. SWARM SHOW: see details about one of your swarms. SWARM DISPERSE: disperse one of your swarms back into your reserves of insects. SWARM RESERVES: see your insects outside of swarms. SWARM DISMISS: Get rid of unwanted insect types, even from your reserves. SWARM DISBAND: wipe one of your swarms. SWARMS: see all of your swarms.
abilities.syntax: SWARM ENTHRALL [type of insect] / SWARM BUILD <number of insect> <type of insect> [<number of insect> <type of insect> ...] / SWARM NAME <swarm> <new name> SWARM SHOW <swarm> / SWARM DISPERSE <swarm> / SWARM DISMISS [RESERVES] <insect type> / SWARM DISBAND <swarm> / SWARM RESERVES / SWARMS

abilities.description: Your minions carry much.
abilities.detail: Your deadly swarms bring ruin upon your enemies, but sometimes a more insidious approach is required. Each swarm can be infected with one of the deadly plagues that your arcane art may manufacture: these can then be conveyed through various methods. Note that the process of infecting takes time, so preparation before battle is key.

abilities.description: Leave no scraps.
abilities.detail: Command a ravenous swarm of burrowing insects to surge towards a denizen, where they will rip and tear flesh, dealing cutting damage. This ability can only be performed every so often(*), unless the swarm fully devours its target(**). * Every 40 seconds. ** If this attack lands the killing blow, the cooldown is immediately refunded.

abilities.description: The price of power.
abilities.detail: When need is high, you may sacrifice one of your swarms by flooding it with your arcane power. It is a costly use of your minions, though doing so will cause all in your location (except yourself) to be struck down with the arcane plague that said swarm was carrying. They shall also suffer damage from the excess energy released. * This will destroy the swarm utilised on use, including all insects contained therein.

abilities.description: Darkness beneath the writhing clouds.
abilities.detail: There will always be those that think that they can outfly your swarms. They are wrong. By directing one of your swarms made up of flying insects to eclipse the sky in a location, any who try to take to the air to escape that location will find that your minions are not so simply evaded(*). If you attempt to take to the skies yourself, your swarm will immediately disperse from its task. * They will be knocked back to the ground and off balance.

abilities.description: Interaction heralds doom.
abilities.detail: The arcane plagues are dangerous in the singular, but it is when they interact that they truly become deadly. Various plagues react to one another when coaxed to do so via higher sorcery, and the interactions are listed below: Pyramides + Flushings = Healthleech. Pyramides + Rebbies = Slickness. Flushings + Rebbies = Darkshade. Flushings + Sandfever = Anorexia. Mycalium + Sandfever = Dizziness if not present, then stupidity if not present, or blackout if both are present. Mycalium + Sandfever + Rebbies = Peace. These conditionals do stack with one another, and you may only invoke this act of higher sorcery a subsequent time after some delay. This working of higher sorcery can be wielded against anyone in the local area.

abilities.description: Pain that comes on countless wings.
abilities.detail: Send a swarm composed of stinging and flying insects to descend upon your enemy. Beyond simply suffering the pain of the ordeal, if your victim is an adventurer they shall also be infected by whatever plague your swarm is infected with. Weariness will affect this ability.

abilities.description: Into the warm and dark.
abilities.detail: Send your swarm to burrow into the flesh of your foe, lingering within their body. This utilisation of your swarms does not do more than cause bodily discomfort(*), but there are many opportunities available to one who can invade the corpus once this has been achieved(**). * Does damage. ** There are further abilities which can be utilised via a burrowed swarm.

abilities.description: Call them home post haste.
abilities.detail: If one of your swarms has burrowed into a victim, you may call them urgently to return with predictably bloody results. A swarm ripping itself free in this manner will cause blood to splatter the location(*), bodily harm, and convey any plague it is carrying. * See AB MEMORIUM SANGUINEHAND.

abilities.description: Rampant from within.
abilities.detail: Your options once one of your swarms has burrowed inside a victim are numerous. While perhaps not as viscerally satisfying as tearing your minions free, infestation is a more subtle working. Though your swarm will be expelled in the process, you can have them leave behind remnants of that plague which they carry, which will manifest at a later time(*). * The plague your swarm is carrying will relapse twice at a later time, though it is not given on the process of infestation itself.

abilities.description: A bleak future awaits.
abilities.detail: Your myriad minions are undoubtedly deadly when used overtly, but there are more subtle workings you may also employ. Once the defences of your foe have been breached(*), and they are sufficiently vulnerable(**), you may utilise your minions as a vector through which to ravage your foe internally with your sorcery(***). * A target who possesses three of: pyramides, flushings, rebbies, mycalium, and sandfever. ** You must have a swarm burrowed into your target. *** Their body will be unable to process immunity elixirs for thirteen seconds after your arcane strike.

abilities.description: A black fate indeed.
abilities.detail: An enemy who is sufficiently weakened and vulnerable to your myriad minions can be dispatched post haste. May their fate be a lesson to those that would consider opposing your will(*). * They will need to be suffering from thinned blood, haemophilia, and the pyramides disease as well as 200 bleeding.

abilities.description: The body rejects that which sustains.
abilities.detail: Its origins shrouded in mystery, this insidious plague takes its name from the legendary swordsman. Any wound that bleeds becomes potentially deadly when labouring beneath this disease, the body turning against itself and being unmade from within(*). * All bleeding is increased by 10% when suffering under this plague. ** Note: this affliction will always be cured after paralysis when attempting to cure it via bloodroot or magnesium.

abilities.description: An unpleasant transformative disease.
abilities.detail: Its origins shrouded in mystery, this disease is a slow-working infection that breaks down and reshapes the body over time. In itself it is not particularly dangerous: the truly nightmarish aspect of its function is that the modifications are passed on to any of the infected's progeny. One of the immediate symptoms, however, is that salve applied to the skin can leave it extremely tender(*). * Applying salves to the skin or torso area will result in being afflicted with sensitivity.

abilities.description: Even the vital will be purged.
abilities.detail: A most unpleasant disease that in the distant past inspired all manner of modern day curses, flushings is an insidious plague which causes a violent reaction to the consumption of ginseng(*). The reaction causes the body to turn against itself, and purge even that which sustains it(**). * Also applies to ferrum minerals. ** Each time you eat ginseng/ferrum you will bleed from your pores.

abilities.description: A blight upon this land.
abilities.detail: Named for perhaps the most loathed monarch in the history of the Seleucarian Empire, this disease is extremely insidious. One infected with the unnatural plague may not even realise they have it; they will only know that all that gaze upon them are provoked to irrational and indiscriminate violence(*), though in its more rampant manifestations they will find that they will suffer from uncontrollable shaking(**). * Those afflicted with this disease will be considered a personal enemy by everyone. ** Periodic balance loss, similar to the epilepsy affliction if to a reduced frequency.

abilities.description: A single step is a quest indeed.
abilities.detail: Beneath the oppressive sun of the desert the infamous sandfever was born. A hapless individual labouring under this disease will find movement a truly exhausting task; once mighty warriors will find themselves drained by even the most simple of movement(*), and once sharp minds shall fall into silent disarray(**). * While afflicted with this affliction a person's celerity becomes 1: this means you can only move one room before having to wait to move again. ** You cannot focus your mind while afflicted with sandfever.

abilities.description: Tinker with an enemy's vital fluids.
abilities.detail: The body is held in balance by four vital fluids, called humours. Humourism is the science of manipulating these humours via the ether to cause illness in another. To raise a target's humours, you must TEMPER that humour. Humours can be reduced by the target eating the ginger herb or antimony mineral. The maximum number of times each of a person's humours may be tempered is eight. Each time you TEMPER a humour it raises the level by 1. If the target is afflicted with afflictions related to that humour, this number may rise. Each humour will cause the victim to be disadvantaged in some form. The penalties and related afflictions are as follows. Choleric (yellow bile): Random curing abilities will have a chance of failing. (nausea, sensitivity, slickness) Melancholic (black bile): Irid moss and potash will have a reduced healing benefit. (anorexia, impatience, stupidity) Phlegmatic (phlegm): Smoking will have a chance of filling your lungs with phlegm, increasing your lungs recovery time. (asthma, clumsiness, weariness) Sanguine (blood): Bleeding will increase over time. (haemophilia, recklessness, paralysis) Only one humour may be tempered at once with this ability; training in Physiology will allow for more freedom in tempering multiple humours. Evaluation of a target's humours can be done for free.

abilities.description: A homunculus will serve you faithfully.
abilities.detail: You may CULTIVATE NUCLEUS, using a small amount of your own flesh to create a small mass of living tissue. This nucleus can then be germinated from anywhere, so long as you hold in your hands some alchemical salt, sulphur, or mercury, into a full-grown homunculus using GERMINATE NUCLEUS <prime>. This homunculus, which is a small, imperfect copy of the alchemist who created it, may be controlled via the ethereal bindings between the creator and the created. Initial control is weak, but further training in Physiology will allow for more proficient control of your homunculus. You may only have one homunculus alive at a time, and it will perish should you yourself die. HOMUNCULUS FOLLOW will order your homunculus to follow you. If it is unable to follow you because it is in a different location, HOMUNCULUS RETURN will bring the homunculus back to you. You may also HOMUNCULUS ATTACK <target> to have your homunculus attack another, though its attacks will be weak without training in Physiology. Finally, HOMUNCULUS PACIFY will command your homunculus to cease its attacks. Most homunculus abilities work on their own special balance, while requiring balance and equilibrium.
abilities.syntax: CULTIVATE NUCLEUS / GERMINATE NUCLEUS <prime> / HOMUNCULUS FOLLOW / HOMUNCULUS RETURN / HOMUNCULUS ATTACK <target> / HOMUNCULUS PACIFY / HOMUNCULUS <command> [args]

abilities.description: See through the eyes of your homunculus.
abilities.detail: Having gained the ability to control your homunculus's eyes, you may look into whatever room it stands so long as it is on the same continent as you. You may also specifically check for exits from its current room.

abilities.description: Control your homunculus's legs from a distance.
abilities.detail: So long as you and your homunculus stand within the same area, you may order your homunculus to move from room to room.

abilities.description: Afflict an opponent by assaulting the humours.
abilities.detail: By assaulting an opponent's humours, you can afflict upon them several common maladies. Each has several afflictions and a damage type associated with it, and any afflictions from wracking a humour will come only from this pool. When wracking, you may specify the affliction you wish to use, or you may allow the affliction to manifest at random at the cost of a slight delay in speed. It is possible to wrack an opponent's untempered humour, though this is done at a balance penalty and may be done only via specifying the affliction. When used against denizens, wracking will deal damage with the type of damage determined by the chosen humour. Wracking operates outside of humour balance, and may be used off-equilibrium immediately following a symbology ability when targeted against an adventurer. The humours and their affliction pools are: Choleric: Nausea, sensitivity, slickness, (poison damage). Melancholic: stupidity, anorexia, impatience, (cold damage). Phlegmatic: clumsiness, weariness, asthma, (asphyxiation damage). Sanguine: Haemophilia, recklessness, paralysis, (magic damage).

abilities.description: Specialised attacks for your homunculus.
abilities.detail: By mastering control of your homunculus's arms, you may now use your homunculus to more effectively attack your opponent. In addition to increased damage, your homunculus's damage type will change depending on the prime used to germinate it, and each prime will grant the attacks a special effect: Salt: Magic damage - Attacks will cause bleeding. Sulphur: Psychic damage - Attacks will drain mana. Mercury: Poison damage - extend the next herb balance of the target. Note, however, that if your homunculus becomes separated from you, its attacks will revert to its original, weak attacks. In addition, you may administer one of the primes with which your homunculus was not germinated in order to temporarily grant the effects of that prime. Note that attacks under the effects of administered primes will be less effective than those of its native type.

abilities.description: Discern the vitals of another.
abilities.detail: By evaluating your target, you may roughly discern his or her fluid level, humour states, health and mana. Evaluating your target's humour states alone with EVALUATE <target> HUMOURS will not use any equilibrium.

abilities.description: Listen through your homunculus's ears.
abilities.detail: Having mastered control of your homunculus's auditory system, you may decide to listen to anything your homunculus hears.

abilities.description: Manipulation of two humours at once.
abilities.detail: You are now able to temper up to two humours on an opponent at one time.

abilities.description: Speak through the mouth of your homunculus.
abilities.detail: You may use your homunculus's mouth to speak from afar.

abilities.description: Concurrent control over three humours.
abilities.detail: You are now able to temper up to three humours on an opponent at one time.

abilities.description: Your homunculus possesses dextrous fingers.
abilities.detail: With control over your homunculus's hands, you may now manipulate items from afar. All commands require your homunculus to be in the same area as yourself, with the exception of looking in its inventory. HOMUNCULUS INV[ENTORY] will show you what your homunculus is currently holding. HOMUNCULUS GIVE <item> TO <person> allows to your homunculus to hand an item to another. The homunculus must be in the same room, on the same elevation, as the target, and the target may not be phased or similar. HOMUNCULUS GET <item> will pick up an item from the ground. This can only be done if your homunculus is holding fewer than five items already, and is subject to the same restrictions as picking up an item yourself. HOMUNCULUS DROP <item> will drop an item from your homunculus's inventory into its current room. This is subject to the same restrictions as dropping items yourself.
abilities.syntax: HOMUNCULUS INV[ENTORY] / HOMUNCULUS GIVE <item> TO <person> / HOMUNCULUS GET <item> / HOMUNCULUS DROP <item>

abilities.description: Mastery of all four humours.
abilities.detail: You are now able to temper all four humours on an opponent at one time.

abilities.description: Your homunculus will prevent an enemy from escaping.
abilities.detail: Your homunculus will now attempt to block whoever it is currently attacking from leaving the room, so long as you stand beside it.

abilities.description: Wrack two humours simultaneously.
abilities.detail: Your skill in physiology now allows you to wrack two humours at once. If you do not specify two afflictions, random ones will be picked from the relevant humour pools. You can find the lists of relevant afflictions under AB PHYSIOLOGY WRACK. Note: Paralysis may only be delivered once the sanguine humour has been sufficiently tempered (two times).

abilities.description: Your homunculus's screeching will startle an enemy.
abilities.detail: By controlling your homunculus's throat, you may shriek loudly at an opponent, disrupting his or her concentration. This will knock your target off focus balance or increase the timer needed to regain focus balance, as appropriate. You must be in the same room as your homunculus to use this ability.

abilities.description: Failure upon failure.
abilities.detail: Your grasp over the humours of your subjects is now such that you may meld your mastery of physiology with your alchemical workings directly. Causing cascade failures requires a sufficiently prepared subject: Vitrification: requires a target's sanguine humour has been tempered at least twice and brings it back into balance by one temper. However, you will perform the vitrification far more swiftly than normal.
abilities.syntax: Append CASCADE to the end of appropriate attacks

abilities.description: Attack an already imbalanced humour.
abilities.detail: By inundating an already tempered humour with additional fluid, you may cause an instant reaction in your opponent. This will cause all fluid to be drained from that humour. The more fluid drained, the greater the reaction. The effects for each humour are: Choleric: Health loss. Melancholic: Mana loss. Sanguine: Bleeding. Phlegmatic: Afflict with afflictions from lethargy, anorexia, slickness and weariness. The higher the fluid level, the more afflictions will be delivered simultaneously.

abilities.description: Capitalise on your homunculus's alien physiology.
abilities.detail: By channeling your powers of humourism through the alien body of your homunculus, you may corrupt an opponent's melancholic and sanguine humours. This has the interesting effect of causing mana loss from bleeding, and health loss from clotting. The effect will wear off after a time.

abilities.description: Eternal life with a brand new body.
abilities.detail: While within your home city's physiology laboratory, you may INCUBATE NUCLEUS, which will then grow over time into a perfect replica of your body. This will take several days, after which you will be able to TRANSFUSE CONSCIOUSNESS should you die, moving your soul into this new body. This must be done from the same continent and plane as the laboratory. TRANSFUSE STATUS will show you the location of your incubating body, and how much more time (if any) is needed for incubation to complete.
abilities.syntax: INCUBATE NUCLEUS / TRANSFUSE STATUS / TRANSFUSE CONSCIOUSNESS

abilities.description: Kill another with catastrophic organ failure.
abilities.detail: If at least two of your target's humours are tempered, you can attempt to shut down his internal organs, causing instant death. This will take some time to complete, during which you can perform no other actions. Having more humours tempered will make the process simpler, decreasing the time needed to induce arrest.

abilities.description: Leap at your foes in neighboring rooms.
abilities.detail: With this acrobatic attack, you can handspring into an adjacent room, attacking an adventurer there.

abilities.description: Wish for the props that every good jester needs.
abilities.detail:
With this ability, you may throw some gold up into the air and wish for balloons, mickeys, itching powder, or blackjacks. You must have the relevant ability to wish for the associated prop. Costs
Balloon:20 gold
Blackjack:500 gold
Mickey:20 gold
Itchpowder:20 gold
You may optionally wish for multiple (up to 10) props at once. When doing so, the gold cost and balance use will be multiplied.

abilities.description: Take to the skies with balloons.
abilities.detail: The first of a few balloon-related abilities, this allows the jester to inflate a normal balloon and fly up to the skies with it.

abilities.description: Slip out of that which would bind you.
abilities.detail: Once you've activated slipperiness, you will be able to WRITHE from entanglements faster than normal. Additionally, your agility will allow you to partially avoid attacks from denizens, reducing your damage taken. There is no ongoing cost to this ability.

abilities.description: Deliver a vicious blow with a blackjack.
abilities.detail: This ability requires that you have a blackjack wielded. With it, you may bop someone, either adventurer or denizen. It may be used in conjunction with the targeting ability in weaponry. Additionally, when used against adventurers, it will deliver either amnesia, stupidity, or epilepsy.

abilities.description: Twist a balloon into a giraffe.
abilities.detail: This ability requires the presence of a balloon in your inventory. MOUNT GIRAFFE will allow you to mount it, and then you can move it around as usual. You are also able to STEP INTO TREES from on its back.
abilities.syntax: INFLATE BALLOON INTO GIRAFFE / MOUNT GIRAFFE / STEP INTO TREES

abilities.description: Flip over obstructions.
abilities.detail: You may BACKFLIP past obstructions that would otherwise be impassable by normal means.

abilities.description: Cast coloured illusions to dazzle those about you.
abilities.detail: This ability lets you set off coloured, delayed illusions. The colours available to you can be seen at the bottom of CONFIG COLOUR, with the exception of 15, which you may not use. The cost in mana is one mana for each character in the illusion. You may embed a single newline in an illusion by inserting the character sequence \n at the appropriate spot. For restrictions and limitations, please refer to HELP ILLUSIONS.
abilities.syntax: HOCUSPOCUS <delay in seconds> COLOUR <color> <illusion message> / HOCUSPOCUS <delay in seconds> <illusion message>

abilities.description: Make a swift retreat.
abilities.detail: While you are riding your inflatable giraffe, you may beat a hasty retreat, going up to 10 rooms in a straight line.

abilities.description: Momentarily stun everyone in the room.
abilities.detail: This bomb, when it explodes, will create a wave of force that will stun everyone in the room momentarily. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
abilities.syntax: CONSTRUCT CONCUSSION BOMB / THROW BOMB <direction>/AT GROUND

abilities.description: Blast people from the skies and trees.
abilities.detail: Upon exploding, this bomb will rise up into the air and knock those in the trees and skies to the ground. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
abilities.syntax: CONSTRUCT BUTTERFLY BOMB / THROW BOMB <direction>/AT GROUND

abilities.description: Launch your foes to the clouds with a balloon.
abilities.detail: With this ability you may inflate a balloon and immediately hand it to someone else, causing them to be carried into the air. Those protected by the mass defence are too heavy to be moved.

abilities.description: Leap out of the room striking someone on the way out.
abilities.detail: With the backwards handspring, you may leave the room while simultaneously kicking someone on your way out.

abilities.description: Maintain superior balance.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you will have superior balance, making it much more difficult to knock you off your feet. There is a mana drain associated with it, however.

abilities.description: Coat a weapon in venoms.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may layer venoms on an edged weapon. Each time that weapon hits somebody, one venom will poison your opponent, and disappear from the weapon. They work on a last-on, first-off basis, so if you put xentio on a weapon, and then put voyria on, the voyria would come off first, and the xentio second. You must have the selected venom in a vial in your inventory. In order to get rid of the venoms on a weapon, simply WIPE <weapon>.

abilities.description: Choke all in the room with a plume of smoke.
abilities.detail: This bomb, when it explodes, will spew out a foul gas that will choke those in the room. The fumes induce hunger in those that inhale them. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
abilities.syntax: CONSTRUCT SMOKE BOMB / THROW SMOKEBOMB <direction>/AT GROUND

abilities.description: The ancient art of juggling.
abilities.detail: You may juggle up to two items at once, or three if you have reached Transcendent pranks. Once you are juggling, you may throw the items you're juggling at a greatly decreased cost in balance. JUGGLED will show you what, if anything, you are juggling. Be aware that juggling comes with an endurance drain and, no matter how nimble your fingers, you are not adept enough to juggle bombs.

abilities.description: Explode strands of webbing to bind everyone in the room.
abilities.detail: When this bomb explodes, it will throw out magically sticky webbing everywhere. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
abilities.syntax: CONSTRUCT WEB BOMB / THROW BOMB <direction>/AT GROUND

abilities.description: Masterful footwork to make yourself a difficult target.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you will exercise your dexterity, becoming far more difficult to hit. Be warned that it comes with a serious endurance drain.

abilities.description: Sometimes you have to just let it all out.
abilities.detail: The humourless can sometimes just be too much. By venting your frustration upon them, tomorrow can be a brighter day! You'll slap the stupid into them and make them a stuttering fool, that you will.

abilities.description: Strip defences with your terrible jokes alone.
abilities.detail: This ability will induce the desire to slap you in those who hear your jokes, causing them to lose the rebounding aura and shield defences. Note that other jesters are already so familiar with terrible jokes that this ability will not work on them.

abilities.description: Slip someone a mickey.
abilities.detail: After obtaining a mickey from the Props ability, you can slyly slip the mickey to someone, which will cause that person to eat the mickey instead of the next herb he intends to eat, making him sick.

abilities.description: The ability to search for traps in your location.
abilities.detail: The TRAPS ability will search for traps in the room, giving you information about them. You will not be able to find traps laid by someone with higher skill than you.

abilities.description: Attempt to disarm a trap.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you will attempt to disarm a trap in the direction specified. If you are successful, and not in the arena, then you will get the commodities that went into its making. If you are unsuccessful, you will fall victim to the trap. You will only be able to disarm traps laid by those with skill equal to or less than your own.

abilities.cooldown: Write: 6.00 seconds of equilibrium Identify: 3.00 seconds of balance
abilities.description: Scrawl messages on walls.
abilities.detail: While in any outdoor urban location, you can scrawl coloured graffiti on the wall. It will last until someone uses a bucket of water to scrub it off, with SCRUB WALLS.

abilities.description: Quickly somersault past obstructions.
abilities.detail: With this ability you can escape a location even if you're webbed or paralysed. It is faster than 'tumbling' in Survival, as a bonus.

abilities.description: Pluck arrows from the air.
abilities.detail: At the cost of a constant mana drain, this ability will give you a chance to pluck arrows fired at you from the air.

abilities.description: Litter the floor with banana peels.
abilities.detail: You are now able to conjure up a handful of banana peels on the ground. These slippery items will make it more difficult for people to leave the room.

abilities.description: Construct festive firecrackers.
abilities.detail: The firecracker is an essentially useless little prank designed to make celebratory occasions more festive. You'll find that a single piece of iron will make three firecrackers.

abilities.description: Employ the irritating itchpowder.
abilities.detail: Like the mickey, once you've gotten some itchpowder through the Props ability, you can slip it on someone, making him or her itch uncontrollably until an epidermal salve is applied. This will cause the unfortunate individual to be periodically afflicted with impatience.

abilities.description: Numb the sense of your victims with a bomb.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause a cloud of dust to go up, cutting off much sensory input for a time. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
abilities.syntax: CONSTRUCT DUST BOMB / THROW BOMB <direction>/AT GROUND

abilities.cooldown: Construct: 4.00 seconds of balance Wind: 2.00 seconds of balance
abilities.description: An innocent musical toy with a vicious bite!
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may construct a jack-in-the-box that, when wound and targetted for a specific person (see syntax above), will kill that person when the puppet pops out, assuming the target is still in the room. You may not do anything else while you wind the jack-in-the-box.

abilities.description: Give your bombs a delayed effect.
abilities.detail: By setting a timer on a bomb, you are able to delay its effect. Be warned though, that once a timer has been set, a bomb cannot be picked up again.

abilities.description: A tough crowd, this one.
abilities.detail: Sometimes the infamous greyfaces need a bit of a different approach to coax out a smile. If wielding a puppet of one such poor soul, you may enlighten him or her with some good old gallows humour, adding some real character to his face in the process(*). Even then, you might need to soften them up a bit first(**). If used against a denizen, this skill does not require a puppet and behaves differently. With your morbid humour, you will inflict psychic damage upon the target. The closer they are to death, the sharper your wit cuts(***). * This will improve the fashioned state of your puppet. ** The more afflictions the target has, the more fashions you will receive. They will require at least two and several things are excluded: broken limbs, writhe afflictions, and anything with a nonstandard cure such as time. *** You will deal increased damage to denizens under 50% health. This bonus increases on denizens below 25% health.

abilities.cooldown: Educate: 5.00 seconds of balance Strap: 4.00 seconds of balance
abilities.description: Brainwash mice to carry bombs on their backs.
abilities.detail: Brainwash mice until they are willing to sacrifice their lives for you. First, get a rope and cheese, and then tie the rope to the cheese. Then, you have to fish for the mice in a city area. Reel the mouse in when one bites. Once you've caught one, you may educate him, which will prepare the mouse for use. Just strap a bomb onto his back, drop him, and ORDER MOUSE KILL <whoever>. If you are within approximately 10 rooms of your target, the mouse will immediately take off chasing your unlucky victim, and, upon finding the person, detonate the bomb.
abilities.syntax: TIE CHEESE TO ROPE / FISH FOR MICE / REEL IN MOUSE / EDUCATE MOUSE / STRAP <bomb> TO <mouse> / ORDER MOUSE KILL <target> / CALL MICE

abilities.description: They weren't using it anyway.
abilities.detail: Once you've got a good idea of how someone's wagging their tongue, you can grab that beauty right out of their mouth*. You'll need to get it just right though, so it'll take some observing. Once someone is afflicted with stuttering, each time they communicate** you'll get a better idea of what you need. Once you've observed enough***, the rest is up to you! * Yes, they die. Tragic but what can you do. ** Any form of communication triggers this, as well as the puppet tickle ability. Laughter might not be the best medicine in this case. *** You'll need to observe four times to be able to liberate their tongue.

abilities.description: Become a mighty viridian.
abilities.detail: Meaning 'green' in an ancient language, a Viridian is a living, walking embodiment of the flora of the land. Upon casting this spell, you will quickly transform into one as thorny vines cover your body and burrow into your flesh. You will become stronger, able to endure more damage, and gain a protective bonus to physical damage done to you however your movements will be slightly hampered. HUMAN will allow you to change back into your normal form. Be aware that remaining in this form is a constant drain on your willpower. * STAFF option may be added to allow transformation into the mighty Viridian in areas that are not normally conducive to plant growth.

abilities.description: Rend your foes with your lethal vines.
abilities.detail: You may now lash the flesh of your foes with your thorny vines, doing damage. If you have learned the TARGETING ability in Weaponry, you may optionally direct your thornrend at a specific body part, causing additional damage to an arm, leg, the head, or the torso of your opponent. If you have gained the ENVENOM ability in Weaponry then you may envenom your arms, which will deliver a venom to your target when you thornrend. Otherwise, you may SECRETE SAP to coat your arms in a single application.

abilities.description: Aiming your blows at specific body parts.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you will be able to target specific body parts on your opponent. Because this requires more precise timing on your part, the sheer damage you can do is reduced. However, by lacerating these body parts with your lethal vines, you can cause damage to them that is more difficult to cure than simple broken bones. For instance, a limb may be able to be beaten into uselessness, which requires a restoration salve to fix (and which does not get fixed immediately). Attacks to the torso will produce internal bleeding, while attacks to the head will produce a concussion. TARGET NOTHING will turn targeting off.

abilities.description: Enhance yourself with nature's bounty.
abilities.detail: This is the core of the propagator's strategy. While in Viridian form, you are able to propagate one of either your head, body, arms, or legs with a plant. As you progress in propagation, you will learn to utilise more plants in this way. Each plant conveys a different benefit depending on the location you grow it. Returning to human form will remove all of your propagations.

abilities.description: One of the most widely used herbs.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: You will regenerate endurance faster. Body: You will regenerate health faster. Arms: Your thornrend attack will deal increased damage to paralysed adventurers or hindered denizens (*). Legs: Move more quickly through caves and other such locations. * Valid denizens battlerage afflictions are: clumsiness, amnesia, charm, and stun.

abilities.description: The grass of the sea.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: Increased asphyxiation resistance. Body: Allows for breathing underwater. Arms: Your thornrends will additionally deliver the healthleech affliction. Legs: Assuming you can already walk on water, move more quickly through watery environments.

abilities.description: A flower with mysterious properties.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: Access to the rage ability, which cures various afflictions. Body: Immunity to the peace affliction. Arms: Your thornrend attacks will additionally deliver the weariness affliction. Legs: The ability to walk on water.

abilities.description: The first step toward mastery.
abilities.detail: You are now able to propagate up to two of the four possible locations simultaneously.

abilities.description: Lay open their throat with your vines.
abilities.detail: You will now be capable of lacerating a target's throat, slashing vocal cords and causing great pain.

abilities.description: A plant that grows in mountainous areas.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: Increased psychic resistance. Body: Reduces the mana cost of clotting your wounds. Arms: Your thornrends will additionally deliver the slickness affliction. Legs: Move more quickly through mountainous areas.

abilities.description: A brightly coloured plant used to cure phobias.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: You are less likely to fall prey to the muddling effects of the stupidity affliction. Body: You will be immune to fear effects from phobia afflictions. Arms: Your thornrend attacks will additionally deliver the vertigo affliction. Legs: Move faster through forests.

abilities.description: A potent herb with limited applications.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: Allows you to writhe out of transfixation much faster. Body: Allows you to writhe entanglements faster. Arms: Your thornrend attack shall deliver dizziness. Legs: Move faster through tundra and polar regions.

abilities.description: A berry that grows in various valleys.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: You will recover more quickly from sipping the immunity elixir. Body: Increased resistance to poison damage. Arms: Your thornrend attack will deal cutting damage against adventurers and denizens, instead of magical. Legs: You are less likely to slip on icy ground.

abilities.description: Call upon Nature to hinder your foe.
abilities.detail: Calling upon Nature, you may summon a mass of animated vines to hinder your target for a time, preventing any attempts they make to parry your thornrends.

abilities.description: A small nut with surprising potency.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: Maintaining the metawake defence will cost less mana and willpower. Body: Awaken swiftly as if you had the kola defence. Arms: Your thornrend attack will secrete a sap that will attempt to put your target to sleep. Legs: Move faster through jungles and valleys.

abilities.description: Greater control over the viridian.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your training where you are able to propagate three of the four possible locations simultaneously.

abilities.description: Make your skin tough like bark.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause your skin to become as bark, providing an increased measure of protection vs. attacks doing physical damage.

abilities.description: A plant that affects the mind.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: Increased willpower regeneration. Body: Increased mana regeneration. Arms: Your thornrend attacks will additionally deliver epilepsy. Legs: Move faster through grasslands.

abilities.description: A plant that grows in the harsher environments.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: You will be able to see when adventurers fall in battle as if you had the deathsight defence. Body: You will recover more quickly from smoking the skullcap plant. Arms: Your thornrend attacks will funnel power into an arcane storm if one is present (requires feedback on your target) OR bypass the shield defence against denizens(*). Legs: Move more swiftly through deserts. * Your thornrend attacks will bypass, but not strip, the magical shield defence on denizens.

abilities.description: Bedazzle your foe with a celestial bolt.
abilities.detail: Calling upon the vast brilliance of sky-bound celestial bodies, you may overwhelm a target's senses. Unless they are sufficiently restrained, your victim may evade the effects of the spell.

abilities.description: A plant that grows in hilly locations.
abilities.detail: When propagated, this plant conveys the following bonuses: Head: You can shout longer messages without passing out from the strain. Body: When eating the hawthorn plant, you will gain the deafness defence faster than usual. Arms: Your thornrend attack will deliver the sensitivity affliction if deafness is not present; otherwise it shall strip the deafness defence. Legs: Move faster through hilly locations.

abilities.description: Send Nature's touch to destroy your enemy from within.
abilities.detail: Among the most dangerous and forbidden of a sylvan's spells, the Heartseed embodies Nature at its most baneful. Draining your victim's vitality to speed its growth, the germination of a Heartseed will rapidly end the life of he or she whom it is sent to plague. If your victim manages to avoid their fate and cure the heartseed, their body will be wracked by the process, causing them significant damage for each injured limb they suffer from.

abilities.description: Complete mastery of the viridian form.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point where you are able to have all four possible locations propagated simultaneously.

abilities.description: Your mind must never be corrupted.
abilities.detail: Purge your mind of a single mental affliction. If you have impatience, this will always be cured first. If you are confused, you will be unable to focus enough to carry out this psionic act.

abilities.description: A spike of psychic force.
abilities.detail: A precisely targeted spike of psychic force will shatter the magical shields surrounding your opponents.

abilities.description: A simple application of your intellect.
abilities.detail: Direct your considerable intellect towards the process of understanding all racial languages(*). * This has the same restrictions as the necklace of comprehension artefact.

abilities.description: The mind shall not be constrained.
abilities.detail: Expand your mental faculties, restoring some mana.

abilities.description: Communication is key.
abilities.detail: You may imprint a psionic message upon a location, after which any other also practiced in psionics may retrieve said message. There may only be one psionic message per location and the act of retrieving the message will damage said message. If damaged too much, the message will fade.

abilities.description: A subtle touch of misdirection.
abilities.detail: Interfering in an individuals telepathic communication channels is a trivial enough process if one knows how. It is said that the true born Aldar could project their influence across an entire network, but alas such is lost to all but the barest few. You may target an individual and make them see a message on the channel you so desire, though the telesense defence will make it apparent to them that someone is interfering (though they will not see who).

abilities.description: Your mind against theirs.
abilities.detail: By focusing all of your attention on the process(*), you may drive out foreign influence upon your mind or the mind of a friendly target(**), breaking any mindlocks if one is present. * This is a channeled action: you may perform no other actions while focusing on severing the mindlock. ** In the case where you target it at the person you have lifebonded it will be the same delay as when targeting it at yourself: in all other cases the channel is twice as long.

abilities.description: Your will is implacable.
abilities.detail: Radiate a circle of psychic force outwards, knocking all that stand in your location off their feet: friend and foe alike.

abilities.description: A gentle touch to confound and mislead.
abilities.detail: This subversive psionic art will not harm your enemy directly, but will cause mental maladies to affect them more significantly(*). * They shall have a greater chance of failing actions due to stupidity, and are more likely to suffer the adverse affects of dizziness.

abilities.description: The faintest changes are yours to know.
abilities.detail: Your mind is now so attuned to those around you that you will be able to detect when the body, mind or spirit of someone you have began the unweaving of reaches a critical level.

abilities.description: Controlling the self is of paramount concern.
abilities.detail: Drive your body into action even when paralysed through sheer force of will.

abilities.description: Pain is a warning.
abilities.detail: By pushing your mind beyond its safe limits, you will temporarily speed your focus balance.

abilities.description: Your mind is far superior.
abilities.detail: Link your mind to another and you will take attacks against their mind upon yourself. Be warned, if your mana falls below half of your maximum you will die outright and if not resurrected by a starburst tattoo or similar shall find your soul lacking significantly in substance(*). * You will die and be left on low mana as a soul.

abilities.description: Sometimes a hammer can replace the scalpel.
abilities.detail: Sometimes you require a more overt display of force. Though your gifts do not lend themselves overly to offensive acts, an unfocussed blast of psychic power is more than within your grasp. Providing a target's mind is sufficiently weakened(*), you may direct this blast to ravage their mind, leaving their mental defences in ruins. This will permit you to not only strike at their flesh with your woven weapons, but also at their mind(**). * They must have at least three of: impatience, stupidity, blackout, dizziness, epilepsy, and unwoven mind. ** Your weaving attacks shall drain mana when striking a target with a ravaged mind.

abilities.description: The insidious becomes apparent.
abilities.detail: Reach out with your psionic senses, detecting how many telepaths are holding mindlocks in your local area.

abilities.description: Perceive the state of another's mental strength.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may see how much mana an adventurer has.

abilities.description: Your will made manifest.
abilities.detail: By creating a psychic projection of yourself in a location, you may overlay it with yourself from anywhere on the same plane and continent. Doing so will swap your location with the projection(*). * The projection will fade after three swaps.

abilities.description: Perception is everything.
abilities.detail: This advanced psionic ability will permit you to consistently annihilate the knowledge of your presence from the minds of those in your proximity. You may select partial(*) or total(**), total having all of the benefits of partial but lasting half as long. This ability is very taxing, and you may only enact any form of vanish every so often. * A partial vanish shall hide your presence in a room. ** A total vanish shall hide your entry and exit, as well as your presence on alertness.

abilities.description: Perfect unity of the mind and body.
abilities.detail: By attaining a truly transcendent mind, you may operate your physical and mental abilities in complete harmony(*). To attain this state of mind you must exercise your body's potential while focusing on the state of transcendence(**). * Once your mind and body achieve full transcendence, you can perform a psionics action while off equilibrium and for no incurred equilibrium cost. ** Each time you perform a weaving-based attack while transcendence is active you will increase how harmonised your mind and body are. A failure to attack after some time will cause your state to regress.
abilities.syntax: PSI TRANSCEND [skill to use if full transcendence only]

abilities.description: Just like heating water.
abilities.detail: One of the basic exercises for budding psion students was to heat a cup of water with their will alone. Unfortunately, during the War of Humanity where death was the business of the Aldar, one particularly malicious student under Han-Silnir's command determined that at its heart blood is simply liquid too, and equally available for manipulation. Though boiling the blood inside a person's veins is fortunately beyond modern psionics users, blood that is open to the air is an easy target(*). While the blood forged flames burn upon someone's skin, they will find it impossible to apply salves(**). * If someone is bleeding sufficiently, you may set their blood aflame with this technique. ** This affliction is cured once all bleeding is clotted away.

abilities.description: A single cut at the fundamental level.
abilities.detail: If your enemy's mind is sufficiently weakened, you can deliver a single precise stroke to cause the whole to collapse in upon itself(*). * Requires below 30% of mana.

abilities.description: The pinnacle of mental might.
abilities.detail: In ancient times the Aldar Caymus drove his mind's potential beyond all others, able to pierce the very fabric of time and gaze upon events not yet transpired. While no other has achieved the mastery he claimed since, a lesser form of such foresight is available to you. By fixating on a possible eventuality in the future, if such an eventuality comes to pass you will be able to act with unnatural speed to disrupt it. While this will not foil the action entirely, it will cause it to have undesirable consequences. If your foresight fails however, and the action is not performed, you will be stunned. Tree: foreseeing a tree touch will extend the recovery period. Shield: foreseeing a shield tattoo shall extend the equilibrium recovery period.

abilities.cooldown: Initial fashion: 2.00 seconds of balance Standard fashion: 2.00 seconds of balance Unravel: 10.00 seconds of balance
abilities.description: Fashion puppets from wood.
abilities.detail: In order to fashion a puppet, you first need to get yourself 2 wood commodities. After you fashion the first time, you will have for yourself a crude humanoid puppet. In order to make it actually useful, you must then wield the puppet, and FASHION PUPPET OF <target>. As you fashion your puppet of an adventurer over and over, you'll notice that it gets closer and closer to being a semi-living puppet. Further, the more fashions you have with your puppet, the more Puppetry powers will be able to be channeled through the puppet. Additionally, your puppet will decay at a rate of 50% every 6 minutes after the last fashion. This effect does not occur for puppets of allied adventurers. If you find yourself in need of destroying a puppet that is no longer in your possession, you may unravel it from afar. Note that this is a difficult feat, and will result in being thrown off balance for a long period of time.
abilities.required: Initial fashion: 50 mana, and 2 Wood Standard fashion: 50 mana Unravel: 750 mana

abilities.description: Grip your puppets tighter than ever before.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Muddle the thoughts of your victim.
abilities.detail: This will cause your victim to become mentally confused.

abilities.description: Cause your enemy to become unsteady on his feet.
abilities.detail: Curse your victim with the dizziness affliction.

abilities.description: Put someone to sleep.
abilities.detail: Either put your victim to sleep, or remove a sleep-related defence.

abilities.description: Cause your victim to see an image of your choosing.
abilities.detail: Cause your puppet's namesake to see something specific. You may embed a single newline by including the characters \n at the appropriate spot.

abilities.description: See the surroundings of your target.
abilities.detail: Get a view of what's in your target's surroundings. If your puppet is above 30 fashions this skill requires nothing to use.

abilities.description: Find out what the health and mana of your target is.
abilities.detail: Through your puppet, you may see the health and mana of your target.

abilities.description: Strip someone's defences.
abilities.detail: This ability will strip a defence from your puppet's namesake.

abilities.description: Lock up the muscle system of your victim.
abilities.detail: Paralyse the nervous system of the victim.

abilities.description: Break both the arms or both the legs of someone.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may break both the arms or legs of your victim.

abilities.description: Choke the life out of your victim.
abilities.detail: As long as the puppets living twin is in the area you may wrap your fingers tightly around your puppets throat, and watch in joy as its likeness asphyxiates.

abilities.description: Induce a sense of extreme bravado in your opponent.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you'll cause your victim to think he or she is always on full health.

abilities.description: Tickle the feet of your puppet.
abilities.detail: By tickling the bottom of your puppet's feet, you will cause your victim to laugh convulsively.

abilities.description: Set them ablaze.
abilities.detail: Set your victim alight!

abilities.description: Make them bleed.
abilities.detail: Cause blood to begin pouring from the pores of your unlucky opponent.

abilities.description: Instantly travel to your target.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may cross a continent to travel to your victim.

abilities.description: Sorry, say that again?
abilities.detail: Twist and contort the tongue of your puppet, making them utterly tongue-tied! For as long as they remain tongue tied, they will be unable to cure the stuttering affliction by any means.

abilities.description: Break all the limbs of some unlucky victim.
abilities.detail: Break all the limbs of a victim.

abilities.description: Make a victim obey your orders.
abilities.detail: Command your victim to perform a specific action.

abilities.description: Make a victim move in slow motion.
abilities.detail: Slow the movement of your victim through time.
abilities.required: 20 fashions, 10 used (1 if speed defense is stripped)

abilities.description: Damage your target's internal organs.
abilities.detail: Push your fingers sadistically into the gut of your victim, damaging their torso in the process. Sometimes this damage is enough to cause them to no longer be able to eat.

abilities.description: Rob your victim of some of his senses.
abilities.detail: Blackout some of the senses of your opponent, temporarily.

abilities.description: Summon your victim to you.
abilities.detail: Summons your puppet's model to you, providing he is in the same area or an adjacent room.

abilities.description: Tie up your hapless opponent.
abilities.detail: Tie up a victim through your puppet.

abilities.description: Hear talking through your target's ears.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you'll be able to hear anything anyone who is in the room with your victim says.

abilities.description: See the inventory of your target.
abilities.detail: See the possessions in the inventory of your victim.

abilities.description: Prick your target to make them sick.
abilities.detail: Imbibe a venom directly into the bloodstream of your puppet's model with a pin. You must have a vial of whatever venom you wish to imbibe with in your inventory.

abilities.description: Viciously mangle one of your victim's limbs.
abilities.detail: Though breaking someone's limb is certainly painful, mangling it is far worse.

abilities.description: Give your victim a concussion.
abilities.detail: An extremely potent affliction, the concussion gives one afflicted with it amnesia every second.

abilities.description: Leech the experience from your victim.
abilities.detail: This interesting and useful ability will allow a Puppetmaster to leech experience from a victim who is in a hunting party. What it essentially does is give experience to the Puppetmaster as if he or she was a part of the hunting party that the victim is in.

abilities.description: Fashion faster than ever before.
abilities.detail: With TRUEFASHION, you have achieved a level of skill whereby sometimes you can get two fashions in the time it normally takes to get one.

abilities.description: The greatest oak sprouts from a tiny seed.
abilities.detail: This ability is the basis upon which all other reclamation abilities are built. You may reclaim a room for nature, which will be the first of many. You may only perform most reclamation abilities in a room you have reclaimed unless otherwise stated. This ability takes concentration to perform in most cases, although it will be quicker in forests and instantaneous if in your grove. You may only reclaim one room in this way at a time. In addition, attempts to exterminate a room that you have reclaimed shall first remove your claim upon it, before damaging nature; a powerful asset indeed.

abilities.description: Sometimes one must retreat to advance.
abilities.detail: Sometimes, one must retreat if they wish to claim a greater prize at a later date. This ability will allow you to release your claim on any locations that you may have reclaimed.

abilities.description: Slowly but surely.
abilities.detail: Once you have begun reclaiming a location, you may expand on your network by performing this ability adjacent to a room you have already reclaimed. The restrictions are similar to reclaiming a room with the reclaim ability, although you may reclaim as many rooms in this way as you are able.

abilities.description: Know the extent of your control.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to view all of the locations you have reclaimed, as well as any active effects that may be operating on those locations.

abilities.description: You are everywhere at once.
abilities.detail: You may cross the distance between yourself and someone standing in one of your reclaimed locations in a single step, providing you are also standing upon ground you have claimed. This ability will be blocked by the presence of a monolith sigil or similar.

abilities.description: The vines will scourge their flesh.
abilities.detail: Those who walk within your claimed land will be lashed by the vines, causing damage and some bleeding.

abilities.description: Send them into slumber.
abilities.detail: Your network is now capable of producing spores that when inhaled, shall cause the unfortunate individual to become very tired. Poison, sleep, refresh spores and pollen are all mutually exclusive.

abilities.description: The wind tells many secrets.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to hear any word that is spoken aloud in your reclaimed locations.

abilities.description: Nothing can be hidden from you.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point where you are able to immediately determine the locations of any that walk upon your reclaimed land.

abilities.description: Knowledge is power.
abilities.detail: While active, you will know whenever someone moves in or out of locations reclaimed by you.

abilities.description: A far less gentle fate.
abilities.detail: These spores are far more deadly than simple sleep spores, and will cause the victim to suffer if they are unfortunate enough to inhale them. Poison, sleep, refresh spores and pollen are all mutually exclusive.

abilities.description: The flesh of the fallen shall nourish nature.
abilities.detail: Your network is now able to consume the corpses of any that fall within its bounds, expanding outwards from the location that they fell if it is able.

abilities.description: Restrain those that trespass.
abilities.detail: You may command the vines to bind someone in place, but it will rob them of their energy for a time, and will be unable to bind a second person in that given location for a while.

abilities.description: Nature will always recover.
abilities.detail: Those locations that have been exterminated by the foul necromancers are truly a blight upon nature. If you discover such a location adjacent to your network, you may regrow it, healing the damage and claiming the land in a single stroke. Alternatively, if you lack any network at all, you may do this to begin claiming one.

abilities.description: Choke the life from them.
abilities.detail: This potent pollen will enter the lungs and throat of those that inhale it, asphyxiating them. Poison, sleep, refresh spores and pollen are all mutually exclusive.

abilities.description: Let no transgression go unpunished.
abilities.detail: Your mastery has reached such a point that you will be made aware whenever anyone is attacking one of your reclaimed locations with abilities such as necromancy exterminate.

abilities.description: Rob the flames of oxygen.
abilities.detail: When standing within your reclaimed network, you may cause the vines to smother any flames that may have sprung up, extinguishing them all immediately across the entire expanse of your reclaimed land.

abilities.description: The most benign of spores.
abilities.detail: The most benign of the spores your network can produce, these will heal the physical body of those that inhale them. Poison, sleep, refresh spores and pollen are all mutually exclusive.

abilities.description: Two is better than one.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your training where you are able to support two active effects on your network at once. This ability does not permit you to have two spore type abilities active at the same time.

abilities.description: All will become one.
abilities.detail: This powerful ability is situationally one of the greatest in the reclaimer's arsenal. If your reclaimed land meets another's (two rooms become adjacent to one another) and the reclaimer of the other land is a mutual ally, you may subsume his or her land and make it part of your own network. To do this, you must stand on the room that is adjacent to your network that they have reclaimed and perform the ability.

abilities.description: Perfect control is yours.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your training where you are able to support three active effects on your network at once. This ability does not permit you to have two spore type abilities active at the same time.

abilities.description: Over your dead body.
abilities.detail: This ability will grant a defence that will prevent any room you are standing in from having your claim stripped from it.

abilities.description: Breathe life back into the fallen.
abilities.detail: While standing on your reclaimed ground, you can breathe life back into the corpse of a fallen adventurer.

abilities.description: Return them to the embrace of nature.
abilities.detail: When standing in a reclaimed location, you may have the vines tear apart a suitably vulnerable enemy. For the purposes of this ability, suitably vulnerable requires that the target has both arms and both legs at least damaged to the point of needing the restoration salve to fix them.

abilities.description: The wrath of nature unleashed.
abilities.detail: This ability is maybe the greatest and most costly of all. When all else is lost, you may sacrifice all land that you have reclaimed, dealing significant damage to all those that stand within. A terrible sacrifice indeed, but sometimes the advancing foes must be stopped at all costs.

abilities.description: Ability to destroy runes.
abilities.detail: With this ability you may remove (smudge) a rune from yourself, the ground or from a totem, assuming that your skill in Runelore equals or exceeds that of the one who originally sketched the rune. Smudging a totem or slot on a totem for any totem not owned by you will take longer, and may potentially notify the totem owner or owning organisation of the attempt.
abilities.syntax: SMUDGE <totem> / SMUDGE <totem> SLOT <1-6> / SMUDGE GROUND [rune] / SMUDGE <rune> OFF ME

abilities.description: Sketch runes with expert precision.
abilities.detail: The art of sketching mystical runes.

abilities.description: A rune to inspire fear.
abilities.detail: Inspires fear in an enemy who enters and sees it. It will disappear after one use, unless it is on a totem. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes a target with 20% mana or less. Empower effect: delivers impatience.right|frameless|24px|alt=KENA

abilities.description: Heal your allies with earth magic.
abilities.detail: Heals you and your allies.right|frameless|24px|alt=URUZ

abilities.description: Causes sleeping urges.
abilities.detail: This rune will cause someone to fall asleep when they see it, or remove insomnia or the kola defence. It will disappear after one use unless it is on a totem. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes someone missing the insomnia affliction or who is prone. Empower effect: puts a person to sleep if they are missing the insomnia defence. Does not strip kola or similar. right|frameless|24px|alt=FEHU

abilities.description: Attack the mental reserves of your enemies.
abilities.detail: When sketched on the ground or on a totem, it attacks an enemy's mana when he or she encounters it. Disappears after one use, unless it is on a totem. Won't affect blind people. When sketched upon a weapon, it enables the weapon to occasionally drain mana from a target. This will only apply if the weapon is a runeblade.right|frameless|24px|alt=PITHAKHAN
abilities.syntax: SKETCH PITHAKHAN ON GROUND/<totem> / SKETCH PITHAKHAN ON <weapon>

abilities.description: A rune to increase the vitality of the bearer.
abilities.detail: While the rune lasts, this will increase the bearer's strength and constitution by 1.right|frameless|24px|alt=JERA

abilities.description: A rune with the ability to paralyse.
abilities.detail: Paralyses an enemy who enters and sees it. Disappears after one use unless it is on a totem. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes a paralysed target. Empower effect: gives one stack of the cracked ribs affliction.right|frameless|24px|alt=INGUZ

abilities.description: Upon encountering this, an enemy's sight will be returned.
abilities.detail: Returns sight to an enemy who encounters it. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes a target who is shivering. Empower effect: your foe will suffer damage based on how many cracked ribs they have.right|frameless|24px|alt=WUNJO

abilities.description: Add an element of bleeding to your strategem.
abilities.detail: A runeblade possessing this rune will inflict more bleeding when striking an enemy.right|frameless|24px|alt=LAGUL

abilities.description: Damages the health of enemies.
abilities.detail: This will damage an opponent who sees it. It will disappear after one use, unless on a totem. It will not affect deaf people. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes a limb that is damaged (i.e. in the process of needing a restoration application to heal it). Empower effect: gives healthleech. If any fracture afflictions are present on your target, they will immediately relapse their associated symptom afflictions.right|frameless|24px|alt=SLOWULU

abilities.description: A rune of protection from damage.
abilities.detail: As long as it lasts, this grants a reduction by 10% of all damage types to the adventurer.right|frameless|24px|alt=ALGIZ

abilities.cooldown: 4.00 seconds of balance symbol=Flurry of Lightning Bolts
abilities.description: A rune to call shockwaves to take your enemies off balance.
abilities.detail: When sketched upon the ground, this rune calls forth a rumbling from the earth to unbalance your enemies. This requires they either be not levitating or afflicted with either the lethargy or weariness afflictions. If they are levitating and not afflicted, the levitation defence will be stripped instead of the disruption to their balance. Additionally, you will be able to enhance your abilities with an empowered weapon, allowing you to prevent enemies from fleeing your grasp. This must be used in conjunction with the engage ability in Discipline, and requires an Isaz rune be sketched upon the ground(*). * This requirement is removed if you possess an Isaz rune in configuration upon your runeblade. In configuration: Attune condition: your engage prevents escape, or an isaz rune you have sketched upon the ground disrupts the balance of one of your enemies. Empower effect: delivers epilepsy. right|frameless|24px|alt=ISAZ

abilities.cooldown: Carve cooldown: 2.00 seconds of balance Stand cooldown: 4.00 seconds of balance Smudge cooldown: 4.00 seconds of balance upon initiation and completion
abilities.description: The symbol of the master of Runelore.
abilities.detail: Totems are a very powerful runelore skill. After you've carved a totem, you may sketch runes on one of 6 slots on a totem. You may then STAND TOTEM, to prop the totem up, and all enemies who enter the room will be affected by -each- rune on the totem, going from rune #1 to rune #6. In order to carve a totem, you will require 20 wood commodities, 10 leather commodities, and 2 silver commodities. In order to remove a rune from a totem, simply SMUDGE <totem> [SLOT 1-6] (the slot 1-6 is optional). You may also smudge runes on the ground, with SMUDGE GROUND. You may only smudge runes that were sketched by someone with equal or lesser skill in Runelore. Runes that you may sketch on totems: Kena, Fehu, Pithakhan, Ingut, Nairat, Tiwaz, Wunjo, Sowulu, Mannaz, Sleizak, Loshre
abilities.syntax: CARVE TOTEM / SKETCH <rune> ON <totem> ON SLOT <1-6> / STAND TOTEM / SMUDGE <totem> [SLOT 1-6]

abilities.description: This rune will heal afflictions from you at random.
abilities.detail: Use earth magic to cure you of what ails you.right|frameless|24px|alt=DAGAZ

abilities.description: This rune will increase the blunt protection of armour.
abilities.detail: Increases the blunt protection of armour.right|frameless|24px|alt=GEBU

abilities.description: A rune to increase the cutting protection of armour.
abilities.detail: Increases the cutting protection of armour.right|frameless|24px|alt=GEBO

abilities.description: Drawing on the power of the earth, raise a stone wall.
abilities.detail: This rune will cause a wall of stone to rise up from the ground, blocking the progress of all who would travel that way. If a stonewall already exists in the specified direction, Gular will instead destroy it.

abilities.description: Summon a spiritual steed to bear you home.
abilities.detail: After sketching the rune upon the ground, say 'ride home' from anywhere on the continent, and be taken back to the rune, which will be destroyed. RAIDO LOCATE will show the location of your existing raido rune, if any. RAIDO SEVER will remotely smudge your existing raido rune, if any. Note: The northern areas only accessible through the wilderness are treated as a separate continent. right|frameless|24px|alt=RAIDO
abilities.syntax: SKETCH RAIDO ON GROUND / SAY RIDE HOME / RAIDO LOCATE / RAIDO SEVER

abilities.description: Call forth a spout of molten lava from the earth.
abilities.detail: When sketched upon the ground, this rune calls forth a spout of molten lava to injure a target. It fades shortly after use. It will also prevent rooms that it is sketched in from being flooded for a time.right|frameless|24px|alt=THURISAZ

abilities.description: Further punish your foe.
abilities.detail: When disemboweling with a runeblade possessing this rune, the damage will be magnified on those suffering internal trauma to a significant degree. Alternatively, when sketched on an empowered blunt weapon, that weapon will occasionally inflict a numbing effect upon your opponent's arm.right|frameless|24px|alt=LAGUA

abilities.cooldown: 3.00 seconds of balance symbol=Ball of Ice
abilities.description: Call down a hailstorm around you.
abilities.detail: When sketched upon the ground, this rune brings a hailstorm down upon your enemies. It fades immediately upon use. When sketched upon a weapon, this rune provides some chance that the weapon will deliver an additional burst of hail damage when it strikes. To sketch it upon a weapon requires the weapon to be a RUNEBLADE.right|frameless|24px|alt=HUGALAZ
abilities.syntax: SKETCH HUGALAZ ON GROUND / SKETCH HUGALAZ ON <weapon>

abilities.description: Sketch more than one rune on the ground.
abilities.detail: You have mastered the ability to coordinate three separate earth magics within the same space.

abilities.description: Suck the nourishment from your foes.
abilities.detail: This destructive rune is unique in that it functions differently under certain conditions. When sketched in a magically flooded location(*), it will cause the water to be drained away immediately, consuming the rune in the process.
