When sketched out of water it will persist, and will suck the nourishment from your enemies standing in the room. * Nauthiz is special in that it can be sketched even through water.right|frameless|24px|alt=NAUTHIZ

abilities.description: Return hearing to a victim.
abilities.detail: Returns hearing to an enemy who enters and sees it. Disappears after one use unless it is on a totem. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes a target off focus balance. Empower effect: delivers manaleech. If they are already inflicted with manaleech, delivers a timed affliction which disables all mana regeneration instead.right|frameless|24px|alt=MANNAZ

abilities.description: Besiege your enemies with multiple spouts of molten lava.
abilities.detail: When sketched on the ground, this rune shall erupt three times in quick succession. Each eruption shall destroy prismatic barriers, then magical shields, or do damage if neither is present to all of your enemies in your location.right|frameless|24px|alt=OTHALA

abilities.description: Afflict a foe with the horrible voyria poison.
abilities.detail: Will infect someone with voyria if he or she sees it upon entering a room. Disappears after one use unless it is on a totem. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes a weary or lethargic target. Empower effect: delivers nausea. If they are already afflicted with nausea, delivers voyria instead. right|frameless|24px|alt=SLEIZAK

abilities.description: This rune will remove the defenses of your enemies.
abilities.detail: Strips away a defence of any enemy who enters and sees it. It disappears after one use, unless it is on a totem. When sketched upon the ground, it may also be empowered against a target in the sky or trees above, and will draw them back down to your level. In configuration: Attune condition: your target is off restoration salve balance and has no limbs in need of said restoration application. Empower effect: breaks both of your target's arms.right|frameless|24px|alt=TIWAZ

abilities.description: Provides health regeneration to the bearer.
abilities.detail: Gives health regeneration to the bearer of the rune.right|frameless|24px|alt=BERKANA

abilities.description: A rune to entangle.
abilities.detail: When sketched upon the ground or on a totem, an enemy will be entangled upon seeing this rune. It will disappear after one use unless it is on a totem. When sketched upon a weapon, this rune causes the weapon to FREEZE its target at random. To sketch it upon a weapon requires the weapon to be a RUNEBLADE.right|frameless|24px|alt=NAIRAT

abilities.description: A powerful vibration-dampening rune.
abilities.detail: When sketched upon the ground, this rune will dampen non-protected crystalline vibrations. When sketched upon a weapon, this rune will randomly mask the effects of venoms delivered by the weapon. To sketch it upon a weapon requires the weapon to be a RUNEBLADE.right|frameless|24px|alt=EIHWAZ

abilities.description: Bind your runes to your body.
abilities.detail: You have reached a high degree of sympathy with earth magic, allowing you to bind runes to your body for longer than ever before.

abilities.cooldown: 4.00 seconds of balance symbol=Long Slim Blade
abilities.description: Increased damage to the limbs of your foe.
abilities.detail: When sketched upon a runeblade, the weapon will deal more damage to a target's limbs.right|frameless|24px|alt=LAGUZ

abilities.description: Empower armour with the strength of the earth.
abilities.detail: Calling upon the powers of the earth, you are able to empower any suit of armour upon which the runes gebo and gebu have been sketched. Empowering armour will render it usable only by he who empowered it, but it will bear the defensive powers of the runes of protection for one hundred months.

abilities.description: Runewardens may empower a weapon as a legendary runeblade.
abilities.detail: With your expert training in Runelore, you can craft any knight's weapon into a powerful Runeblade. First sketch Lagul, Lagua, and Laguz upon the blade. Then stand firm upon the earth and EMPOWER the blade. Empowerment of a weapon lasts for 100 Achaean months, during which time the Lagul, Lagua, and Laguz runes will not fade. In addition, a Runeblade may have one other rune (Pithakhan, Nairat, Eihwaz, or Hugalaz only) sketched upon it, enhancing its powers even further.
abilities.syntax: EMPOWER <weapon> / SKETCH PITHAKHAN ON <weapon> / SKETCH NAIRAT ON <weapon> / SKETCH EIHWAZ ON <weapon> / SKETCH HUGALAZ ON <weapon>

abilities.description: Cause an opponent to become afflicted with anorexia.
abilities.detail: Gives anorexia to those who see it upon entering. Disappears after one use unless it is on a totem. In configuration: Attune condition: your runeblade strikes an addicted target. Empower effect: delivers a timed affliction which, if the person eats ginseng or ferrum while labouring under, will drain their health and mana.right|frameless|24px|alt=LOSHRE

abilities.description: Combining runes about a central point.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your study of the runic script that you may now begin to sketch runic configurations upon your runeblade. Only certain runes can be sketched in configuration, and they must always be sketched about one of the core runeblade runes: Nairat, Hugalaz, Eihwaz, or Pithakhan. Runes sketched in configuration become attuned under certain situations, and when in such a state can be empowered(*). The runes that can be sketched in configuration and their attunement conditions are now listed in the relevant ability file for that rune. * Empowered runes fire their effects after a successful weaponmastery attack resolves: in the case of multiple hit attacks such as doubleslash or combination, they resolve after the entire attack has completed. ** Configuration conditions are only checked on the first hit of these multi hit attacks. Runewardens of the dual cutting or dual blunt specialisations should wield their configured runeblade in their left hand. *** You may set an empower priority to automatically attempt to empower runes as they become attuned.
abilities.syntax: SKETCH CONFIGURATION <runeblade/LEFT/RIGHT/WIELDED> <rune1> <rune2> [rune3] / SMUDGE <runeblade> <rune in configuration> / EMPOWER <rune> / EMPOWER PRIORITY SET <rune1> <rune2> <rune3> / EMPOWER PRIORITY CLEAR

abilities.description: Create a bond between your totem and the earth.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may take a totem, and make it into a semi-permanent fixture, mainly for defensive purposes. Once you begin the implanting process, it will take quite a bit of time, during which you may not do anything else. Once it IS implanted, however, no one will be able to pick it up, unless he has the ability to uproot a totem, which will take even longer than implanting it. Totems are automatically against the enemies of whatever entity owns them. When implanted, it will be tuned against your enemies. When designated, it will be tuned against the enemies of whatever the new owner happens to be (see AB RUNELORE DESIGNATE). Once claimed, organisationally-owned totems can be tuned against either the organisation's enemies or all but the organisation's members, and personally-owned totems can be tuned against either the owner's enemies or all but the owner's allies. This is the only way to clear the ownership on a totem.
abilities.syntax: IMPLANT TOTEM / UPROOT TOTEM / TUNE <totem> ENEMIES/NONALLIES (personal totems) / TUNE <totem> ENEMIES/NONMEMBERS (organisational totems)

abilities.description: Enable smudge reporting.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may empower any totem to report attempts to smudge any of its runes, or to uproot the totem proper. Empowerment has a small chance of fading every Achaean day that passes, after which it will cease reporting and must be re-empowered.

abilities.description: Arrange clear title and ownership.
abilities.detail: With this ability you may designate an owner for a specific totem. Only the crafter of the totem may use this ability. The totem remains owned by the crafter until the designated owner (or a member of the designated owner organisation) CLAIMs the totem. If the totem is claimed, then the designated owner becomes the true owner. If the totem is rejected, then the crafter remains the owner. At that point the crafter may attempt another designation as desired. Houses, Cities, Orders, Oakstone, and individuals may own totems - clans may not. When you designate a totem, its tuning is automatically set against the enemies of the new owner.
abilities.syntax: DESIGNATE <person> AS OWNER OF <totem> / DESIGNATE ORDER OF <deity> AS OWNER OF <totem> / DESIGNATE <organisation> AS OWNER OF <totem> / CLAIM <totem> / REJECT <totem>

abilities.description: As relentless as the storm.
abilities.detail: While wielding an edged runeblade of some form with the hugalaz rune sketched upon the blade, you may attempt to bisect your foe with a single empowered strike(*). * This is a multi damage typed ability that deals first lightning damage then cutting damage. ** If your target is an adventurer and at 20% of their health or lower when the cutting damage would be applied, they will be slain outright instead. *** Notably, this attack bypasses auras of rebounding and reflections but leaves them intact.

abilities.description: Battle waits for no one.
abilities.detail: When you wield a runeblade with a configuration upon the blade, usually it takes a short while for the runic configuration to become active. However, the true master of runelore has learned to adapt him or herself to a change in the flow of battle and to turn this to their advantage: thus, when swapping from runeblade to another runeblade in your primary hand of a different type(*), you may eliminate this delay entirely(**). * Going from say, a scimitar to a battleaxe or flail to a morningstar would let you skip the delay in a runic configuration becoming active. Going from a scimitar to a scimitar would not. ** You may only adapt once every 10 seconds or so.

abilities.description: Ambience is everything.
abilities.detail: Craft a scene for all in your location to witness(*). * Creates an illusion. You may embed up to one newline with \n.

abilities.description: Once upon a time...
abilities.detail: To tell a tale, to spin a yarn, to bring to life a story of long gone days. The teller of great sagas of the past knows the power in such things, and so tell them you shall. Each saga will have multiple stages. All sagas will do something upon being completed, and some will do things at other points in the tale as well. Consult each saga for specifics upon the nature of your grand design.

abilities.description: You'll never believe what I heard...
abilities.detail: The art of storytelling is one step removed from the art of conversation, and as a master of both, sometimes you just need to get your message out there in a less obvious way. By seeking out various establishments(*), you can, around once an Achaean day, spread some gossip. Similarly in said locations, you may also listen for gossip every so often, and in such a way gossip is bound to spread. * Inns and similar, generally.

abilities.cooldown: 3.00 seconds of equilibrium and 8.00 seconds of voice balance
abilities.description: No, this is how it went.
abilities.detail: Every storyteller knows there is just that one person who has to be the centre of attention even when they've just got nothing worthwhile to say. Clearly, anything you have to say is far more facinating than such lesser tellers of tales, and now you will prove it! You may countermand any saga that you know being told by another, having a chance to completely interrupt their flow and aborting it before it can reach a grand culmination(*). * You are not guaranteed to succeed. You can increase your chances through various means, but never to a hundred percent.

abilities.description: Delay the conclusion.
abilities.detail: Masters of storytelling gain the ability to delay the conclusion of a tale for dramatic effect. Using this ability will recite another tale up to its culmination, at which point the completion will be delayed. The tale may be completed for the next 5 minutes instantly at the cost of 3 seconds of balance. This will incur a cooldown of 5 minutes. No tall tales can be completed in this way.

abilities.description: Where ever the story takes you.
abilities.detail: A good storyteller must go where ever the tale may take them, though equally it is true that some legends just don't hit as hard when constantly on the move. You may now move while performing many of your sagas for an audience, them no longer being interrupted if your location changes between recite stages(*). * Channeled sagas are excluded.

abilities.cooldown: 20.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Flee the falling star
abilities.detail: The coming of the Morning Star is a tale of destruction and terror. At its recital, those beasts of burden that are nearby will have a glimpse of that dread event, and will flee in panic at its knowing. * Makes mounts panic and run about until soothed.

abilities.cooldown: 2.50 seconds of equilibrium and 20.00 seconds of voice balance
abilities.description: Arcanum undone.
abilities.detail: The Tale of the first Reckoning one is of wizards and warriors, dragons and despots, triumph and victory: but at its core it is a tale of magic, and its thwarting. When you complete this grand tale, all icewalls, firewalls, and lightwalls in your location will be undone, destroyed in an instant.

abilities.description: The freezing waters came.
abilities.detail: Though the coming of the freezing waters which ravaged Cyrene was a thing of horror and liberation both, it was the dreadful silence left in the aftermath which will forever weigh upon those that were there to witness that darkest day in the history of the Heart of the Vashnars. * Conveys a short lived silence effect upon the room.

abilities.cooldown: 2.30 seconds of balance and 16.00 seconds of voice balance
abilities.description: When dream turns to nightmare.
abilities.detail: The power of dreams is one so frequently underestimated, and perhaps no tale tells this so clearly as that of the jade icon. For a time after this retelling, any attempt to put someone to sleep in the location will still succeed, but the one who would seek to impose said slumber shall suffer in their turn(*). * Afflicts anyone who gives the sleep affliction to another with a mental affliction.

abilities.description: Of great escape and glory.
abilities.detail: The tale of Haidar, the Lion, is one of arts reclaimed and more: and yet at its core it is a tale about escape. As you recite this saga, each time you reach another section of the tale, you will free yourself from various attempts to entangle your person.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: To take the power for One's own.
abilities.detail: A story of theft and of power, of taking and of subversion, the sagas of the Divine Child will bring forth a shifting field of absorption in your location. Periodically it will shift, and all damage to your allies of a given type will become impossible until it shifts once more. * The shifting cannot be controlled.

abilities.cooldown: 1.50 seconds of balance and 16.00 seconds of voice balance
abilities.description: And no sun did shine.
abilities.detail: The tale of Slith's attempt to bring an Eternal Night upon Achaea is one which has spellbound many a listener over the years. Indeed, the story is so entwined with the act of focus that your listener, each time they hear the next lines of the tale, will be healed of any other attempts to transfix them under which they may labour.

abilities.cooldown: 2.30 seconds of balance and 16.00 seconds of voice balance
abilities.description: Empire's wrath unleashed.
abilities.detail: A tale of peaceful approach turned to brutal war, the retelling of the Vertan Empire's coming can end only one way. You may recite this Saga while focused upon someone nearby and outdoors(*), and at its culmination meteors shall descend to shatter the magical shields of said individual and all who stand alongside them. Note that once the retelling begins, even if the target flees, so long as they remain outdoors the meteors shall still fall upon them, no matter how far they might flee(**). * Nearby for this purposes is within the same local area. ** Within reason. Crossing planar boundaries or similar may prove too much, even for the glory of Vertan's Empire retold.

abilities.description: And so the dead did stir and...
abilities.detail: The tale of the Magisterion is a grim one, and one inexorably tied in with the Underworld and the lord who once ruled there. When reciting it, your retelling will destroy necromantic constructs(*), though a necromancer being present will require much more effort to overcome(**). * On the first tick with no necromancer present, gravehands are destroyed. On the second tick gravehands are destroyed even if a necromancer is present. On the third tick, infestation maggots are destroyed. ** If a necromancer (Oppression users count as necromancers for the purposes of this ability) is present, this recital is a channeled action.

abilities.description: The oceans ran as blood.
abilities.detail: A tale of disruption and corruption, the day the seas ran red with blood is one wrought by Baelgrim's hand. By retelling that grim tale, water's wrath may be made manifest upon all who hear, and they will suffer its disruption(*). * Water disruption is a timed affliction that causes you to lose some mana when you sip health elixirs or similar.

abilities.cooldown: 2.50 seconds of equilibrium and 18.00 seconds of voice balance
abilities.description: All things controlled.
abilities.detail: The tale of the Genesis is one inexorably intertwined with that of the Tsol'teth, and the terrible deeds they wrought upon the overland in their relentless quest to realise divinity. When speaking this tale, the first two sections of the story shall normalise any reverberation vibrations present in the location, and at the last, any retardation vibe that might be present will succumb to this crushing power.

abilities.cooldown: 15.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Betrayal most foul.
abilities.detail: This tale is one of agreement, but more, one of the most profound betrayal. All that hear it shall know an echo of that most dread choice, and will be struck down with the betrayal affliction for a time. * All afflicted with betrayal have a chance to consider anyone an enemy in a given moment, or an ally as no ally at all. Note that this does not in fact modify either ally or enemy lists in the process.

abilities.cooldown: 25.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.80 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Of renegades and sorrow.
abilities.detail: There was fire and fury a plenty on that day when the renegade host descended upon the city of Targossas, and so this recounting conveys. Upon its conclusion, everyone in the location will be cleansed of a random affliction which afflicts them, excluding the one you are reciting the story to and yourself. Then, the unfortunate subject of your grand recital will be inflicted with damage based on the number of afflictions cured from the audience.

abilities.cooldown: 20.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: The Hero made Divine.
abilities.detail: The Saga of Haskor is one of many battlefields, but through it all runs a single golden thread: Heroism. Speak the saga of Haskor, and all mutual allies that hear your tale will fall under the mantle of your heroism, defended against death so long as you stand. Beware, though. If you fall... the day is dark indeed. * For around half a minute after this saga takes effect, your allies protected by said saga will never know death by the hands of other adventurers so long as they stand with you. However, if you perish, all who heard it shall fall with you as well... ** There is a cooldown of five minutes on using this ability, and it is apparent to all when it is activated.

abilities.description: The day when Death did die.
abilities.detail: A tale of tragedy and long held grudges, the Endbringer's Demise is a story with only one inevitable and indefatigable conclusion. Reciting this solemn recounting to a listener will take all of your focus, and yet upon its final word they shall be cast from this life and into those Halls that Thoth once did rule. * Bypasses all forms of special resurrection such as starburst. The target immediately embraces death upon being slain. ** This is a channeled action which resolves faster the more stacks of the crescendo affliction are present on the target when you begin the recital.

abilities.description: From beyond the flow of time.
abilities.detail: There are many tales of the enigmatic Imperator who sits the Infernal Throne and the dread power at his command. By speaking this story into the world, that first great foe overcome by the Imperator shall be broken, and all timewells in your location and adjacent shall be shattered. * This is a channeled action.

abilities.description: To give everything and more.
abilities.detail: This solemn tale is one of greatest sacrifice, and giving up of one's self so that others may survive. If you speak this tale over where another fallen adventurer did make their final stand(*), upon its completion they will be resurrected, but you will be cast into the Halls of the Finality immediately(**). This tale can only be told so often, and takes all of your focus(***). * You must recite this saga in the room where an adventurer fell. Their corpse is not required, but they must currently be dead. ** You will immediately embrace death and you will leave no corpse behind. *** This carries a thirty minute cooldown upon success and is a channeled action.

abilities.description: Annihilation.
abilities.detail: There is no saga so dire and no tale so terrible as that of He who cast down Gods and broke the world in His coming. The dread power of Bal'met may be gone from Creation, but in this harrowing recital can a sliver of the knowing of that impossible foe be made manifest. Though it will take all of your focus(*) to recite, at the culmination of this recounting all damage in the location will become unblockable for a short time. This affects all present: enemy, ally, and the one who gave voice to this most terrible of tales. * This is a channeled action.

abilities.description: Cloak your location in blackest night.
abilities.detail: Create a magical darkness to completely enshroud your location.

abilities.description: Forge weapons from the shadows that surround you.
abilities.detail: The very shadows shall come together to form your blade. You may manifest both a dagger and scythe, which will be utilised for different abilities that you shall learn as your abilities improve. If you already have either a dagger or scythe in existence, performing this ability shall summon it back to you, rather than creating a new one. Note that for the initial manifestation, you must be surrounded by magical darkness.

abilities.description: Your foes are wheat before the storm.
abilities.detail: This powerful attack with your scythe deals high damage but is somewhat slow.

abilities.description: The shadows are your voice and more.
abilities.detail: When standing in a location cloaked in magical darkness, you may project your voice so that all those who also stand in said darkness may hear you, regardless of distance or boundaries.

abilities.description: The cloak of power from ancient lore.
abilities.detail: The cloaks of power were a secret known only to the Tsol'teth Overlords of ancient times. While wearing this cloak, you may perform many of the more mysterious of the shadow abilities. Additionally, the cloak shall grant you protection from various forms of attack.

abilities.description: Take to the sky upon a surge of shadows.
abilities.detail: Your power over the shadows has reached a point that you may manifest wings, allowing you to take to the sky.

abilities.description: Melt away into the darkness.
abilities.detail: While wearing your cloak, you may draw the shadows in about your person. When leaving a location shrouded in magical darkness, the direction you left in has a chance to be hidden.

abilities.description: You shall not suffer obstructions.
abilities.detail: Command your shadow to rend asunder any magical shields that your opponent may have raised as protection. If they lack a shield and you append KNEEL to this command, their own shadow shall turn against them, knocking them to the ground at your feet. You must be wielding a manifested dagger to carry out this ability. * Note that if your target is knocked prone this ability incurs a longer balance recovery.

abilities.description: A prison for the fallen.
abilities.detail: The true masters of the art are able to contain the shadows of those they vanquish in battle. However, even they require a receptacle of sufficient power to store the shadows, and thus the phylactery was conceived. To create a phylactery, you must stand within a darkened room and possess six bone and two silver commodities. The phylactery must be forged from an organic substance to retain its power, and wood has been found to lack a sufficient lifespan. If you were to lose your phylactery, you may RECALL it at any time from anywhere through your bond with it. Note that due to this bond, only you will be able to utilise your phylactery, and you will be unable to utilise a phylactery created by someone else. Finally, you may LIST those shadows that you have currently bound within your phylactery. You may only store a given number of shadows within the phylactery, so choose wisely. Note that you can RELEASE a shadow at any time, if you deem it no longer worthwhile to retain it.
abilities.syntax: PHYLACTERY CREATE / PHYLACTERY RECALL / PHYLACTERY LIST / PHYLACTERY RELEASE <shadow>

abilities.description: The might of the Overlords directed through your weapon.
abilities.detail: It is said in ancient times the Tsol'teth Overlords were capable of directing the greatest of the shadow abilities with no more than a gesture. Alas, such total mastery has been long since lost. Now a medium is required to channel such powers, and weapons manifested from shadow are more than satisfactory for such a purpose. When you instill a weapon with one of the powers, striking an individual with that weapon shall cause the power to effect them alongside the blow. See the relevant ability files for each instill for details of what shall befall the unfortunate victim. Note: the curare venom and depression/madness instillations cannot exist upon the same weapon at once. You may also SHADOW INSTILL <weapon> WITH NOTHING to remove all previously-instilled powers.
abilities.syntax: SHADOW INSTILL <weapon> WITH <power> / SHADOW INSTILL <weapon> WITH NOTHING

abilities.description: Attack their physical capability.
abilities.detail: This instillation of a weapon shall cause the target to be afflicted with progressively more debilitating afflictions. It shall first afflict them with clumsiness, then weariness, and finally paralysis. If they suffer from all of the afflictions, it shall deal non-trivial damage(*). * The damage is significantly less if you do not have the target attuned, and halved if you do not possess the target's shadow within your phylactery.

abilities.description: Coat a weapon in venoms.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may layer venoms on an edged weapon. Each time that weapon hits somebody, one venom will poison your opponent, and disappear from the weapon. They work on a last-on, first- off basis, so if you put xentio on a weapon, and then put voyria on, the voyria would come off first, and the xentio second. You must have the selected venom in a vial in your inventory. In order to get rid of the venoms on a weapon, simply WIPE <weapon>.

abilities.description: Good help is hard to find.
abilities.detail: You may now separate yourself from your shadow for a brief time, and have it convey items to other adventurers. Your shadow can reach anyone on the same continent as you, or anyone standing within magical darkness. This latter case even functions across planes of existence, so is formidable indeed.

abilities.description: Your onslaught shall claim them all.
abilities.detail: A reaping blow with the scythe, that forsakes damage for superior speed.

abilities.description: Turn their focus inward.
abilities.detail: This instillation causes your foe to become depressed. Depression is a curse created by an ancient Tsol'teth Overlord, and its danger is in its long term effects. For each phobia or madness that the victim suffers from, they will suffer in both body and mind when the symptoms manifest themselves. Note that if the subject already suffers from depression, this instillation shall give nausea, then hypochondria, and finally, if all other afflictions are present, both anorexia and masochism simultaneously.

abilities.description: Bring the fight to you.
abilities.detail: Summon forth a vortex of shadows to suck in all adventurers from adjacent locations.

abilities.description: There shall be no salvation.
abilities.detail: The instillation of retribution is a powerful one indeed. First, it shall strike down your enemy with justice. Then, it shall deliver the curse of retribution. If both are present, it shall burn away some of the victim's mana reserves. For each of depression, retribution, madness, and parasite that are present, the amount of mana drained is increased. Retribution was a curse created in the early days of Tsol'teth experimentation as a method by which they could overcome those foes with far greater capabilities than their own. It fell out of use after the individual might of the Tsol'teth reached such a point as to be unrivalled. Whenever one afflicted with the retribution curse drinks a mana elixir, they shall find that their physical body suffers for half as much mana was restored.

abilities.description: A minor mercy.
abilities.detail: Sometimes, you may wish to prove a point without necessarily killing your foe. In the event of such an eventuality, you may sever their shadow, leaving them grievously injured but alive. This shall add their shadow to your phylactery, but unlike other methods they shall survive the ordeal. Note that this ability takes some time to complete during which you may not be interrupted, and requires the use of a shadow dagger.

abilities.description: None are beyond your reach.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to cross a great distance to a given target in an instant. A monolith sigil on either end of the movement shall prevent the attempt. Note that if you possess a shadow of the target in your phylactery, you may cross the distance whether they stand within magical darkness or not. If you do not, they must be standing in magical darkness and must be within the same area. Note that each phylactery-empowered step to a non-mutual ally shall have a chance to destroy the shadow stored within your phylactery.

abilities.description: The shadows tell you all.
abilities.detail: While standing within magical darkness, you may form a connection with all other locations shrouded in a similar form, determining anyone that stands within said shadows.

abilities.description: Insanity is a torture all its own.
abilities.detail: This instillation shall bring down the curse of madness on your victim. This particular curse causes the unfortunate subject to be periodically afflicted with a random phobia; additionally, it doubles the recovery time of focus attempts, and significantly increases the mana cost. If this instillation strikes someone already afflicted by madness, they will suffer vertigo, then hallucinations. If all three afflictions are present, they shall be stunned.

abilities.description: They shall sustain you.
abilities.detail: While wielding a manifested dagger of shadows, you may plunge it into the shadow of your foe, leaching away some of their mana(*) and adding it to your own. *This does increased mana drain for each of DEPRESSION, RETRIBUTION, and SHADOW MADNESS present.

abilities.description: Grant respite to a former foe.
abilities.detail: You may release the shadow of someone from your phylactery, fully healing the health and mana of the owner where ever they may be. Note that this has a long per target cooldown.

abilities.description: Perceive the state of another's mental strength.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may see how much mana an adventurer has.

abilities.description: Minor alterations can have major repercussions.
abilities.detail: By attuning a person's shadow, you will cause them to be periodically afflicted. Attuning to madness gives periodic phobias and insanities; attuning to degeneration gives afflictions that will hinder the target. Attuning requires the use of a manifested dagger.

abilities.description: Their weakness is your strength.
abilities.detail: The leaching instillation was conceptualised to allow Tsol'teth warriors to fight on and appear tireless and implacable. The first strike of this instillation delivers the fabled parasitic curse. If parasite is already present, the subject is struck down with healthleech; if both are present, they are afflicted with manaleech. Finally, if all afflictions are present, you shall claim the very shadow of your foe with your strike. The parasitic curse will cause all natural regeneration(*) to be given to you instead of the afflicted subject. * This does not include regeneration from tattoos.

abilities.description: Cloak your movements to the paramount degree.
abilities.detail: While wearing your cloak, you may invoke this highest of the shadow evasion abilities. You will be so hidden as to not appear on alertness or similar detection methods. At the time of your choosing, you may EMERGE from the shadows.

abilities.description: Beyond all recognition.
abilities.detail: If you hold someone's shadow within your phylactery, you may shred it with a manifested dagger, causing significant health and mana damage to the unfortunate soul. This will cause you to lose their shadow from your phylactery. You may also apply a venom in the process. Unlike other phylactery-related abilities, they must be in your location for you to do this.

abilities.description: The shadows are your dominion.
abilities.detail: The greatest demonstration of your might over the masses manifests through this ability. With nothing but your mastery over darkness, bring down blackness upon an entire area, cloaking every location within in magical darkness. Be warned, all standing in the area will be warned of the impending darkness before it falls.

abilities.description: You will take it all away.
abilities.detail: With a victim's shadow held within your phylactery, you may take of that which is their province and make of it your own. Strength: for the next thirty seconds, your unnatural strength will permit you to surpass simple physical realities, striking with your scythe even when paralysed. Speed: for the next fourty seconds, your reap and cull abilities will be somewhat faster, though they will deal somewhat less damage as well. Years: for the next thirty seconds, each time you land a blow on your victim and they survive the assault, you will steal of their years and restore your youth if needed. * Only one assimilation bonus may be in play at once, and they only apply against the target you used the shadow of to instigate the process. ** Consumes the shadow upon use.

abilities.description: Death is but a word away.
abilities.detail: The ultimate expression of your power, this ability allows you to command a person's shadow to execute your sentence. If a target is below 40% of their maximum mana, you may carry out this ability, having their shadow act as their own executioner. The threshold raises for 5% for each of depression, madness, retribution, and parasite that are present on the target. Note that successfully slaying your foe with this ability will also claim their shadow, providing that you possess a phylactery with sufficient room remaining.

abilities.description: Switch to a new school of study.
abilities.detail: If you wish to return to your previous studies of Tekura, you may do so. Your progress in the arts of Shikudo shall be remembered and you may return to the Shikudo school later if so desired. Switching costs 100 lessons and may only be done once every 24 hours.

abilities.description: Combine attacks to devastate your foes.
abilities.detail: By combining attacks together you can perform devastating combinations against your foes. Shikudo combinations may consist of no more than three attacks, only one of which may be a kick. For instance, you could COMBO GATTAN'BAHAR DART HEAD LIVESTRIKE FLASHHEEL LEFT (we do not recommend doing this to Gattan'bahar).

abilities.description: A highly defensive form.
abilities.detail: The forms of Shikudo are the backbone of the art. You can only be in one form at a time, though you may flow between the forms at opportune moments, once you further your studies. Many of the Shikudo strikes may only be performed in certain forms, and each form conveys its own set of benefits upon the practitioner. The Tykonos form is primarily a defensive form, and you will find yourself able to divert damage more easily when in this form.
abilities.syntax: ADOPT TYKONOS FORM transitions=Willows Shaken by the Wind attacks=THRUST, SWEEP, RISINGKICK

abilities.description: The most basic of strikes.
abilities.detail: The most basic of strikes, deliver a thrust to a limb with your staff. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: Hold fast to your staff against all odds.
abilities.detail: By gripping tightly with your hands, prevent your staff from being knocked out of your hands.

abilities.description: Brush aside the shields of your foes.
abilities.detail: Smash magical shields with a single blow of your staff. This ability is unique among all Shikudo techniques in that it can be performed in the flow of any one of the forms.

abilities.description: A form which emphasises speed.
abilities.detail: Willows Shaken by the Wind is the Shikudo form which emphasises speed. All Shikudo strikes and kicks performed in this form shall be faster than normal, and you will be so fast that you may even knock arrows out of the air as they seek you, providing you are wielding your staff.
abilities.syntax: ADOPT WILLOW FORM transitions=Willows in Rain Storm attacks=DART, SWEEP, HIRU, FLASHHEEL, HIRAKU

abilities.description: A swift strike to snap bones.
abilities.detail: Sacrificing damage, you may deliver a swift thrust to a limb with your staff. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: The true art of Shikudo.
abilities.detail: A kata is a series of strikes that chain together to form a greater whole. Each time you perform a strike or kick it becomes part of your kata. The primary benefit of kata chains is that once you have built a kata chain of sufficient length(*) you may TRANSITION TO THE <form> FORM, to immediately transition into that form(**). Transitioning will reset your kata chain. However, if you maintain a kata chain for too long (i.e. by staying in the same form overly long) you increase your chance of stumbling and failing your kata. This is catastrophic for the Shikudo practitioner, as it not only resets your kata chain but also puts you completely out of your current form and back into the basic Shikudo form (Tykonos). This can be the moment when fights are lost. The Tykonos form is exempt from this, as the technique is specifically designed to be able to maintain a kata chain indefinitely. Naturally, it is a far more limited form in terms of viable strikes or kicks due to this fact. * A kata chain of sufficient length is a chain consisting of at least 5 actions. ** Note that you can only transition in this way to forms listed as valid transitions for that form (see AB <form> for valid options). You must of course also have studied that form in Shikudo.

abilities.description: A swift kick to damage joints.
abilities.detail: The joints are the most vulnerable part of a limb. By targeting the knees with this kick, you will be able to break said limb with a single blow, crippling your foe. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: A high kick targeting the head or torso.
abilities.detail: This high kick can be aimed at the head or torso. If aimed at the head of a prone opponent, it shall stun them for a short time. Likewise, if aimed at the torso of someone suffering internal trauma, it shall also stun them.

abilities.description: A prone opponent is at their most vulnerable.
abilities.detail: Using your staff, you may sweep someone off their feet. Note that this consumes both of your arm balances, so may not be combined with other strike attacks (though it may be combined with a kick). Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: Some people simply talk too much.
abilities.detail: Aim a strike at the face of your foe with your staff, shattering teeth and making it impossible for them to eat(*). If they are also prone, they will be stunned for a short time. * They will be afflicted with anorexia and stuttering.

abilities.description: Countless drops to conquer mountains.
abilities.detail: The form of Willows in Rain Storm is an offensive form, but reliant on repeated strikes rather than powerful blows. You may perform kata chains of twice the normal length when in this form before risking stumbling out of form, and as said kata chain grows longer the damage you deal shall increase. Additionally, your equilibrium recovery shall be significantly increased when in this form.
abilities.syntax: ADOPT RAIN FORM transitions=Tykonos, Live Oak attacks=RUKU, KURO, HIRU, FRONTKICK

abilities.description: Rattle their skull with a strike from your staff.
abilities.detail: Deliver a blow to your foe's head with your staff. This will give them dizziness; if they are prone, it may also afflict them with confusion.

abilities.description: Numb the ribs or arms with a swift blow from your staff.
abilities.detail: Aiming blows at the arms or torso of a foe can have various effects. If you target the arms they will become numbed, ruining motor control and afflicting the target with clumsiness (or healthleech if the target already has clumsiness). If you strike the ribs of your foe, you'll inflict enough pain that they will begin to sweat profusely, afflicting them with slickness.

abilities.description: Bring them down to the ground.
abilities.detail: This straight kick may be targeted at either arm, arming to strike the vulnerable nerve clusters just below the shoulder. The blow is powerful enough that it will throw the target off their feet if it connects, proning them. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: A lower strike to numb the legs.
abilities.detail: By targeting the muscles in your foe's legs, you may weaken them severely, afflicting said target with weariness. Should your foe already suffer from the weariness affliction, the blow will render them lethargic.

abilities.description: Unbent, unbroken.
abilities.detail: The form of the Live Oak is based around dealing powerful blows. All Shikudo strikes and kicks performed during this form shall do increased damage.
abilities.syntax: ADOPT OAK FORM transitions=Willows Shaken by the Wind, Gaital attacks=LIVESTRIKE, NERVESTRIKE, RUKU, RISINGKICK, KURO

abilities.description: Rob them of breath with a single blow.
abilities.detail: A powerful thrust aimed at the solar plexus, this staff attack will rob your target of breath, delivering asthma. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: Deny them control.
abilities.detail: A precise strike to the side of the neck with your staff will paralyse your foe, leaving them unable to act. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: The deceptive form of legend.
abilities.detail: While in this deceptive form your instinct will guide you to such a degree that your foe will have no hope of predicting your attacks. Indeed, your skill will be so great that your attacks shall simply slide through attempts to parry them.
abilities.syntax: ADOPT GAITAL FORM transitions=Willows in Rain Storm, Unrelenting Storm attacks=NEEDLE, SPINKICK, SWEEP, RUKU, FLASHHEEL, KURO, JINZUKU, DAWNKICK

abilities.description: The death of a thousand strikes.
abilities.detail: The Sentaari masters of old could strike someone with minimal force but with major results. Indeed, many enemies that these grandmasters would encounter would find themselves incapacitated without a single bone broken or drop of blood spilled. By appending LIGHT after a staff strike in a combination, that attack shall not deal any limb damage, but the health damage and affliction shall still be delivered (if applicable). Note that this only applies to staff attacks, you may not deliver light kicks. An example: THRUST LIGHT HEAD, NERVESTRIKE LIGHT, etc.

abilities.description: Rob them of breath.
abilities.detail: A precision strike against the throat, you may crush someone's windpipe with a single thrust of your weapon. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: A crushing kick backed up by momentum.
abilities.detail: This powerful kick will strike a target's torso if they're on their feet or their head if they are sprawled upon the ground. In the event you strike your foes head, they will take significantly more damage.

abilities.description: As inexorable as the rising Sun.
abilities.detail: This powerful kick targets the head, and can be performed against both a prone foe and a standing one. When it lands, it will cause their brain to be rattled and for them to see stars for a time(*). If they are prone, this effect lasts longer and the damage is higher(**). * Shortly after this kick lands, the target will be afflicted with epilepsy. ** If they are prone, they will be afflicted again a short time after the first time they receive epilepsy.

abilities.description: A form of death.
abilities.detail: The form of the Unrelenting Storm is the most rarely taught of the Shikudo Forms, as it is both exceptionally difficult to master and intended for primarily one purpose: to deal with those who can only be dissuaded by death. All Shikudo strikes and kicks that successfully deal damage(*) shall generate Kai energy when in this form, providing you are within the meditative state granted by a Kai Trance. Additionally, the more kai that you possess, the higher your resistance to damage will be. * Attacks that are parried or otherwise blocked will not generate Kai energy.
abilities.syntax: ADOPT MAELSTROM FORM transitions=Live Oak attacks=RUKU, RISINGKICK, SWEEP, CRESCENT, LIVESTRIKE, JINZUKU

abilities.description: A single opportunity is enough.
abilities.detail: By hyperfocussing upon a specific limb, you will be able to identify gaps in your target's defence, avoiding all attempts to parry strikes against that limb. However, focus of this nature comes with a cost: though you will be able to bypass parry attempts, your strike on the hyperfocussed limb shall only deal half as much damage to that limb as normal.

abilities.description: A sharp thrust to the kidneys.
abilities.detail: This swift strike to the kidney's will instill a craving in your target, causing them to become addicted to the consumption of curatives. Note that this ability along with all other Shikudo strikes and kicks must be performed in a combination. See AB SHIKUDO COMBO for details.

abilities.description: The deadly Kai-enhanced kick.
abilities.detail: This kick may only be performed against a foe who lies prone. If that foe has half their health or less, your Kai-enhanced kick shall slay them instantly; if they do not, they will manage to dodge this kick, in which event your recovery time shall be greatly increased. Upon launching this kick you shall immediately flow into the Tykonos form, so it is wise to be certain of your target's demise before committing.

abilities.description: Beware an angered Shikudo practitioner.
abilities.detail: Though much of the Shikudo style is based upon not delivering fatal blows, sometimes there are few other options. If your foe is prone with a damaged head and windpipe, you may dispatch them with a single blow of your staff, ending their life instantly. In the event that you believe that death is not necessary, you may instead INCAPACITATE your foe, stunning them for a great length of time rather than ending their life. Note that this ability is unique among the Shikudo strikes: it is performed outside of a combination and may be used regardless of your form. You may also specify a form when carrying out the act, which you will immediately flow into if your dispatch is successful, regardless of any other limitations.

abilities.description: Rigorous training yields a toughened physique.
abilities.detail: Your budding control over your body will assist you in weathering the storm of life by increasing your constitution by one point.

abilities.description: Your bladework reaches new heights of potency.
abilities.detail: By augmenting your reflexes with shin energy, you will reach such a degree of skill with the blade that you are able to deflect blows aimed at your limbs, even when prone. ** This ability is used in conjunction with the parry ability.

abilities.description: Control your breathing to resist choking attacks.
abilities.detail: This ability will grant a short-term immunity from anything doing asphyxiation damage. However, any offensive activity or consumption of balance or equilibrium will cause you to begin breathing once again.

abilities.description: Sink into a reverie of battle.
abilities.detail: Swordplay and Striking are supremely graceful arts, the fury of bloodshed tempered by rhythm, control, and prowess. Entering the Shin trance, you may sensitise yourself to the cadence and flow of combat, accumulating Shin energy with every strike you land upon a foe. Successfully channelling this energy is essential in order to unleash many of the advanced Shindo, TwoArts, and Striking techniques. The more powerful your opponent, the more Shin energy you will gain from striking them. Shin energy will slowly dissipate over time.

abilities.description: Surveil from the shadows.
abilities.detail: From the ground or in the trees you may attempt to shadow an adventurer in an adjacent location. If you are not detected, you will enter their location unseen and begin to follow them.

abilities.description: Find others throughout the land.
abilities.detail: A useful benefit of the intense training of body and mind inherent to the practise of Shindo is an increased sensitivity to the latent telepathic powers all mortals possess. By honing your focus, you may detect the location of other adventurers.

abilities.description: Will silence upon the world.
abilities.detail: Through force of will, you may block out all sound, rendering yourself deaf.

abilities.description: Restore aural sensation.
abilities.detail: No trauma may deprive you of your hearing should you wish otherwise. Concentrate, and the sounds of the world will return.

abilities.description: Render your eyes unseeing.
abilities.detail: Meditating upon the Void, you may will your eyes to cease their function, blinding yourself.

abilities.description: See the world anew.
abilities.detail: You have sufficient control over your body to instantly repair your eyes when blinded.

abilities.description: Vision in darkness as in light.
abilities.detail: The dark of night is no barrier to your trained eyesight.

abilities.description: Brace yourself with Shin energy.
abilities.detail: Once so bound, any Shin energy accumulated beyond the maximum you may store will invigorate your body, sparking a renewal of health.

abilities.description: Deny them escape.
abilities.detail: With the ability to block exits, you cut off the chances for your cowardly opponent's to flee your blade.

abilities.description: Strengthen your body against assault.
abilities.detail: By increasing the density of your skin, you are able to decrease the amount of damage you will take from physical cutting attacks.

abilities.description: Weave and dodge missiles.
abilities.detail: Heightening your reflexes, you may sense and avoid many projectiles.

abilities.description: Elude attacks from the air.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to dodge attacks from the air.

abilities.description: Stand steadfast against acts of force.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: Vault over obstacles.
abilities.detail: Walls, rubble, and other impediments are no longer a problem to one with your training. What you cannot get around, you may go over.

abilities.description: Withstand the foulest of poisons.
abilities.detail: By stirring your circulation, you may prepare yourself to shrug away the next poison that enters your bloodstream. As venoms are so wide in variety, such a state of readiness requires the whole of your focus; performing any action will end your immunity.

abilities.description: A crude release of force.
abilities.detail: Shin energy is a source of power both pliant and potent. You may unleash a measure of this energy upon a target in a crude but damaging burst of raw force. This attack will bypass, but not destroy, magical shields and prismatic barriers, and does more damage against both prone opponents and those suffering a damaged head(*). * These bonuses both stack with one another, but with diminishing returns.

abilities.description: Fly across the ground.
abilities.detail: Sprinting in a particular direction, you may rapidly cover a great distance.

abilities.description: Dance over the waves.
abilities.detail: So swift are your footsteps that water will not part beneath your feet, permitting you to glide across the surface.

abilities.description: Behold no deception.
abilities.detail: Those who would hide in the shadows cannot escape your well-trained eyes and ears. Your increased awareness may also see the truth behind magical illusions, although the chances of detecting this type of artifice are less reliable.

abilities.description: Know of all who approach.
abilities.detail: Reaching out with your every sense, abilities heightened by rigorous mental training, you may become aware of the comings and goings of others nearby. Such concentration will be a constant burden on your mana reserves.

abilities.description: Maintain awareness at all times.
abilities.detail: Such is your iron will that you may cling to consciousness where lesser minds would fail.

abilities.description: Heal your wounds with Shin power.
abilities.detail: Releasing Shin energy inwardly, you may instantly mend wounds and restore your body. The more energy accumulated, the more you may transmute in this feat of regeneration.

abilities.description: Fortify your mind with Shin power.
abilities.detail: Allowing Shin energy to focus your thoughts and elucidate your mind, you may instantly replenish your mana reserves. The more energy accumulated, the more you may transmute in this way.

abilities.description: The sky is within your reach.
abilities.detail: So powerful are your legs that you may leap high into the sky, briefly eluding gravity's grip. Beware that you lack the control to move about while up in the air.

abilities.description: Fury given fiery form.
abilities.detail: Sparked into flame by inner fury, you may release the unbridled might of your accumulated Shin energy in a flood of flames that will scorch all within reach. So forceful is this burst of heat that others may be flung from the location. Focus and control are essential in performing this advanced technique, lest you yourself succumb to the fire.

abilities.description: Unleash a galvanic surge of power.
abilities.detail: As the storm releases its might through crackling bolts of lightning, so may you channel Shin energy into a savage electrical assault upon all in the vicinity. The galvanic forces released are likely to jangle the nerves of those struck.

abilities.description: Quench your foes with a storm of ice.
abilities.detail: Through a secret Shindo technique familiar only to masters of the art, you may draw the heat from the air around you into yourself. Manipulating the resultant freezing atmosphere into a shearing blizzard, you may scourge all nearby with lashes of ice, freezing them and destroying any heat vibration that might be present at your location. In addition, once your power leaves your control, it shall settle in the location, forming a temporary obscuring snowstorm.

abilities.description: Leap great distances in but one soaring step.
abilities.detail: Launching yourself skywards, you may briefly soar through the air in a particular direction, bypassing the adjacent location, and any obstacles within, and landing in the location beyond.

abilities.description: Your strength becomes another's frailty.
abilities.detail: The potent forces of Shin energy can prove crippling to the uninitiated. By directing them upon an opponent, you may weaken your foe for a time, sapping their strength and dexterity.

abilities.description: Your focus is without compare.
abilities.detail: This state of mind allows you to sink into a trance-like state, granting you abilities normally beyond your capabilities. Even the greatest modern day practitioners of shindo can only maintain this state for a short time, and there is a significant recovery period before it is safe to once again enter the trance. While meditating, you will gain access to the ability to evade past walls and other barriers, as well as being immune to the power of runic totems that may have been bound to the earth.

abilities.description: Reach out with your mind to touch others nearby.
abilities.detail: Scouring the surroundings with your well-honed senses, both physical and mental, you may detect the presences of all adventurers within the local area.

abilities.description: Alone against the horde.
abilities.detail: By enhancing your battle instincts with shin energy, they can become asclose to perfect as a mortal warrior can aspire to. Though this is of little benefit when meeting foes in single combat, when facing armies all but your primary adversary(*) shall find that your sense of danger is so profound that any attacks they direct against your person may be evaded outright(**). * The first person to hit you will never miss. This resets every 5 seconds if they have not hit in that time. ** All subsequent single target attacks from other adventurers have a chance to miss you outright. This does not work against ranged abilities, and you must be relatively unhindered for it to work.

abilities.description: Rebirth through cleansing flame.
abilities.detail: Kindling Shin energy into purifying flames, you may immolate yourself in a display of perfect mastery over both your body and the art of Shindo. Purified by fire, your form will be renewed, cleansed almost all ailments and afflictions. This feat requires and will consume a full reserve of Shin energy.
abilities.required: Shin Energy Required: 80 Shin Energy Consumed: All

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: The ability to throw an axe such that it will return.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow your axe to return to your hand when thrown. It can target adventurers and denizens in room, but only adventurers in line of sight.
abilities.syntax: THROW HANDAXE AT <target> / THROW HANDAXE <direction> AT <target>

abilities.description: Knock an unruly foe to the ground.
abilities.detail: While wielding a spear or trident, you may knock an opponent's legs out from under him. A swift follow-up strike with the point of the weapon will ensure he won't want to stand up any time soon.

abilities.description: Use an axe to pull someone in from a nearby room.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to bring someone in another room to you by throwing your axe at them.

abilities.description: Sending a hapless victim crashing to the forest floor.
abilities.detail: While in the trees, you may shove an adventurer to the ground, possibly breaking his legs.

abilities.description: Shatter an opponent's shield.
abilities.detail: With expert precision, you may shatter an opponent's shield with a well-aimed thrust of a spear or trident.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: The most basic of skirmishing attacks.
abilities.detail: This is a basic thrust with a spear or trident.

abilities.description: Set up a defensive shield with a spear or trident.
abilities.detail: At the cost of a large endurance drain, you may spin your spear or trident in such a way as to cause you to automatically deliver an attack to anyone attacking you physically. You will cease spinning the spear as soon as you do anything aggressive, or when you do STOP.

abilities.description: Grabbing unwary victims from the forest floor.
abilities.detail: While in the trees, you may seize an adventurer and bring him up to your level.

abilities.description: A good woodsman checks his path.
abilities.detail: This ability will grant a defence which shall allow you to see past obstructions with abilities such as GLANCE or SQUINT from the vision skill.

abilities.description: Coat a weapon in venoms.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may layer venoms on an edged weapon. Each time that weapon hits somebody, one venom will poison your opponent, and disappear from the weapon. They work on a last-on, first-off basis, so if you put xentio on a weapon, and then put voyria on, the voyria would come off first, and the xentio second. You must have the selected venom in a vial in your inventory. In order to get rid of the venoms on a weapon, simply WIPE <weapon>.

abilities.description: Impale attackers on a spear or trident.
abilities.detail: By bracing your spear or trident on the ground, you will attempt to impale anyone initiating an attack in an adjacent room that ends in your room. For instance: barge, jumpkick, etc. The very unlucky victim will take damage until he or she writhes off the spear or trident, but, you will not be able to move as long as the person is impaled on your spear or trident.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: There is no defence against your onslaught.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to rive through protective defences, then deliver a followup blow. If both the shield and rebounding defences are present, the second blow shall target the second of these defences rather than dealing damage.

abilities.description: Mesmerise them with your flawless skill.
abilities.detail: You may ensnare the gaze of a prone opponent with your flawless skill with your chosen weapon. This shall cause them to be transfixed if the blindness defence is not present; otherwise it shall strip the blindness defence. Note: your target must be prone.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Let them bleed for their foolishness.
abilities.detail: This slicing attack with your chosen weapon aims to inflict maximum bleeding, as well as delivering a venom and the haemophilia affliction if your target is an adventurer.

abilities.description: Slice through the defences that would protect your foes.
abilities.detail: This ability with your chosen weapon will allow you to randomly strip a defence from an enemy. It shall always target defences in this order: prismatic barriers, reflections, mass, then a random defence. * Note that it strips all reflections at once, not just one.

abilities.description: Rattle their brains with a blow to the head.
abilities.detail: This ability will knock a prone and transfixed target unconscious. The more health your victim is missing, the longer they shall remain unconscious for. This duration is also increased if a rattle follows within ten seconds of a skullbash, their brains being sufficiently scrambled already.

abilities.description: Truss them up for slaughter.
abilities.detail: You can truss up an unconscious opponent. These bindings take much longer to escape than standard bonds.

abilities.description: Split their skull with a mighty blow.
abilities.detail: Deliver a powerful blow to the head of an opponent. Against adventurers, this requires that your target be prone and the damage of this attack will be increased based on how damaged the target's head already is. When targeted against a denizen, this attack will deal damage, assuming they lack the vitality to properly dodge your strike(*). * This attack deals vastly reduced damage against denizens unless they are below 33% health.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Lay them open with a precision strike.
abilities.detail: This attack with your chosen weapon causes significant bleeding as well as the weariness affliction, if used against an adventurer.

abilities.description: Drive your blade straight through your target.
abilities.detail: This wicked ability may be used when your hapless victim has fallen to the ground and lies there, helpless. With it, you will drive your spear/trident into his body, causing regular damage as long as he is on the weapon. Further, while impaled, he will find himself unable to move, though you too will be unable to move.

abilities.description: Drag away your prey.
abilities.detail: You may drag someone you have impaled away. (This will remove your spear or trident from your victim's gut.)

abilities.description: Chivalry is a construct of the city dwellers.
abilities.detail: You may now craft barbs to attach to your chosen weapon. This will occasionally cause the wounds you inflict to be torn open to a greater degree, decreasing the effectiveness of attempts to clot the injuries.

abilities.description: Gut them like a fish.
abilities.detail: You may wrench your weapon if an opponent is impaled upon it, causing terrible internal damage.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Strike, then strike again.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may use your chosen weapon to deal a lateral slash, then using the momentum continue your attack to strike with the haft of your weapon. Against adventurers, the blow with the haft shall first deliver impatience. If the target is already impatient, it shall deal epilepsy. Against denizens, your damage will be split amongst the slice of your weapon and strike of its haft.

abilities.description: Return them to the embrace of nature.
abilities.detail: Once you have petrified an enemy, you may take your spear and shatter their stone body into myriad shards, ending their life and returning their remains to the embrace of nature.

abilities.cooldown: Attune: 4.00 seconds of balance Unattune: 2.00 seconds of balance Unbind: 2.00 seconds of balance Unbind all: 2.20 seconds of balance
abilities.description: Commune with the spirits.
abilities.detail: By communing with a spirit, you may bind it to yourself. This will grant you some of the powers that that particular spirit possessed during its life. You may bind up to five spirits at once. You may also attune yourself completely to a spirit. This will grant additional benefits, although you may only attune two spirits at a time. Once you have mastered the spiritual arts in their entirety, you may attune three spirits at a time. Communing requires a ritual drum, which can be purchased from most general stores around Sapience.
abilities.syntax: COMMUNE / SPIRIT BIND <spirit> / SPIRIT ATTUNE <spirit> / SPIRIT UNBIND <spirit>|ALL / SPIRIT UNATTUNE <spirit> / SPIRIT BINDINGS

abilities.description: Daina, The Viridian.
abilities.detail: By channeling the power of nature, you are able to drive diseases from your body with greatly increased efficiency.

abilities.cooldown: 5.00 seconds of balance attune=An increased capability to dodge attacks.
abilities.description: Jhulian, The Nomad.
abilities.detail: The spirit of Jhulian, The Nomad will allow you to travel to a mutual ally, given a short delay.

abilities.cooldown: 3.00 seconds of balance attune=Increased mana regeneration.
abilities.description: Arius, The Druid
abilities.detail: Once you have bound the spirit of Arius, The Druid, you will be able to channel the mighty power of the hydra to unleash a terrible roar at your opponent, disrupting their mental equilibrium. When targeted against denizens, it will do damage and cost equilibrium rather than balance.

abilities.cooldown: 2.00 seconds of balance attune=The tumble ability will have a reduced balance.
abilities.description: Silvanix, The Fool.
abilities.detail: The skilled jester has deft wits and defter hands, and Silvanix was no exception. By binding his spirit, you will be able to snatch arrows from the very air.

abilities.cooldown: 3.50 seconds of balance attune=Increased health regeneration.
abilities.description: Ri'shen, The Master.
abilities.detail: One who has mastered the practices of kaido is able to restore their body from almost any injury. While the power granted to you through the connection with Ri'Shen is not to that level, it will allow you to perform lesser feats of regeneration.

abilities.cooldown: 2.00 seconds of balance attune=Curses will drain a small amount of health and mana from the target.
abilities.description: Maligus, The Cleric.
abilities.detail: The practitioners of Apostasy have long been feared for their mastery of unholy powers, and Maligus in life was no exception. Upon binding his spirit, you will gain the ability to forceably attune a vodun doll to the soul of an unfortunate subject, improving its detail potentially far quicker than would normally be possible. This ability will be more effective against those who lack mental fortitude. Additionally, various afflictions, listed from most impactful to least, improve the power of a soulrend if the victim suffers from them: manaleech, confusion, shyness, paranoia, dementia. This ability can be combined with curses. * The rend takes place before the affliction is delivered from a curse, so cursing manaleech and soulrending at once will not work. ** Note that with the exception of manaleech, if these modifier afflictions are masked they are 33% less impactful.
abilities.required: Invoke: 50 mana Curse: Invoke mana cost + curse mana cost.

abilities.cooldown: 2.00 seconds of balance attune=Increased resistance to asphyxiation damage.
abilities.description: Aspar, The Iron Handed.
abilities.detail: Alchemists know more about how to turn a body against itself than perhaps anyone else in Sapience. In life, Aspar was most feared for his ability to manipulate the sanguine humours of his enemies. By binding his spirit, you will be able to infect open wounds with disease, forcing the blood to clot but doing far more harm than good. Diseases which may be inflicted in this way are impatience, paralysis, asthma, slickness, anorexia, weariness, lethargy, and clumsiness. This ability is combinable with curses.

abilities.cooldown: 2.50 seconds of balance attune=A chance for swiftcurse charges not to be consumed when hunting denizens. It shall also reduce the willpower cost of the bleed curse against denizens.
abilities.description: Aelkesh, The Faceless.
abilities.detail: Aelkesh was an Occultist who lived during the period of heightened strife with the Church. He developed an ability to allow him to travel great distances to facilitate his escape in the event of danger, and while binding his spirit will not grant such mastery, it will allow you to fling yourself out of potentially fatal situations. Be warned, however it is far from accurate.

abilities.cooldown: 2.00 seconds of balance attune=Curses will inflict bleeding.
abilities.description: Teraile, The Swordsman.
abilities.detail: The skill of the practitioners of the legendary Two Arts can not be overstated. By binding the spirit of one of the long dead masters of this art, you will be able to lacerate the flesh of your enemies. This ability will cause the victim to gain the haemophilia affliction, there by removing their ability to clot their wounds. If your victim already has haemophilia, they will suffer bleeding. This ability may be combined with curses.

abilities.cooldown: 5.00 seconds of balance attune=Increased elemental damage resistance.
abilities.description: Arcanor, The Sorcerer.
abilities.detail: To fight on your terms as a mage is the first step toward victory. By binding the spirit of Arcanor, you will be able to invoke his power to summon great walls of ice to block the escape of all those who would flee from your wrath.

abilities.cooldown: 2.20 seconds of balance attune=Resistance to poison damage.
abilities.description: Syvis, The Venomous.
abilities.detail: The masters of venom have long been feared for their deception and cunning when it comes to the elimination of those that would cross them. By binding the spirit of this ancient assassin, you will be capable of causing diseases that your victim believes they have cured to relapse shortly there after. Be warned, you are no true master of the art. You may only perform this ability every so often. This ability must be combined with curses.

abilities.description: Marak, The Eviscerator.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to destroy a vodun doll to balancelessly activate one of the following vodun-based abilities on the target: confusion, dizzy, sleep, bind, paralyse, break, throttle, reckless, bleed, cripple, mangle, imbibe. The doll must be fashioned to twice the extent that the ability used would normally require. This ability must be comboed with curses.

abilities.cooldown: 3.50 seconds of balance attune=Immunity to the fear affliction.
abilities.description: Anthius, The Crusader.
abilities.detail: Anthius was one of the faithful Templars who sought out and eliminated those that would corrupt the sanctity of Creation. By channeling this spirit, you are able to unleash holy judgement at a heretic in an adjacent location. The spectral fires will scythe past magical defences, and will not be denied.

abilities.cooldown: Carve: 2.00 seconds of balance Smudge: 4.00 seconds of balance upon initiation and completion attune=Increased physical damage resistance
abilities.description: Garon, The Knight.
abilities.detail: While this spirit gives you sufficient knowledge to craft magical totems, you lack the knowledge required to etch them with runes of power. To this end, a different medium is required. To carve a totem, you will require 20 wood, 10 leather, and 2 silver commodities. Once you have obtained and implanted one into the ground, you may draw either a circle of binding or pain about its base. When an unfortunate enemy looks upon the totem empowered by such a circle, he shall find himself either bound in place or struck down by great pain, dependent on which circle has been drawn. Drawing a circle requires two black inks.
abilities.syntax: CARVE totem / IMPLANT <totem> / UPROOT <totem> / DRAW CIRCLE of <PAIN|BINDING> / SMUDGE TOTEM / SMUDGE TOTEM SLOT <1-6> / SMUDGE CIRCLE SURROUNDING <totem> / EMPOWER TOTEM / TUNE <totem> ENEMIES/NONALLIES (personal totems) / TUNE <totem> ENEMIES/NONMEMBERS (organisational totems)

abilities.description: Designate the owners of your tribal totems.
abilities.detail: With this ability you may designate an owner for a specific totem. Only the crafter of the totem may use this ability. The totem remains owned by the crafter until the designated owner (or a member of the designated owner organisation) CLAIMs the totem. If the totem is claimed, then the designated owner becomes the true owner. If the totem is rejected, then the crafter remains the owner. At that point the crafter may attempt another designation as desired. Houses, Cities, Orders, Oakstone, and ndividuals may own totems - clans may not. When you designate a totem, its tuning is automatically set against the enemies of the new owner.
abilities.syntax: DESIGNATE <person> AS OWNER OF <totem> / DESIGNATE ORDER OF <deity> AS OWNER OF <totem> / DESIGNATE <organisation> AS OWNER OF <totem> / CLAIM <totem> / REJECT <totem>

abilities.cooldown: 2.00 seconds of balance attune=You may move more rooms at once.
abilities.description: Tarnel, The Walker.
abilities.detail: The walkers of the forest know the value in snaring an unsuspecting victim. The prey that doesn't see the trap coming has its throat cut first. At the chance of breaking your bond with Tarnel, The Walker, you may bind an enemy. This invokation is very fast.

abilities.description: Kosuira, The Child Sorceress
abilities.detail: A protege in the art of Terminus, Kosuira learned much more of the art than any modern day Depthswalker. Though much of this knowledge is now out of reach, by tapping into her spirit you may bring down an invocation, freezing the ground in your location and doing similarly for all adjacent locations.

abilities.description: For the most desperate of times.
abilities.detail: The master practitioner can learn to slacken bonds to the point of breaking while in communion, and yet in a time of need draw them all back to full potence for a brief time, though with dire consequences. * Slackening a bond puts it into a dormant status, it keeps its attunement. You cannot have a slackened and active bond with the same spirit. * You can have as many slackened bonds as you can have active bonds and these limits do not impact one another, so you can have five active and five slackened for instance. * When you enkindle, all active bonds are severed and all slackened bonds are made active. After five minutes all bonds will be broken and you will be unable to commune for a further five minutes.
abilities.syntax: SPIRIT ENKINDLE / SPIRIT SLACKEN <spirit> / SPIRIT SLACKEN SOLIDIFY <spirit>

abilities.cooldown: 4.00 seconds of balance attune=Curses shall restore a small amount of health and mana.
abilities.description: Arayan, The Healer.
abilities.detail: The power of priests to heal their fortunate allies is legendary. Though you shall require a focus in the form of a vodun doll fashioned to at least 50 times, you will be able to channel this power.
