abilities.detail: While both Aeonics and Shadowmancy made the Tsol'teth terrible indeed, it was the art of Terminus that allowed them to perform many of their more cataclysmic feats of power. Terminus allows one to use the ancient Tsol'teth language to enact various outcomes; some are relatively minor, and some are near miracles in their scope. However, the knowledge of the Tsol'teth was guarded jealously, and no one person could learn it all. As you progress through the skill you shall gain access to various research trees that you may study. The more you study a tree, the more abilities you shall unlock. As you progress you shall also be able to study more trees, as your mental capacity shall expand to accommodate. Note: tier 1 through 4 abilities all cost one research point. Tier 5 abilities cost 2, though tier 5 abilities are not available until later in Terminus. You must be in an equipped Terminus lab to research trees - the only currently known lab is accessed through the MEMORY ability in Aeonics.

abilities.description: The acquisition of strength.
abilities.detail: You have now unlocked the hunting research tree. This tree has a focus on being able to defeat denizens more efficiently.

abilities.description: Who doesn't want to live forever?
abilities.detail: You have now unlocked the longevity research tree. This has a focus on abilities to make you heal yourself more efficiently, or to push the boundaries of what is possible in that capacity.

abilities.description: Only the best.
abilities.detail: You have now unlocked the augmentation research tree. This tree allows you to make improvements to the tools of Shadowmancy, among other things. Note that augmented items only function at their improved capacity while you retain knowledge of the requisite ability from this tree.

abilities.description: The world is your weapon.
abilities.detail: You have now unlocked the environmental research tree. This tree focuses upon manipulation of the surrounding environments, both for offensive and defensive purposes.

abilities.description: The might of the warlords.
abilities.detail: You have now unlocked the conquest research tree. This tree focuses upon ways to optimise confrontations between armies, and was a favoured branch by the Tsol'teth of old.

abilities.description: The mind is malleable.
abilities.detail: You are now able to purge your mind of progress in a given research tree. This will not remove your ability to access that tree, just any progress you have made in currently studying it. This has a 24 hours cooldown.

abilities.description: Master your chosen field.
abilities.detail: You are now able to complete your study of a research tree, learning it all the way to completion. Note that you may only master one research tree at this time.

abilities.description: The centre of your power.
abilities.detail: Your fulcrum is both a haven and staging point. By speaking this word of power you may mark a location; then you may return to it from anywhere. It is said the true Tsol'teth can cross both planar and continental boundaries. You are not so knowledgeable to accomplish such a task, so are confined to only being able to return to your fulcrum from the same continent and plane. Note that all fulcrums are purged at dawn, without exception. Not even the Tsol'teth were able to overcome this limitation, though the weakness was religiously guarded. Additionally, a fulcrum once placed cannot be changed until the next dawn, and you may only have one fulcrum in existence at a time. Choose wisely!
abilities.syntax: INTONE MORUDAI / FULCRUM STATUS / GO FULCRUM

abilities.description: True voice of the Tsol'teth.
abilities.detail: Your voice now possesses such power that your incantations can bypass even the power of the silence vibrations that magi may bring forth in their feeble attempts to thwart you.

abilities.description: Control, control, control.
abilities.detail: You have now unlocked the dominion research tree. Possibly one of the things that made the Tsol'teth so infamous was their ability to bend others to their will. This research tree was what permitted them to do so.

abilities.description: Mediocrity is unacceptable.
abilities.detail: Your mastery has reached such a point that you may now learn up to two research trees to completion, gaining the capstone ability of both.

abilities.description: Your precision is without compare.
abilities.detail: This word of power enhances your precision against denizens, raising your critical hits chance.

abilities.description: The first step is survival.
abilities.detail: This word of power shall convey a defence upon you that shall make you more able to resist the damage dealt by denizens.

abilities.description: Turn aside your foes.
abilities.detail: This word of power shall summon forth a prismatic barrier to protect you. This ability incurs an equilibrium cost in addition to the standard word balance cost.

abilities.description: You can take them all.
abilities.detail: Upon uttering this word, all denizens in your location shall immediately become hostile to you. This does not work against denizens loyal to other adventurers or organisations.

abilities.description: The weak of will shall serve your ends.
abilities.detail: You may intone this word of power at a denizen of the land, causing their sense of danger to be greatly inhibited. This allows you to exploit openings for a short time, doing increased damage with all scythe attacks.

abilities.description: Your blood is not for them to spill.
abilities.detail: This word of power conveys a defence that shall have a chance to entirely remove the willpower cost on an attempt to clot your bleeding.

abilities.description: A deeper trance.
abilities.detail: This word of power allows you to, while meditating, sink into a deeper trance and increase your rate of regeneration.

abilities.description: No wound can stop you.
abilities.detail: This word will fully restore your health, mana, willpower and endurance. Note that it may only be uttered once every 8 hours.

abilities.description: Twice is better than once.
abilities.detail: This ability will reset all of your tattoos, causing them to come off cooldown(*). This also restores up to 300 years of age. *It may only be used once every 8 minutes.

abilities.description: Why settle for worse?
abilities.detail: A truly potent ability, speak this word targeted at one who considers you a mutual ally. For the next thirty minutes you shall possess the same constitution and strength as your chosen target. * Note that this carries a one hour cooldown. ** Additionally note that this is a direct link. If your linked target's stats change while you are linked with them, your stats shall also change to mirror them.

abilities.description: A superior model.
abilities.detail: While holding a phylactery created via Shadowmancy, you may utter this word to enhance said phylactery, making it able to hold an additional five shadows.

abilities.description: You have certainly not lost your edge.
abilities.detail: By uttering this word over one of the respective weapons created via Shadowmancy, you may enhance its cutting edge, causing it to deal more damage against your foes.

abilities.description: Strike like lightning.
abilities.detail: By uttering this word over the respective weapon created via Shadowmancy, you may enhance its speed.

abilities.description: Yet closer to the elusive legend.
abilities.detail: Though the true cloak of the Tsol'teth overlords is far out of your reach, this word when uttered over a Shadowmancy cloak brings you yet one step closer. It shall improve the cloak so that, when worn, it shall grant you increased resistance to the destructive force of fire. In addition, one wearing an augmented cloak who performs the rebirth ability from Aeonics shall return with more health and mana than one without. The recovery time of the rebirth ability shall also be significantly reduced.

abilities.description: The greatest feat of augmentation.
abilities.detail: The greatest feat of augmentation is using your own body as your canvas. By augmenting your own skin, you shall become more resistant to both cutting and blunt attacks.

abilities.description: Let the water be no more.
abilities.detail: Speaking this word shall immediately dispel any magically summoned forth water in your location.

abilities.description: Snuff the flames with a single word.
abilities.detail: Speak this word and snuff a firewall in your location. Note that you may not choose which to destroy; this word of power is unpredictable.

abilities.description: A final strike.
abilities.detail: Summon forth a lightning strike against an enemy. They must be within three rooms of you and outdoors.

abilities.description: None stand above you.
abilities.detail: Speak this word and bring all that fly above you in the skies down to your level.

abilities.description: Let the ground swallow you up.
abilities.detail: Speak this word and let the ground swallow you up.

abilities.description: Cause pain with but a word.
abilities.detail: Speak a word and cause damage to all that stand in your location. Beware: this word is indiscriminate and will strike at you as well.

abilities.description: Heresy is not even the beginning.
abilities.detail: Speak this heretical word and the shrines of the divine shall become muted. Note that as your proficiency within the Conquest research tree increases, so too does your grasp of this word as follows: At level two, it impacts your current room. At level three, it impacts your current and adjacent rooms. At level four, it impacts your current room, adjacent rooms, and the rooms adjacent to those. At level five, it impacts your current room, adjacent rooms, the rooms adjacent to those, and the rooms adjacent to those. The cooldown and duration decrease and increase respectively as you increase in the research, though particularly in the case of duration these gains are much more minor than the other benefits conveyed. When worldburn is activated, the Trointeth cooldown on all shrines for that order is cleared.

abilities.description: It's not paranoia if...
abilities.detail: The sound of this word shall instill a madness in all who hear it, making them believe that anyone and everyone is an enemy.

abilities.description: Deny their salvation.
abilities.detail: With this word of power, you may shatter an ice or stonewall that bars your path, causing it to explode and deal damage(*) to all that stand on either side of it. Note that stonewalls shall cause more damage when they shatter. *This strips magical shields if one is present, but does no damage in cases where this occurs.

abilities.description: And thus, they fell.
abilities.detail: The power to tap the ancestral memories of the Tsol'teth line is one usually restricted to those of the true blood, but due to your studies you are now able to glance back a single generation. Speak the lamentation of deSangre, and all those that you see as allies shall be granted an enhancement truly terrible in nature. Whenever one under the effect of the lamentation slays another(*), they shall become stronger, faster, tougher(**). Due to the taxing nature of tapping the ancestral memories, this ability carries a fairly significant cooldown. * Killing an enemy does not reset the lamentation timer. ** Each kill grants them +1 to each stat and a balance/equilibrium bonus.

abilities.description: They have no choice in the matter.
abilities.detail: By targeting this word of power at one of the weak-willed, you can force them into following you around the land. Instantly obtain your army!

abilities.description: Your mind is your own.
abilities.detail: Speaking this word of power shall convey a defence upon you that shall prevent the next attempt to force you to carry out an action against your will from being successful.

abilities.description: Your grace is limitless.
abilities.detail: You have reached a sufficient level of proficiency that, with this ability, you will be able to target the gaiartha word of power at another, granting them its beneficial effects.

abilities.description: They shall do your bidding.
abilities.detail: This word of power shall allow you to command a subject to carry out a single action. Unfortunately, as this is a fairly temperamental word of power, it requires that the subject in question lack the deafness defence. Additionally, this word of power will consume equilibrium.

abilities.description: A power out of legend.
abilities.detail: One of the most feared power of the Tsol'teth Overlords was their ability to bend an entire battlefield to their will with nothing but the power of their voice. After mastering this research tree, that power is now yours. When you utter the litany and specify the command that you wish to dictate, all those that stand in your location or adjacent to it shall be forced to carry out that command. This ability both has a windup time and informs both your location and those adjacent when you begin to initiate it.

abilities.description: A scabbard is as important as one's blade.
abilities.detail: A properly positioned scabbard is integral in drawing one's sword with ease, grace, and power. Neglect your scabbard at your peril, for the First Art is useless without it.

abilities.description: Every sword is unique.
abilities.detail: Every sword has a name, just as every sword has an owner; the first step towards mastery of the Two Arts is to learn this. In order to gain your sword, seek out Kavaya near the Eastern Ithmia, east of the City of Delos.

abilities.description: A single, measured slash.
abilities.detail: Draw your blade and aim a single slash at your target before resheathing. With the Weaponry ability of TARGETING, this attack may optionally be targeted at a particular body part.

abilities.description: Clench your blade with an unshakable grip.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Strike true with the slow might of the Earth stance.
abilities.detail: Stance: Earth Ever steady underfoot, the Earth is a fixture of steadfast might. This strong, grounded stance favours sure strikes, granting a moderate increase to damage and accuracy at the cost of speed.

abilities.description: Cleave through defensive auras.
abilities.detail: With raze, your sword will become a weapon of destruction, attacking the defences of your enemies that serve to keep your weapons out.

abilities.description: Cut across the arms.
abilities.detail: Draw and slash your blade across the arms of your enemy from either left or right. Such an attack will strike both arms in immediate succession, the second with less force than the first.

abilities.description: Lash out at a cowardly foe.
abilities.detail: There is nothing more despicable and dishonourable than a coward, and this ability will allow you to punish cowards, as is their due. Once you have engaged an adventurer, if he is otherwise unhindered and tries to leave the room, you will get in an extra strike, whether you have equilibrium and balance or not. This ability may be initiated if off balance.

abilities.description: Quickly assess an opponent's wounds.
abilities.detail: With a keen and practised eye, discern the severity of any bleeding wounds your opponent may endure.

abilities.description: Slash across the legs.
abilities.detail: Draw and slash your blade across the legs of your enemy from either left or right. This horizontal attack will strike both legs in immediate succession, the second less powerfully than the first.

abilities.description: The whirling Wind stance neglects power for speed.
abilities.detail: Stance: Air Unceasing and all-pervasive, the Wind flows and soars invisibly and unpredictably. This graceful stance permits somewhat greater speed and accuracy of attack, but blows dealt will be significantly less powerful.

abilities.description: Drive your blade straight through your target.
abilities.detail: This wicked ability may be used when your hapless victim has fallen to the ground and lies there, helpless. With it, you will drive your sword into his body, causing regular damage as long as he is on the sword. Further, while impaled, he will find himself unable to move, though you too will be unable to move.

abilities.description: Carve up or down across the head and chest.
abilities.detail: Draw your blade and slash your enemy with a rising or falling vertical blow. This attack will strike your foe's head and torso in succession, depending on from which direction the blow comes, dealing less damage to the second area struck.

abilities.description: Drive your enemy back with a balanced slash.
abilities.detail: This powerful, measured blow will drive your target back, knocking them off-balance.

abilities.description: Wreathe your blade in crackling flame.
abilities.detail: By channelling accumulated Shin energy into your sword, you may heat your blade to a scorching temperature. A weapon so empowered will burn as fire the next time it is drawn, potentially setting your target ablaze. If a target is already ablaze, extra damage may be dealt. ** Your blade may only be infused with one element at a time.

abilities.description: Deliver a stunning blow with the hilt of your sword.
abilities.detail: Drive the pommel of your blade into your opponent's skull, delivering a swift and accurate blow.

abilities.description: The adaptive Water stance favours defence.
abilities.detail: Stance: Water Patient and unchanging, yielding yet impervious, Water is supremely adaptive to its surroundings. This flowing stance is slow to attack but affords tremendous physical defence.

abilities.description: Know yourself, know your foe.
abilities.detail: The trained blademaster shall be able to assess the state of a foe's limbs with a single glance.

abilities.description: If death must come, be it by your own blade.
abilities.detail: In the direst of circumstances, so long as you still keep your blade, your life remains in your own hands. By driving your sword through your own heart, you may bring immediate death.

abilities.description: Unleash a fierce strike against your attacker.
abilities.detail: Prepare yourself to strike back against your foes. Any time a physical blow is struck against you, you have a chance to loose your blade upon your attacker in retaliation.

abilities.description: Command lightning into your sword.
abilities.detail: By channelling accumulated Shin energy into your sword, you may charge your blade with volatile electrical currents. A weapon so empowered will strike as lightning the next time it is drawn, and shall cause your foe's muscles to lock up in clumsiness. ** Your blade may only be infused with one element at a time.

abilities.description: Torment an impaled foe.
abilities.detail: Should your enemy be impaled upon your sword, you may twist the blade, gouging through their innards and letting a torrent of blood.

abilities.description: Aggressive and powerful, the Fire stance is one of attack.
abilities.detail: Stance: Fire Flickering and ephemeral, Fire manifests in the weaving, surging flame and the overwhelming force of sudden combustion. Blows struck from this reckless, offensively focused stance will deal significantly more damage, with more speed, but you will be more vulnerable to attacks.

abilities.description: Suffuse your blade with ice.
abilities.detail: By channelling accumulated Shin energy into your sword, you may chill your blade to a glacial state. A weapon so empowered will strike as ice the next time it is drawn, and may freeze your target into inaction. ** Your blade may only be infused with one element at a time.

abilities.description: Spill blood with a succession of slashes.
abilities.detail: By compounding your focus, you may slash your target thrice in a single, continuous motion. Such an attack will deal more damage and draw more blood than a lesser slash, but not permit an accompanying strike.

abilities.description: Send their blood to the points of the compass.
abilities.detail: Draw and slash your target from one of the cardinal directions, causing more bleeding than a lesser slash. The points of the compass: NORTH: head EAST:left arm SOUTHEAST: left leg SOUTH: torso SOUTHWEST: right leg WEST: right arm

abilities.description: Wield the Void and your sword as one.
abilities.detail: By channelling accumulated Shin energy into your sword, you may fold the recondite power of the Void about your blade. A weapon so empowered will flow as a shadow the next time it is drawn, carving through armour and other physical protections as if a tool of magic, and may negate one of your opponent's defences. ** Your blade may only be infused with one element at a time.

abilities.description: Let their blood flow freely.
abilities.detail: When an opponent writhes impaled upon your blade, with this technique you may carve through vital organs, causing severe internal bleeding and hampering your enemy's ability to clot their wounds.

abilities.description: The total focus of the Void stance amplifies inner power.
abilities.detail: Stance: Void Empty of all things, Void is absolute nothingness without boundary or end. The clarity gained by driving away thought, and by freeing your mind of distraction, in contemplation of Void, will enhance your connection with your physical form. Striking from this stance will yield more Shin energy, and less will be consumed by most abilities.

abilities.description: Draw the broken star across your foe.
abilities.detail: Unleash the fatal fury of a master swordsman by carving the broken star. In the sanguinary heat of battle, when your opponent's bleeding reaches a suitably profuse intensity, let your blade guide your hand as four perfect, precise strokes cut free their soul.

abilities.description: Your loyal companion.
abilities.detail: The golden eagles serve only those loyal to the Bloodsworn divine, forming a lifelong partnership with a paladin in their struggle against the forces of Evil, Chaos, and Darkness. Your eagle comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. If you cause your eagle to die, you will be refused another eagle. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your eagle. Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your eagle. EAGLE ASSESS : See information about your eagle. EAGLE RECALL : Recall your eagle to your shoulder. EAGLE SANCTUARY : Order your eagle to a sanctuary where it will be safe. EAGLE LAND : Order your eagle to land on the ground. EAGLE CIRCLE : Order your eagle to fly up into the skies. EAGLE TRAIN : Order your eagle to go train, in order to raise a stat. EAGLE REPORT : Gain information on where your eagle is. EAGLE SLAY : Order your eagle to slay someone. EAGLE HUNT : When your eagle is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. EAGLE FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your eagle will flee battle. EAGLE SLEEP : Order your eagle to sleep. EAGLE FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your eagle. As your eagle gains in Stamina: its health will increase. Speed: it will attack more quickly as well as fly from place to place more quickly. Strength: it will attack with more power as well as be able to carry larger items.

abilities.description: Increase your ability to weather damage.
abilities.detail: Your budding control over your body will assist you in weathering the storm of life by increasing your constitution by one point.

abilities.description: Order your bird to seek out an adventurer.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may order your eagle to seek out another adventurer. Your eagle must be either on the ground or on your wrist to use this ability.

abilities.description: See as your companion sees.
abilities.detail: Look through the eyes of your eagle, seeing its immediate surroundings(*). * Does not work if it is in someone's inventory or similar.

abilities.description: Obstructing departure with your body.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to block a particular direction, preventing normal movement in that direction.

abilities.description: Ever watchful.
abilities.detail: You have established enough of a rapport with your eagle now that you may order it to follow, from the air, a particular adventurer. When the eagle loses the adventurer, generally because the adventurer goes indoors, it will stop following.

abilities.description: Grip your wielded items in a deathlock.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Barging your opponents.
abilities.detail: This ability will barge an adventurer to the direction you choose. To start the ability, you must be in a room adjacent to the room where the target adventurer resides, and you must choose to barge him in a direction that wouldn't take him into the room you are in. So, for instance, say that Isildur is in a room to the north of me, and that this room has another exit to the ne. I would do BARGE ISILDUR NE.

abilities.description: Stun a target with the power of your voice.
abilities.detail: Your battle cry is so powerful that when directed against another, it will blast him to the ground and stun him, provided he isn't deaf.

abilities.description: Use of the valued projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: Use one of the various bows to shoot an adventurer in a line-of-sight location from you.

abilities.description: Take full advantage of your quiver.
abilities.detail: Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver. When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver. Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver. To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.
abilities.syntax: ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom> / INSPECT QUIVER / DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour> / SWITCH <colour>

abilities.description: Further increase your accuracy through wind compensation.
abilities.detail: Once you have this ability, your accuracy with bowmanship will be increased.

abilities.description: Increase your accuracy in shooting.
abilities.detail: Increase the accuracy of your shooting.

abilities.description: Standing firm against attempts to move you.
abilities.detail: By concentrating on increasing your mass, you are able to gain immunity from most attempts to move you against your will. It is lost when you next use balance or equilibrium.

abilities.description: Small things can be salvation.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may order your eagle to deliver a small item or group of items from your inventory into the inventory of another adventurer.

abilities.description: Reduce the damage taken from magical attacks.
abilities.detail: Due to your increased bodily control, you are able to reduce the damage from magical attacks.

abilities.description: A powerful projectile weapon.
abilities.detail: The crossbow is more powerful, but less accurate, than the longbow.

abilities.description: Reduce the level of your bleeding.
abilities.detail: This will permit you to partially clot your bleeding.

abilities.description: Controlling your breathing.
abilities.detail: With your mastery of your own body, you are able to purge yourself of the asthma affliction.

abilities.description: Throw off pacifying afflictions.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to cure certain pacifying afflictions, notably those that are normally cured by eating bellwort.

abilities.description: Secure it in the talons.
abilities.detail: Using this ability will cause your eagle to try and pick up an object in the room that it is in, and deliver it back to you.

abilities.description: The steed is often an easier target.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow your eagle to startle an opponent's steed, tossing the poor rider off. Note that this works regardless of whether your opponent is on the ground, in the trees, or flying. You simply need be in the same room, and the eagle will fly to the correct elevation to startle your target's mount.

abilities.description: There is no hiding from the light.
abilities.detail: This ability is an improved version of eagle follow. With track, even if the eagle temporarily loses its target, because the target went indoors, the eagle will continue to follow the target once the target comes back outside.

abilities.description: Attempt to protect someone else with swordwork.
abilities.detail: Upon using this ability, you will attempt to take much of the damage from the blows that might otherwise harm the adventurer you are defending.

abilities.description: A bird's eye view.
abilities.detail: If your eagle is flying, it will report back to you the health levels of everyone who is in the local area and outdoors.

abilities.description: Using the infamous darkbows of Hashan.
abilities.detail: The famed darkbows of Hashan are both expensive and powerful. Only slightly less powerful than a crossbow, they are far more accurate.

abilities.description: To tear the Dark asunder.
abilities.detail: Equip your eagle with steel talons, and set it loose upon the enemies of Creation(*). * Significantly increases your eagle's offensive capabilities.

abilities.description: Damage a cowardly opponent.
abilities.detail: There is nothing more despicable and dishonourable than a coward, and this ability will allow you to punish cowards, as is their due. Once you have engaged an adventurer, if he is otherwise unhindered and tries to leave the room, you will get in an extra strike, whether you have equilibrium and balance or not.

abilities.description: Mount or vault your steeds at increased speed.
abilities.detail: You have reached such a level of training in the arts of Chivalry that you regain balance while Mounting a steed much more rapidly. Furthermore, if you have the ability Vault in Riding, you can use it without any loss of balance at all.

abilities.description: Temporarily raise your strength.
abilities.detail: This will allow you to temporarily raise your strength with 2 points, for no more than a total of 1/4th of each Achaean day. It can be used once a day without cost, but if you turn it off and turn it back on within the same Achaean day, you will incur a cost of 500 willpower each time you turn it back on. Your endurance losses will be significantly higher while Fury is active.

abilities.description: The ancient ability of producing venom.
abilities.detail: The ancient ability of producing venom.

abilities.description: Sinking your fangs into an unfortunate victim.
abilities.detail: Sinking your fangs into an unfortunate victim. The addition of a venom only functions when biting adventurers.

abilities.description: Cleansing your venom sacs of poison.
abilities.detail: Cleansing your venom sacs of poison.

abilities.description: Resist the detrimental effects of venoms.
abilities.detail: With your mastery over your own body, you are able to cure yourself of an affliction. Due to the taxing nature of this ability, you will need to recover a short time after using it before you may use it again.

abilities.description: Minor damage.
abilities.detail: This venom will cause minor damage to adventurers and denizens. This venom cannot be used to envenom a weapon.

abilities.description: Loss of coordination.
abilities.detail: Cause a loss of coordination in your target.

abilities.description: Blindness.
abilities.detail: Cause blindness in your target.

abilities.description: Gives the victim delusions of invulnerability.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with recklessness.

abilities.description: Inhibits the respiratory system.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with severe asthma.

abilities.description: Causes unbearable shyness.
abilities.detail: Cause unbearable shyness in your victim.

abilities.description: Makes the victim allergic to sunlight.
abilities.detail: Give your target an allergy to sunlight.

abilities.description: A venom of muscular paralysis.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim's body to freeze with paralysis.

abilities.description: Shrivel up the arms of your unlucky victim.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim's arms to shrivel.

abilities.description: Increase the recipient's sensitivity.
abilities.detail: Increase your victim's sensitivity to pain.

abilities.description: Disfigure your victim, causing disloyalty in those around.
abilities.detail: Causes your victim to become disfigured making their loyal servants turn on them.

abilities.description: Induces spasmodic vomiting.
abilities.detail: Induces spasmodic vomiting.

abilities.description: Gives blindness and deafness.
abilities.detail: Cause both blindness and deafness in your victim.

abilities.description: Forces the recipient's eyelids open.
abilities.detail: Forces your victim's eyelids open clearing his eyes of blindness.

abilities.description: A more powerful version of Sumac.
abilities.detail: A more powerful version of Sumac poison. This venom can not be used to envenom a weapon.

abilities.description: A venom that weakens the muscles.
abilities.detail: A venom that weakens the muscles.

abilities.description: Cause the legs of your victim to become useless.
abilities.detail: Cause the legs of your victim to become useless.

abilities.description: Causes great dizziness.
abilities.detail: Cause great dizziness in your target.

abilities.description: Give the curse of anorexia to your victim.
abilities.detail: Causes your victim to fall prey to anorexia.

abilities.description: The deadliest venom known to mankind.
abilities.detail: This deadly venom will induce a quick death for its victim.

abilities.description: Put your victim to sleep.
abilities.detail: Put your victim to sleep.

abilities.description: The ability to instantly secrete a venom.
abilities.detail: The ability of Transcretion is automatic and will allow you to secrete and instantly be able to bite without waiting for balance. You will also be able to secrete venoms directly onto edged weapons.

abilities.description: Induce haemophilia in a target.
abilities.detail: Induce haemophilia in your target. This venom can not be used to envenom a weapon.

abilities.description: Grants an insatiable addiction.
abilities.detail: This potent venom will instill an addiction in your victim that will not be sated.

abilities.description: An unpredictable toxin.
abilities.detail: This unpredictable toxin will afflict your victim with a random venom.

abilities.description: Cause sheer stupidity in your opponent.
abilities.detail: Afflict your victim with sheer stupidity.

abilities.description: Forcing your victim back into mortal form.
abilities.detail: This venom will force the spirit animals out of those pesky forestals.

abilities.description: Causes the recipient to become foully oily.
abilities.detail: Cause your victim to secrete foul oils from his skin.

abilities.description: A venom that thins the blood.
abilities.detail: A nasty venom that will thin the victim's blood allowing your toxins to be more effective.

abilities.description: A venom that chills the veins.
abilities.detail: A venom that chills the veins.

abilities.description: A lethality profound.
abilities.detail: Your grasp of venom has reached such a profound transcendence that you are now able to turn the very immune system of your victim's against them. Certain venoms, when delivered in just the right quantities, can promote violent immune responses which in turn lead to cascading failures and further afflictions manifesting throughout the subjects body. Each reaction has: A trigger: the venom which sets off the cascading failure (this is what you bite with). Conditionals: the afflictions which the subject must already labour under. A result: the result of the reaction taking place. Some reactions have: A bonus conditional: a bonus conditional which can be met. A bonus result: the bonus which is achieved if the bonus conditional is met. Naturally, with the exact dose and balance requirements of this high art of venom, only the fangs of the serpent are sufficient for this purpose(*). * You may see what reactions you are aware of with the EKANELIA command, and study one at further length with the EKANELIA STUDY <reaction> command. ** Reactions fire on the bite command.

abilities.cooldown: Fashion: 2.00 seconds of balance Unravel: 10.00 seconds of balance
abilities.description: Fashion vodun dolls from rope and cloth.
abilities.detail: After the first fashioning to create the doll, you will have a crude humanoid vodun doll. Wield the doll and FASHION DOLL OF <target>. As you fashion your doll further, you'll notice that it gets closer to being a semi-living state. Further, the more fashions you have with your doll, the more Vodun powers you'll be able to channel through the doll. Additionally, your doll will decay at a rate of 50% every 6 minutes after the last fashion. This effect does not occur for dolls of allied adventurers. If you find yourself in need of destroying a doll that is no longer in your possession, you may unravel it from afar. Note that this is a difficult feat, and will result in being thrown off balance for a long period of time.
abilities.required: 1 rope and 1 cloth for doll Fashion: 50 mana Unravel: 750 mana

abilities.description: Grip your dolls tighter than ever before.
abilities.detail: While using this ability, you will prevent items from being knocked out of your grip.

abilities.description: Muddle the thoughts of your victim.
abilities.detail: This will cause your victim to become mentally confused.

abilities.description: Cause your enemy to become unsteady on his feet.
abilities.detail: Curse your victim with the dizziness affliction.

abilities.description: Send someone to the dreamworld.
abilities.detail: Either put your victim to sleep, or remove a sleep-related defence.

abilities.description: Cause your victim to see an image of your choosing.
abilities.detail: Cause your doll's namesake to see something specific. You may embed a single newline in the illusion by including the characters \n at the appropriate spot.

abilities.description: See the surroundings of your target.
abilities.detail: Get a view of what's in your target's surroundings. If your doll is above 30 fashions this skill requires nothing to use.

abilities.description: Find out what the health and mana of your target is.
abilities.detail: Through your vodun doll, you may see the health and mana of your target.

abilities.description: Strip someone's defences.
abilities.detail: This ability will strip a defence from your doll's namesake.

abilities.description: Lock up the muscle system of your victim.
abilities.detail: Paralyse the nervous system of the victim.

abilities.description: Break both the arms or both the legs of someone.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may break both the arms or legs of your victim.

abilities.description: Crush the life out of your victim.
abilities.detail: As long as the doll's living twin is in the area you can inflict the effigy with a choking curse, and watch in joy as its likeness asphyxiates.
abilities.required: 15 Fashions (0 used when in same room as target, 1 if in same area)

abilities.description: Induce a sense of extreme bravado in your opponent.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you'll cause your victim to think he or she is always on full health.

abilities.description: Tickle the feet of your doll.
abilities.detail: By tickling the bottom of your dolls' feet, you will cause your victim to laugh convulsively.

abilities.description: Set your victim alight.
abilities.detail: Set your victim alight!

abilities.description: Bloodlet your enemy.
abilities.detail: Cause blood to begin pouring from the pores of your unlucky opponent.

abilities.description: Travel through the spirit pathways to your doll.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may cross a continent to travel to your victim.

abilities.description: Break all the limbs of a victim.
abilities.detail: Break all the limbs of a victim.

abilities.description: Your wish is their command.
abilities.detail: Command your victim to perform a specific action.

abilities.description: Make a victim move through time more slowly.
abilities.detail: Slow the movement of your victim through time.
abilities.required: 20 Fashions (10 Used, 1 if speed defense is stripped)

abilities.description: Destroy your target's internal organs.
abilities.detail: Push your fingers sadistically into the gut of your victim, damaging their torso in the process. Sometimes this damage is enough to cause them to no longer be able to eat.

abilities.description: Rob your victim of some of his senses.
abilities.detail: Blackout some of the senses of your opponent, temporarily.

abilities.description: Summon your victim to you.
abilities.detail: Summons your doll's model to you providing he is in the same area or an adjacent room. This will bypass monolith sigils for people who consider you an ally if you are within standard ranged distances or line of sight.

abilities.description: Tie up your hapless opponent.
abilities.detail: Tie up a victim through your doll.

abilities.description: Hear talking through your target's ears.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you'll be able to hear anything anyone who is in the room with your victim says.

abilities.description: You know them more than they know themselves.
abilities.detail: As you refine your doll, your knowledge of your victim shall grow to the point that even while clumsy your efforts to bring down curses upon them shall succeed more often than not(*). * The doll must be wielded and this ability has no impact until you have at least ten fashions.

abilities.description: See the inventory of your target.
abilities.detail: See the possessions in the inventory of your victim.

abilities.description: Afflict your opponent through your doll.
abilities.detail: Imbibe a venom directly into the bloodstream of your doll's model with a pin. You must have a vial of whatever venom you wish to imbibe with in your inventory.

abilities.description: A pain beyond that of mere breaking.
abilities.detail: Though breaking someone's limb is certainly painful, mangling it is far worse.

abilities.description: Bruise the very brain of your doll's model.
abilities.detail: An extremely potent affliction, the concussion gives one afflicted with it amnesia every second.

abilities.description: Attach yourself to the spirit of your victim.
abilities.detail: This interesting and useful ability will allow a Vodun master to leech experience from a victim who is in a hunting party. What it essentially does is give experience to the Vodun master as if he or she was a part of the hunting party that the victim is in.

abilities.description: The hallmark of a master of Vodun.
abilities.detail: With TRUEFASHION, you have achieved a level of skill whereby sometimes you can get two fashions in the time it normally takes to get one.

abilities.description: Increased mastery of the shortsword.
abilities.detail: This ability works to automatically increase your damage and accuracy with a shortsword. Be warned that it will only work when you're wielding a shortsword.

abilities.description: Gain proficiency in one of the schools of weaponry.
abilities.detail: The decision to specialise in a specific school of weaponry shall dictate the rest of your growth as a knight. You shall learn abilities specific to your chosen school as you progress further in weaponmastery. The different schools are: Two handed: a style which focuses on single, powerful blows with warhammers and bastard swords. Sword and shield: a style that focuses on combination attacks, balancing offense and defence. Dual cutting: a style that focuses on wielding two bladed weapons simultaneously. Typically based around swifter strikes to overwhelm opponents. Dual blunt: a style that focuses on wielding two blunt weapons simultaneously, and generating momentum to unleash exceptionally damaging strikes against an opponent. Note: you may switch your specialisation, but it shall cost you 100 lessons each time that you do so (outside of your initial selection).

abilities.description: Coat a weapon in venoms.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may layer venoms on an edged weapon. Each time that weapon hits somebody, one venom will poison your opponent, and disappear from the weapon. They work on a last-on, first-off basis, so if you put xentio on a weapon, and then put voyria on, the voyria would come off first, and the xentio second. You must have the selected venom in a vial in your inventory. In order to get rid of the venoms on a weapon, simply WIPE <weapon>.

abilities.description: Swing your blade in a controlled arc.
abilities.detail: By swinging your sword in a controlled arc, you will be able to damage everyone in the room with your sword. If you optionally specify a target, the arc shall only strike that person, but the blow is far swifter to recover from (3.00 seconds). Note that this ability may be performed off equilibrium.

abilities.description: Predict when your blows will damage their limbs.
abilities.detail: The trained weapons master is able to determine approximately when their blows will cause their target's limbs to break.

abilities.description: Attack the defences that would keep your weapons out.
abilities.detail: With raze, your sword will become a weapon of destruction, attacking the defences of your enemies that serve to keep your weapons out.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: The ability to wield and use two weapons simultaneously.
abilities.detail: The scimitar and axe are the weapons of the true warrior, and you are skilled enough with this noble weapon to wield two and use two of them at once. You may optionally specify a limb and venoms to use.

abilities.description: A deep, piercing blow from an adjacent location.
abilities.detail: When starting from an adjacent location, you may lunge at a target, causing quite a bit of damage. You must be wielding a sword to use this ability.

abilities.description: Sink your blade into an opponent.
abilities.detail: This wicked ability may be used when your hapless victim has fallen to the ground and lies there, helpless. With it, you will drive your sword into his body, causing regular damage as long as he is on the sword. Further, while impaled, he will find himself unable to move, though you too will be unable to move. If your victim suffers from two broken legs it will greatly extend the length of time it takes them to escape your blade.

abilities.description: First penetrate his defences, then give him the sharp end.
abilities.detail: You have now gained the ability to simultaneously raze and slash an opponent. Many knights have found it to be a very effective tactic in taking down another adventurer's magical shield and attacking at the same time.

abilities.description: Take them down to the ground.
abilities.detail: Swing at a leg of your target with a battleaxe. If the leg breaks, you'll take the opportunity to drive your target to the ground. If it does not break the limb, the balance on this attack is significantly increased. This will always break the limb when it is above 90% damaged. Note that this attack does not deliver a venom.

abilities.description: Rend your opponent's body in two.
abilities.detail: If you are wielding a sword in your hand, you may try to cleave someone's body asunder. Your opponent does not have to be in the room with you when you begin a cleave, but by the time you get the second cleave-related message, he must be in the room, or the cleave will be stopped. If you do successfully cleave your opponent, you will so destroy his body that there will be nothing left for anyone to immolate.

abilities.description: Through intense concentration, increase your blade mastery.
abilities.detail: Mastery is the ability to pour such concentration into your bladework that your ability to penetrate cutting defenses increases.

abilities.description: Rattle skulls with a brutal blow.
abilities.detail: With the flat of a battleaxe, deliver a skull rattling blow to a downed opponent, delivering blackout.

abilities.description: Make them fear for their life.
abilities.detail: You may intimidate a vulnerable opponent, causing them to lose coordination to the point that they will extend any tumbling attempts they attempt. Vulnerable for the purposes of this ability requires a target be prone with both legs broken. Note that this ability may be performed without balance, but requires equilibrium.

abilities.description: Tear the entrails from a target.
abilities.detail: Once you have impaled someone, you may disembowel them, ripping open their bloated bellies, and causing immense damage. Those suffering from internal bleeding will take more damage from this attack.

abilities.description: Strike them with ever greater power.
abilities.detail: The skilled wielder of the flail or morningstar is capable of using the momentum of previous attacks to perform greater feats. Each whirl based attack performed with one of these weapons that lands shall raise the momentum of the knight's following attacks, to potentially devastating effect.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: The most basic of blunt attacks.
abilities.detail: This ability delivers a single, powerful blow with your chosen weapon. When striking a limb that is already damaged to the point of needing a restoration salve, it will deliver a fracture to that limb(*). Excluding the legs.
abilities.required: Either a flail or a morningstar

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Fracture the defences that would protect your opponent.
abilities.detail: This attack will allow you to shatter the aura of rebounding or magical shield that may protect an opponent. Due to the nature of this attack, a failed fracture attempt against an unprotected target shall result in a loss of momentum.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Strike twice as fast.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your training where you may now utilise two weapons at once to attack. Your skill is such that you may target each separate attack to a different limb of your target. When you strike an already damaged limb of an opponent with this attack, that limb will gain a fracture(*). * Excluding the legs.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: With the trained eye of a warrior.
abilities.detail: With the gifted eye of a warrior, observe your adversary and determine the number of fractures their limbs suffer from.

abilities.description: Predict when your blows will damage their limbs.
abilities.detail: The trained weapons master is able to determine approximately when their blows will cause their target's limbs to break.

abilities.description: Crush their skulls.
abilities.detail: If you are wielding a blunt weapon in your hand, you may try to crush someone's skull. Your opponent does not have to be in the room with you when you begin your attempt, but by the time you get the second attack-related message, he must be in the room, or the skullcrush will be stopped.
abilities.required: A blunt weapon of some form

abilities.description: Your form is flawless.
abilities.detail: The true knight does not suffer any potential flaws in form or technique. You may now drive the hated imperfection of clumsiness from your being, though doing so is taxing and carries a long delay before you may do so again.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Expend your momentum for crippling effects.
abilities.detail: You may now expend your momentum upon a limb while striking at the limbs of your target to produce various effects. This will require momentum and reset the momentum decay timer. The results are different depending on if you are using a flail or a morningstar. Morningstars: When expending in a strike to the head, your opponent will be stunned and have their vision restored. If they are already unblind and are also prone, they will receive a skull fracture. When expending in a strike to the torso, you will drive the air from your target's lungs, cancelling any aura of rebounding that they may have begun establishing about their person, and numbing them into paralysis. If they are already paralysed, you will crack their ribs. When expending in a strike to the left arm, you will make them unable to parry effectively for a short time and afflict your opponent with clumsiness. If they are already clumsy, you will fracture their wrist. When expending in a strike to the right arm, they will find themselves unable to utilise tattoos effectively for a time and will be afflicted with weariness. If they were already weary, you will crack their wrist. Finally, when expending in a strike to either leg, your target will be knocked to the ground and become lethargic. Flails: When expending in a strike to the head, your target will be afflicted with healthleech. If they already have healthleech and are prone, you will fracture their skull. When expending to the torso, you will drive the breath from their lungs and afflict them with asthma. If they are already asthmatic, you will crack their ribs. When expending to either arm, you will cause their skin to become bloody and raw, afflicting them with darkshade. If they are already suffering from this affliction, you will fracture their wrist. When expending to either leg, you will cause them to become clumsy. If they are already clumsy, they will be knocked off balance for a short while. * All expends cost 1 momentum, except expend legs with a morningstar which costs 3. ** All non-fracture based afflictions from flail expends relapse a short while after they are first given, striking for a second time.

abilities.description: Unleash a terrible assault against a helpless opponent.
abilities.detail: This brutal attack can only be performed against a prone opponent. It deals significant damage, and has different results based on the limb targeted. Head: raises the damaged state of the limb by a full level if possible. Torso: fractures three of your target's ribs in one strike(*). When targeted against the head it consumes 7 momentum; when targeted against the torso only 3. This ability also has a longer balance cost when used against the head. * Two ribs if the target has no internal trauma. Three if they have mild internal trauma. Four if they have serious internal trauma.

abilities.description: You have the high ground.
abilities.detail: When wielding flails, your furor is so great that your blows which would otherwise expend momentum against a prone target no longer do. * You will not gain momentum on attacks in this case, but you will not lose it either.

abilities.description: End their life in a single strike.
abilities.detail: You may pulp the brains of a suitably vulnerable victim, ending their life in a single terrible strike. For the purposes of this ability, suitably vulnerable requires they be prone with either a mangled head -or- five or more skull fractures.

abilities.description: Shrug off afflictions like the trivialities they are.
abilities.detail: You may use this ability to shrug off the affects of paralysis. There is a fairly substantial delay before you may utilise this ability for a second time. Your body takes time to recover from this ability, removing your capability to utilise fitness for a short time following it.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Dispense with your opposition.
abilities.detail: Deliver a single, powerful blow to shatter bone and rend flesh.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Split their skulls with a mighty blow.
abilities.detail: This powerful blow aimed at the head shall deliver skull fractures. The more skull fractures your victim suffers from, the longer it shall take them to recover from sipping a healing elixir or tonic. Additionally, while afflicted with skull fractures, the target shall periodically receive nausea. This periodic afflicting becomes faster based on how many fractures are present.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Carve through your victim's defences.
abilities.detail: This ability allows the user to carve through defences that would keep them from their opponent. If both the rebounding aura and shield defence are present, both are stripped, if only one is present, a followup damaging slash will be dealt.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Splinter the defences protecting your opponent.
abilities.detail: This ability allows the user to smash through defences that would keep them from their opponent. If both the rebounding aura and shield defence are present, both are stripped, if only one is present, a follow-up damaging blow will be dealt.

abilities.description: Perceive the state of your opponent.
abilities.detail: The trained warrior is able to pick out the slightest details of an opponent, even through the haze of battle. This ability will allow you to determine the exact state of the injuries you have inflicted against a target.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Deliver a devastating rising stroke.
abilities.detail: This raising strike aimed at the torso aims to crack the ribs of your opponent. The more cracked ribs they suffer from, the less healing elixirs or tonics shall restore them for. Additionally, while afflicted with cracked ribs, the target shall periodically receive sensitivity. This periodic afflicting becomes faster based on how many fractures are present.

abilities.description: Bring them down in a tangle of limbs.
abilities.detail: Against an opponent who has suffered at least one badly damaged leg, you may exploit their motions to gain an opening with which to tangle your weapon with their legs. This will bring them crashing to the ground.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Deliver precision strikes against your opponent's limbs.
abilities.detail: This ability can target either the arms or legs of your opponent. When striking the arms they will suffer from wrist fractures, and when hitting the legs you will deliver torn tendons. Wrist fractures will periodically afflict with lethargy. Torn tendons periodically gives clumsiness, and also makes it more difficult to leave the room. Afflictions relapse faster based on how many fractures are present.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Pulp your opponent's limbs with crushing blows.
abilities.detail: This ability can target either the arms or legs of your opponent. When striking the arms they will suffer from wrist fractures, and when hitting the legs you will deliver torn tendons.

abilities.description: Distract them with a deafening shout.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you are able to distract your enemy from acts that take intense focus. For instance, the behead or shatter abilities from weaponry.

abilities.description: Alter your technique.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow the trained knight to alter his stance to produce various results. By focusing on speed, the next attack will be sped up. By focusing on precision, the damage dealt by the next attack will be reduced, but the number of limb-based afflictions dealt will be doubled.

abilities.description: Your technique is flawless.
abilities.detail: The true knight does not suffer any potential flaws in form or technique. You may now drive the hated imperfection of clumsiness from your being, though doing so is taxing and carries a long delay before you may do so again.

abilities.description: Redirect incoming projectiles.
abilities.detail: You may now deflect incoming arrows toward less vital areas of your body, mitigating their overall damage.

abilities.description: Rend your opponent's body in two.
abilities.detail: If you are wielding a sword in your hand, you may try to cleave someone's body asunder. Your opponent does not have to be in the room with you when you begin a cleave, but by the time you get the second cleave-related message, he must be in the room, or the cleave will be stopped. If you do successfully cleave your opponent, you will so destroy his body that there will be nothing left for anyone to immolate.

abilities.description: Crush their skulls.
abilities.detail: If you are wielding a blunt weapon in your hand, you may try to crush someone's skull. Your opponent does not have to be in the room with you when you begin your attempt, but by the time you get the second attack-related message, he must be in the room, or the skullcrush will be stopped.

abilities.description: A true knight will die on his feet.
abilities.detail: Having learned to roll with the momentum of your blows, you will be able to come back to your feet if knocked down. This ability does not require balance, if following a weaponmastery attack.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Destroy their limbs utterly.
abilities.detail: This ability delivers a single, powerful strike across your opponent's body, targeting either their arms or their legs. The more wrist fractures or torn tendons they suffer from respectively, the greater the damage to their limbs. If the limb is already broken prior to the devastate attempt, the level of limb damage will be increased.

abilities.description: Put him out of his misery.
abilities.detail: Deliver a crushing blow to a prone opponent with a warhammer.

abilities.description: Dispatch them with a single catastrophic blow.
abilities.detail: Set your feet and raise your hammer, in preparation for a single catastrophic blow. Your next brain attempt will be altered to do damage based on how many skull fractures the target has. This ability requires you possess both standard balance as well as battlefury balance, and consumes both.

abilities.description: Sink your blade into an opponent.
abilities.detail: This wicked ability may be used when your hapless victim has fallen to the ground and lies there, helpless. With it, you will drive your sword into his body, causing regular damage as long as he is on the sword. Further, while impaled, he will find himself unable to move, though you too will be unable to move. If your victim suffers from two broken legs it will greatly extend the length of time it takes them to escape your blade.

abilities.description: Tear the entrails from a target.
abilities.detail: Once you have impaled someone, you may disembowel them, ripping open their bloated bellies, and causing immense damage. Those suffering from internal bleeding will take more damage from this attack.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Rend the flesh of your foes.
abilities.detail: Deliver a slow, yet powerful blow with your sword.

abilities.description: Remove the defences that would keep your weapons from your foe.
abilities.detail: This ability will allow you to raze the defences that would protect your opponent from your attacks, such as the aura of rebounding or magical shields.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Deliver a crushing blow with your shield.
abilities.detail: This powerful strike with your shield will have various affects depending on where you strike your victim. Targeting high shall deliver a mental affliction(*), as well as delivering the scrambled brains affliction. Targeting mid shall cause their muscles to lock in paralysis. Targeting low shall cause them to stumble and become hopelessly clumsy. If no target is specified for this attack, the damage dealt is more significant. * It will first deliver dizziness if not present, then recklessness, stupidity, confusion, and finally epilepsy.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Link your blade and shield attacks into devastating combinations.
abilities.detail: By performing both sword and shield attacks in synch, you are able to unleash vicious combinations against your opponents.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Deny them of breath with a precise strike to the throat.
abilities.detail: By driving the edge of your shield into your opponent's throat, you may cut off their air supply, inflicting them with a case of asthma.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Speed is the mark of a true master.
abilities.detail: Deliver a swift strike with your blade, sacrificing damage for speed.

abilities.description: Pin them to the ground with your blade.
abilities.detail: This wicked ability may be used when your hapless victim has fallen to the ground and lies there, helpless. With it, you will drive your sword into his body, causing regular damage as long as he is on the sword. Further, while impaled, he will find himself unable to move, though you too will be unable to move. If your victim suffers from two broken legs it will greatly extend the length of time it takes them to escape your blade.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Rattle their brain with a mighty blow.
abilities.detail: When your victim lies helpless at your feet, you may deliver a mighty blow to their head with your shield, making them see stars and afflicting them with the blackout affliction.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Send them sprawling.
abilities.detail: With this ability, you may knock the legs out from under a hapless victim.

abilities.description: You see every blow that's coming.
abilities.detail: Once you have gained an understanding of the flow of a given battle, you may enter a state of heightened anticipation, during which you will mitigate most attempts to physically strike at you. * Requires maximum ferocity and resets to zero. ** For six seconds (or until it fires three times), you will reduce most physical damage blows to zero. *** This ability has identical bypass conditions as the shield of absorption artefact.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: A brutal display of power.
abilities.detail: Once you have suitably prepared your opponent by breaking one of his limbs and impaling him upon your blade, you may bring your shield crashing down upon his skull, stunning him momentarily.

abilities.description: Rend your opponent's body in two.
abilities.detail: If you are wielding a sword in your hand, you may try to cleave someone's body asunder. Your opponent does not have to be in the room with you when you begin a cleave, but by the time you get the second cleave-related message, he must be in the room, or the cleave will be stopped. If you do successfully cleave your opponent, you will so destroy his body that there will be nothing left for anyone to immolate.

abilities.description: Your dedication to victory can overcome all barriers.
abilities.detail: Your dedication to victory is so great that at the cost of your own health, you may fight through the effects of paralysis. This requires max ferocity and halves your ferocity upon use.

abilities.description: Channel the ferocity of battle.
abilities.detail: You have reached a point in your training where you are able to channel the ferocity of battle which each successful combination attack that you may land.

abilities.description: Unleash your ferocity against your foe.
abilities.detail: Once you have generated sufficient ferocity, you may unleash a devastating blow with your shield. This attack does not consume balance and may be followed with a standard combination attack. When targeted high, the strike will stun your opponent. When targeted to the midsection, the strike will deliver sensitivity. When striking low, you will knock your opponent to the ground.

abilities.cooldown: Balance cost varies based on weapon speed
abilities.description: Exploit holes in their guard.
abilities.detail: This attack is not as fast or powerful as other sword based slashes, but it generates twice as much ferocity when successful.

abilities.description: Tear the entrails from a target.
abilities.detail: Once you have impaled someone, you may disembowel them, ripping open their bloated bellies, and causing immense damage. Those suffering from internal bleeding will take more damage from this attack.

abilities.description: Open conduits to the Elemental Realms.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may open a channel to one of the three elemental realms that you have access to. Keeping these channels open has a cost in willpower. SEVER AIR/WATER/EARTH will close that channel. CHANNELS will list what channels you have open.

abilities.description: Lash them with a whip of air.
abilities.detail: You may conjure forth a whip formed of condensed air to lash your enemies with.

abilities.description: Blow someone in a direction with a gust of wind.
abilities.detail: By channelling the element of air, you can either blow a fog or cloud out of the room, or blow an adventurer in a particular direction.

abilities.description: Create a distracting illusion of yourself.
abilities.detail: By weaving together the powers of air and water, you may create a distracting reflection of yourself to absorb one hostile attack upon your person.

abilities.description: Protect your open channels from attack.
abilities.detail: Using this ability will provide you protection against abilities that may attack your open elemental channels. These abilities will first have to attack your fortification before destroying your channel. However, fortify does have a regular willpower cost associated with it. If you choose to fortify all, the mana and eq costs will be the cost of fortifying a single channel multiplied by the number of channels you have open.

abilities.description: Locate another adventurer.
abilities.detail: By summoning up an image in a pool of water, you are able to scry for the location of a target.

abilities.description: Knock someone out of the trees or the sky.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you may knock a flying or treed adventurer out of the skies or trees.
abilities.syntax: CAST GEYSER AT <target> channels=Earth and Water

abilities.description: Circulate electricity throughout your body.
abilities.detail: With this spell, you will be able to grant yourself the ability to circulate electricity through your body with greater ease, reducing the damage you take from lightning-based attacks.

abilities.description: Slice away shields with a blade of wind.
abilities.detail: This spell will allow you to slice through magical shields that protect your enemy.

abilities.description: The magic of channel binding.
abilities.detail: Like fortification, binding provides protection against losing your channels due to others attacking them. If a channel that is unfortified is attacked, binding will protect that channel a large percentage of the time. It has a willpower loss associated with it, however. If you choose to BIND ALL, the mana and equilibrium costs will be what it costs for a single channel binding, multiplied by however many channels you have open.

abilities.description: Disturb the natural weather patterns.
abilities.detail: This ability allows you to disturb the natural weather patterns, causing them to drastically worsen in your immediate location.
abilities.syntax: CAST DISTURB channels=Air, Water and Earth

abilities.description: Conjure forth a burst of static.
abilities.detail: This spell causes a burst of static, which will paralyse any adventurer it is focussed upon. Against denizens, this spell will deal electrical damage.
abilities.syntax: CAST STATIC AT <target> channels=Air and earth

abilities.description: A burst of sound to rupture the ears.
abilities.detail: This spell will generate a shockingly loud clap of thunder. Against adventurers it shall restore the target's hearing if they are deaf, or instill the sensitivity affliction in them if they are not. When used against a denizen, this spell will deal blunt damage.
abilities.syntax: CAST THUNDERCLAP AT <target> channels=Air and Earth

abilities.description: Bleed off your residual power.
abilities.detail: This small spell allows you to create a conduit between an individual and the residual power left in the clouds created by disturbing the natural weather patterns. Each time you cast a spell upon the person who the conduit has been formed with, the residual power of the spell is bled off and used to power your arcane disturbance.

abilities.description: Hurl the unsecured to the corners of the globe.
abilities.detail: This powerful wind spell will allow you to throw all those not secured by the mass defence from your location.

abilities.description: A brilliant flash of light.
abilities.detail: This spell permits you to conjure forth a brilliant flash of light at an enemy. The light will restore their vision if they are blind, or transfix them if they are not.
abilities.syntax: CAST FLASH AT <target> channels=Air and Earth

abilities.description: Control the flows of two spells at once.
abilities.detail: Your skill has reached such a level that you are able to direct the channeled power of two spells practically simultaneously, casting them in rapid succession. The following spells can be cast in this way: windwhip, shear, static, thunderclap, flash, bolt, razorwind, cyclone, and hailstone.

abilities.description: A searing bolt of lightning.
abilities.detail: This spell will summon forth a searing bolt of lightning to strike down an enemy. If the target is under 75% of their maximum health, it shall also cause them to black out.
abilities.syntax: CAST BOLT AT <target> channels=Air and Earth

abilities.description: Sometimes, lightning does strike twice.
abilities.detail: This extremely potent spell allows you to summon forth a lightning strike against a foe. However, the spell is two fold; after the initial strike, a less potent one shall follow some seconds later.
abilities.syntax: CAST ELECTRIFY AT <target> channels=Air and Earth

abilities.description: To the point of instability, and no further.
abilities.detail: This ability is used in place of synchronisation. You may overcharge two spells, causing various effects. Lightning spells: take 15 units of arcane energy each. They deliver paralysis, and damage if paralysis is already present. They shall also temporarily extend focus mind recovery time, though this effect is short lived. Wind spells: take 13 units of arcane energy each, and deliver asthma. They deliver damage if asthma is already present. Water spells: they take 13 units of arcane energy each, and deliver weariness. If weariness is already present on the target, they deliver damage. Static, thunderclap, and bolt are lightning spells; cyclone and razorwind are wind spells. Waterspout and hailstone are water spells.

abilities.description: A wind to lacerate the skin.
abilities.detail: This potent air spell will inflict healthleech against adventurers, or deal cutting damage against denizens.

abilities.description: Conjure up obscuring fog.
abilities.detail: By channelling the powers of air and water, you may cause an elemental fog to envelop the room.

abilities.description: The greatest of the wind spells.
abilities.detail: This powerful wind spell will cause dizziness when used against an adventurer. If the subject is already dizzy, it will give impatience and cause them to suffer damage. Against denizens, this spell will deal blunt damage.

abilities.description: Summon an air elemental to carry you to the skies.
abilities.detail: This powerful spell allows you to lift yourself on the aircurrents, granting flight.

abilities.description: Simple is best.
abilities.detail: Summon forth a hailstone to strike your target in the side of the head. If the target is an adventurer, this will give them clumsiness. If they are already clumsy, it shall give epilepsy. If they have epilepsy, it shall give impatience. This spell also causes cold damage to both adventurers and denizens.
abilities.syntax: CAST HAILSTONE AT <target> channels=Air and Water

abilities.description: Cast an illusion of your choosing.
abilities.detail: With this spell, you can create an illusion of your choosing in the room about you. You may embed a single newline in your illusion by including the character sequence \n at the appropriate spot. You may optionally specify a target for your illusion by adding the name of your intended victim after the word 'cast'. For limitations and restrictions, please refer to HELP ILLUSIONS.

abilities.description: A great flood of water.
abilities.detail: This powerful water spell shall summon forth a great deluge of water, flooding your immediate location.

abilities.description: Call down a hailstorm to pummel everyone else in the room.
abilities.detail: With this spell, you may rain hailstones down upon all your enemies in the room.

abilities.description: Your fury is terrible indeed.
abilities.detail: This most powerful of the lightning spells allows you to summon forth a sphere of condensed electricity. You may set a delay between 10 and 60 seconds on the construct, after which time it will become unstable. Woe to any who are present for that eventuality. }} [[Category:Skills

abilities.description: A simple but deadly rush.
abilities.detail: Charge at your target, and drive a spear into them, causing damage and some minor bleeding.

abilities.description: Armour is an unnecessary inconvenience.
abilities.detail: Weave a second skin over the top of your existing one, with significantly stronger composition(*). * Grants resistance to all forms of damage.

abilities.description: A sundering blow.
abilities.detail: Using an axe, cleave through magical shields surrounding your foe(*). When you cleave through a magical shield, also knock your target prone. * Strips aura of rebounding and magical shield (both at the same time).

abilities.description: Bring them down with a crushing blow.
abilities.detail: Deliver a crushing overhand blow with a mace. If the target is already knocked to the ground, this blow will rattle their skull so much that they will become impatient; if they are not, they will be knocked to the ground and suffer from a bout of stupidity. In addition, impatience will be delivered if this blow also breaks the target's head with the strike, or if their head is already broken.

abilities.description: They won't be walking that off.
