abilities.detail: Using a dagger, you will slice at the hamstring in a target's leg. This will cause the leg to be broken if it's in a good condition(*), and cause the target to fall prone if it is not(**). * Will deliver broken left or right leg if the targeted leg is not damaged to the point of requiring a restoration salve. ** Will knock them prone if the leg is damaged to the point of requiring a restoration salve.

abilities.description: What a tangled web.
abilities.detail: Using a whip, you may attempt to lash it about your target, entangling them. This only works against a target who is upon the ground; if they're still standing, you will tangle their feet and bring them down to the ground instead.

abilities.description: Modify your creations.
abilities.detail: You may now prepare a modification to future weaves. Preparing a modification lasts indefinitely: you do not need to re-prepare every time you seek to attack. Preparing a new modification will remove the previous one, and you may stop preparing any modifications at all by specifying to prepare NONE or NOTHING. Disruption: this preparation will cause your attacks to give paralysis. Laceration: this preparation will cause your attacks to give haemophilia. Dazzle: This preparation will cause your attacks to give clumsiness. Rattle: this preparation will cause your attacks to give epilepsy. Vapours: this preparations will cause your attacks to deliver asthma. Incisive: you will deliver no affliction, but your strike will possess such clarity as to not miss due to being excessively clumsy. Insubstantial: your attacks bypass auras of rebounding and reflections (but do not strip them).

abilities.description: Darkness falls.
abilities.detail: Using a dagger, slash your target across the eyes, blinding them(*). The length of this blindness is increased if they're upon the ground, and they will also suffer a short blackout in this instance. * Delivers the true blind affliction.

abilities.description: A swift and precise jab.
abilities.detail: Using a sword, you will puncture the cluster of nerves just below the shoulder of your opponent(*). * Delivers the weariness affliction.

abilities.description: A precise and deadly strike.
abilities.detail: Using a sword, you will sever the muscles in one of your target's arms(*). If you do not specify an arm, this attack will always target the left by default. * Delivers the clumsiness affliction.

abilities.description: Bring them down to your level.
abilities.detail: Launch a spear at a target flying above you or in the sky at an adjacent location, bringing them back to the ground.

abilities.description: From dust to dust.
abilities.detail: Begin the process of unweaving part of an individual's fundamental essence. Each type of unweaving has separate effects and the longer the unweaving process persists, the more deadly these effects become: Body: health loss whenever the unweaving proceeds. Mind: mana loss whenever the weaving proceeds. Spirit: each time the unweaving proceeds, an additional cure is required to cure the spirit unweave. This is unique to the spirit unweave.

abilities.description: Precision over power.
abilities.detail: A deadly slash across the throat, this attack with a dagger will make it impossible for a target to breathe (*), as well as inflicting them with a bad case of excessive bleeding (**). * Delivers asthma. ** Gives bleeding, which is increased if the target is prone at the time of the attack.

abilities.description: His face was bad enough already.
abilities.detail: Deliver a vicious backhanded blow with a mace, shattering teeth and rattling your target. This attack delivers stupidity and dizziness, and if the unfortunate individual is prone with either one of these afflictions already, they will also be knocked off of focus balance.

abilities.description: A slight change of pace.
abilities.detail: Invert your unweavings on a target, swapping one weaves status for another. For instance, invert your targets body and spirit weaves, and the spirit weave gains the progression of the body weave and the body weave gains the progression of the spirit weave.

abilities.description: Let them know your fervour.
abilities.detail: Weave power into your very voice, enabling you to shout a rallying cry(*), healing yourself for a large amount of health(**). You can only do this every so often, as it is somewhat taxing. * This uses your warcry if you have one set. ** This can push your health above your maximum.

abilities.description: They'll never eat again.
abilities.detail: By driving your blade into the guts of your foe, you'll ravage their internal organs, making them violently sick(*). If they're already bleeding significantly then they'll also lose any desire (or ability) to eat(**). * Gives nausea. ** Gives anorexia.

abilities.description: Onslaught unending.
abilities.detail: Deliver a flurry of strikes with a sword, rending your foe with a devastating onslaught. The more unwoven their spirit is, the more blows you will be able to slip past their guard.

abilities.description: They are unfit for Creation.
abilities.detail: If at least two of your target's mind, body and spirit are both unravelled at least three times each, you may utterly deconstruct that person, slaying them instantly. This is immune to the effects of clumsiness.

abilities.description: We are legion.
abilities.detail: The ultimate expression of weaving: weaving copies of your own person into being. These copies shall attach themselves to random targets in your location, and whenever you hit an individual those copies shall copy you on their relevant targets. You do not get to choose the targets and the miriads will only work when they can see both you and their target(*). Miriads do the same limb damage and afflictions as you, but their health damage is significantly reduced(**). * You must be in the same room as the target of the miriad. ** 50% of base values.
abilities.syntax: WEAVE MIRIAD / WEAVE MIRIAD DISPERSE / MIRIADS

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: The coldest dish so served.
abilities.detail: The tale of the Condemneds vengeance is one long in the making and more tragic still for the fact that he may yet have stayed his hand if not for a single dismissive word. Yet there is no doubt that come the time of choice Han-Silnar slew the Wanderer in defiance of those that hold his chains: in this, he would not be commanded otherwise. * Cyrenians that hear this tale shall be granted the steelmind defence, making the next forced action against them fail.

abilities.description: Listen now of the Prince most dread.
abilities.detail: It is said that the weight of a life's sin is commensurate with their evil. If such is the case, then Black Pazuzu's evil is a burden to be borne by a City and its Peoples from now unto distant futures unknown. And so when you recite the tales of Black Pazuzu, Prince of Woe and self-proclaimed New God, it is the weight of Remembrance that you will bear: both ancient transference and sacred charge. This is his story, but you are not afeared.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Of an origin most malign.
abilities.detail: It began, as it so often does, with fire. Speak the tale of the birthplace of Woe and the landscape shall become most hellish in its turn(*). * Firewalls will be raised over all available exits of your location.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: So let us speak of ambitions great.
abilities.detail: From aeons long ago when the first war was waged comes this story of alliances and betrayals. When you speak this tale, all who are present at the culmination shall find that for a time they will be unable to change those they consider ally or enemy by any means.

abilities.cooldown: 17.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.50 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: The end of the beginning.
abilities.detail: The tale of the great battle upon Nishnatoba is one foundational to history, as is the last charge that came at its grand culmination. Speak this tale and all of your citymates that are members of the standing army in your location will rally behind you(*), ready to charge into battle. * They will be added to your group.

abilities.description: Weep for what was lost.
abilities.detail: The tragic tale of Enheduanna is one of sorrow and betrayal, love and hatred, and terrible, terrible wrath. At the culmination of this tale all in your location that hear you, ally or enemy, will be suffused with a fragment of that terrible fury, all of their actions becoming enhanced(*). * Balance and equilibrium time is reduced while present in the room where this tale was spoken for those that heard it, though not for long. * This tale may only be spoken once every five minutes.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.50 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: For Justice must be served.
abilities.detail: Justice must be served, and this solemn retelling will speak of the first justice that was wrought. On completing it, you will see of the justice which must be served in the present day(*). * It will reveal the locations of all of those in the realm who Cyrene has a bounty placed upon.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Of darkness roused from maddened depths.
abilities.detail: The might of once great Seleucar was a thing that broke the first Black Wave, or at least such was the great design. By speaking this foretelling, you and all allies that hear the grand culmination shall be suffused with a portion of that might temporarily, gaining a bonus when fighting particularly mighty foes(**). * All allies and Cyrenians in your location. * While enhanced in this way your attacks will do more damage against denizens who cannot be struck with critical strikes.

abilities.cooldown: 19.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: A doom on Gruul's line.
abilities.detail: Bound, but never broken. Imprisoned, but yet imperious. The tale of that guise named Taug is one which doomed the line of Gruul and broke a nation even in their triumph. Speak this tale most grim and the blood rains will fall, and all will remember the horror of the king without a crown. * Blood rain in a location prevents magical travel into that location.

abilities.cooldown: 18.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Of vengeance in the making.
abilities.detail: The tale of the traitor Danaeus begins with a mortal life and ends with the ascension of a Chaos Lord. Through fell magics, the once-companion of the wizard Hycanthus despaired of a finite existence and chose the path of blood and betrayal, turning on one master, then another, and then another. All that hear this tale will know a vengeance yet unfilled, and long in the making. * Gives the vengeance defence to all in the location.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Of uplifting and twisted rule.
abilities.detail: When the Chaos Lords first arose and those in power shifted by the day, so too did their vulnerabilities change seemingly at random. At the culmination of this tale, a field of damage absorption shall be created, periodically changing to make a given damage type utterly negated in your location(*). * The shifting cannot be controlled.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.50 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Of lies and deeds most dire.
abilities.detail: When the elemental balance was cast into disarray and long bound Taug was unleashed from a prison ancient in the making, it was a time of great strife. Listen now and hear of how it transpired, and, at the culmination, witness the elements once more be broken at least in part(*). * A random elemental lord in the location will be forced out of their form.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.50 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: An ancient foe cast down.
abilities.detail: The story of the crystal legion that fell prey to Pazuzu unchained after so long guarding his prison is one often overlooked, but for those who comprehend the great task these warriors were appointed to, it is one that can only give them over to reflection(*). * Grants everyone in the location a reflection.

abilities.description: A silver tongue to topple empires.
abilities.detail: The silver tongue of Woe's Prince was as infamous as any of his fell deeds. With whispers and honey he brought kings to their knees and collapsed empires with a word, his argent web spun like a fattened spider. While you cannot quite match Pazuzu's level of charisma, you will find it easy to influence the general public(*) and insert your own gossip into the murmurs of the trifling masses. * Within inns and similar, generally.

abilities.cooldown: 20.00 seconds of voice balance and 4.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: For nothing of remorse was known.
abilities.detail: The unleashing of Khalas from His imprisonment is a tale which came to herald much, but in and of itself, it is a tale of freedom. All that hear this tale, for a short time(*), will be immune to all forms of room hinder(**). * Five to ten seconds. * Such as rites of piety, gravehands, tentacles and similar.

abilities.cooldown: 16.00 seconds of voice balance and 2.50 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: The lines of past and present thin.
abilities.detail: A tale of mustering for war, of plots most dire and the breath before a storm. Speak this tale and you will be transported to the Pantheon of the Gods for a mustering of your own, though only if close enough and unbarred by a monolith(*). * Same plane and continent, and not on a ship.

abilities.description: Of Death alive but not.
abilities.detail: There was a time, long after His demise, when Thoth once more walked and fought with those who would see Woe brought low. However, that which has gone beyond will soon fade once more, and this tale will make such manifest to all(*). * On the first tick with no necromancer present, gravehands are destroyed. On the second tick gravehands are destroyed even if a necromancer is present. On the third tick, infestation maggots are destroyed. * If a necromancer (Oppression users count as necromancers for the purposes of this ability) is present, this recital is a channeled action.

abilities.description: A triumvirate new and broken.
abilities.detail: There was a time when three gods went to face the Prince most Dread, and three gods failed to bring him low. Recite this tale to an individual(*), and both they and three of your citymates will benefit from an increased capacity for war for a time(**). * The target must not be Cyrenian, and three Cyrenians in your location except yourself must be present. Otherwise this reciting will fail. * They will have faster balance recovery for a time.

abilities.description: Of friendship slain by duty.
abilities.detail: A friendship broken. A trust sundered. A deal struck, and all in the name of duty. Speak the solemn tale of when Woe and Death's Demise parted ways forevermore, and see one perish as that ancient alliance did(*). * This is a channeled action, at the culmination of which your target is slain. ** The channel resolves faster the more stacks of the crescendo affliction are present on the target when you begin the recital.

abilities.cooldown: 20.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: United at the last.
abilities.detail: So now we speak of the closing days of the Age of Blackest Woe, and when mortals at last united as one to bring down the forces of the Infernal Prince. When reciting this tale, all Cyrenians in rooms adjacent to you that share allyship with you(*) or who are in your current party will be summoned to your side(**). * Mutual allies. * Rooms with a monolith when the recital begins are excluded. A monolith at recital culmination will have no influence, however.

abilities.cooldown: 20.00 seconds of voice balance and 4.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: A city fallen and besieged.
abilities.detail: The siege upon Shallam lost was one of great heroism and loss, but also one of great triumphs and great mistakes. By reciting this tale, a sliver of the chaos that befell that great battlefield will be made known, and fire shall once more reign from the heavens(*). * A random room in the local area with people in it is chosen. Everyone in that room takes damage. * This is a channeled action.

abilities.description: A prelude to the beginning and the end.
abilities.detail: The great march to memory was the prelude to the final clash with the Prince of Woe, and it if manifest not through tale but through reenactment. You may now tell many of the tales of Woe while on the march, though some particularly ominous ones still require the stillness of contemplation to be fully comprehended(*). * Recitals are no longer interrupted by moving, though channeled recitals are excluded.

abilities.cooldown: 19.00 seconds of voice balance and 3.00 seconds of equilibrium
abilities.description: Divine wrath unleashed.
abilities.detail: In all the long histories of the world have the Pantheon rarely marched to war united, and the resolve must be great indeed for such a dire event to transpire. Speak this tale of battle met and all who share a cause with you(*) will share in a fragment of that resolve, becoming numb to the ravages of war(**). This tale is a difficult one to tell, and you may only do so infrequently(***). * All Cyrenians in your location. * All affected will gain the numbness defence for twenty-five seconds. * This tale can only be recited once an hour.

abilities.description: Master the dramatic pause.
abilities.detail: Masters of storytelling gain the ability to delay the conclusion of a tale for dramatic effect. Using this ability will recite another tale up to its culmination, at which point the completion will be delayed. The tale may be completed for the next 5 minutes instantly at the cost of 3 seconds of balance. This will incur a cooldown of 5 minutes. No tall tales can be completed in this way.

abilities.description: The tale to end all tales.
abilities.detail: All tales speak of dread Woe's final rest, yet with its speaking you may yet put another to theirs in turn. Recite this story over the corpse of a mighty denizen(*), and all within the location that have not participated in a funeral recently(**) will be bolstered(***). * The denizen must be one immune to critical strikes and of a sufficiently potent level. The corpse is destroyed. * You can only recite a funeral every 24 hours and participate in one every 24 hours. * Everyone in the audience receives some experience.

abilities.description: Conceal yourself in the shadows.
abilities.detail: Conceal yourself from view.

abilities.description: Swing up into the trees like a monkey on kola.
abilities.detail: When in a location with trees (such as a forest, or a jungle, or many gardens), you may swing up into the branches.

abilities.cooldown: Traps: 3.00 seconds of balance Traps List: 5.00 seconds of balance
abilities.description: The ability to search for traps in your location.
abilities.detail: The TRAPS ability will search for traps in the room, giving you information about them. You will not be able to find traps laid by someone with higher skill than you. TRAPS LIST will show you all your traps around the world.

abilities.description: A trap that shoots out a poisoned dart at its victim.
abilities.detail: The dart trap shoots out a dart when sprung. It does no damage, but may be envenomed from vials with venom in them, in which case the dart will poison the victim with whatever venom was applied to the trap. Like all traps, it has a bit of magic in it and will only affect your enemies.
abilities.syntax: ASSEMBLE DART TRAP / LAY DART <direction> / ENVENOM DART <direction> WITH <venom>

abilities.description: Summon a lithe vixen to attack your enemies.
abilities.detail: With this ability you may call a sly and cunning vixen to attack your enemies. When she attacks your victim, if they are suffering from the haemophilia affliction, the amount of bleeding she can inflict will be higher. HELP MOBILES will show you what commands you can use with it. ** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: Make your skin tough like bark.
abilities.detail: This ability will cause your skin to become as bark, providing an increased measure of protection vs. attacks doing physical damage.

abilities.description: Trap your enemies like the stupid beasts they are.
abilities.detail: This trap will snare an opponent like a hare heading for the cooking pot, reducing their celerity to 1 for 20 seconds.

abilities.description: The ability to see who last harvested in a room.
abilities.detail: Whenever a plant is harvested, or, indeed, anything that is alive is changed, traces are left in the fabric of life-energy that sustains all living beings. The lastharvest ability allows you to tap into those energies for a short time to see who last harvested from each plant in your location.

abilities.description: Summon a suspiciously helpful lemming to your aid.
abilities.detail: The lemming will race around and between the legs of an opponent, making them afraid of heights. ** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: Discover who exterminated a room last.
abilities.detail: Naturalism allows you to detect the foul stain of a Necromancer's soul on an exterminated room, letting you see who did it.

abilities.description: Use your knowledge of healing to reduce bleeding.
abilities.detail: Anyone who spends time in the wilderness understands the value of a basic knowledge of first aid. Using this technique, you will cause your wounds to clot more quickly.

abilities.description: Attempt to disarm a trap.
abilities.detail: Using this ability, you will attempt to disarm a trap in the direction specified. If you are successful, and not in the arena, then you will get the commodities that went into its making. If you are unsuccessful, you will fall victim to the trap. You will only be able to disarm traps laid by those with skill equal to or less than your own.

abilities.description: Hide your animal companions from plain sight.
abilities.detail: Your skill in Woodlore has increased to the point that your animal companions will obey your orders to hide themselves from plain sight.

abilities.description: A trap to strangle your enemies.
abilities.detail: This is the snare trap's more powerful cousin. It snares someone, but it proceeds to strangle that person until he or she writhes out of the trap.

abilities.description: Call a raven to aid you in combat.
abilities.detail: The raven will dart in and out of an opponent's line of sight, instilling paranoia in them. ** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: A trap that will throw your enemies out of the room.
abilities.detail: The catapult trap is laid in a direction like all traps, but is also set to throw its victim in a particular direction. So, for instance, say you are in a room with north and west exits. You might do: LAY CATAPULT NORTH WEST. Then, when one of your enemies either tries to leave the room going north, or tries to enter the room from the north, he will be thrown west and thrown off-balance momentarily.
abilities.syntax: ASSEMBLE CATAPULT TRAP / LAY CATAPULT <direction> <direction to throw person>

abilities.description: Build a campfire to soothe the body and soul.
abilities.detail: When you build a campfire, those in the room with it will regenerate endurance and willpower at a greatly increased rate. When the fire starts to burn out, you may stoke it to keep it going.
abilities.required: 3 wood to build, 1 wood to stoke

abilities.description: Call for the aid of a very grumpy badger.
abilities.detail: The grumpy badger is a fearsome foe and is able to rip into opponents with its claws, causing great amounts of bleeding.(*) If the target is sufficiently bleeding already(**), the badger will enter a frenzy and additionally give asthma. * The bleeding is increased if the target also has haemophilia. 200 bleeding or more. *** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: A trap that will rip open the jugular of a victim.
abilities.detail: This trap will cut the jugular of any enemy of yours that tries to pass by it, causing great bleeding.

abilities.description: Put an alarm on a trap.
abilities.detail: Set an alarm on a trap such that the trap owner will be notified when the trap is sprung.

abilities.description: Your connection with nature is formidable indeed.
abilities.detail: Your bond with nature is so strong that you may now summon your animal companions anywhere that you may be in Sapience.

abilities.description: Numb the senses of this trap's victims.
abilities.detail: When sprung, the dustbomb will numb a person's senses, cutting off much sensory input for a time.

abilities.description: Summon a butterfly to assist you in combat.
abilities.detail: Though small and seemingly harmless, the butterfly is a powerful ally in combat, buzzing about your enemy's head and restoring their hearing. ** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: A trap that stuns its victims with a blow to the head.
abilities.detail: This trap drops a horseshoe on top of its victim's head, stunning him for a time.

abilities.description: Navigate the forests with expert skill.
abilities.detail: This ability grants a defence that, when activated, will allow you to move faster through the forests.

abilities.description: Attack your enemies with a flurry of flying thorns.
abilities.detail: While in a forested environment, you may fill the air with deadly flying thorns, damaging anyone in the room. ** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: Conceal the nature of a trap's effect.
abilities.detail: This powerful ability will allow you to disguise the effects of a trap from he who sets it off. The victim will know he set off a trap, but will not immediately know what kind of trap was set off.

abilities.description: Elude the intruding eyes below.
abilities.detail: Your masterful knowledge over the skies will allow you to perform skilful evasive techniques while flying, avoiding the piercing gazes of those on the ground below. Note that such action is very physically demanding, and such will incur a heavy endurance drain.

abilities.description: Drive one of your companions into a rage.
abilities.detail: Through your link with your companions, you are able to drive one into a rage, causing them to do a more dangerous attack than they normally would. This does not consume balance or equilibrium, and the animal does not need to be actively summoned for you to call it forth for a single attack. Badger: will deliver bleeding and addiction. If the target already has addiction, will deliver nausea. Fox: will deliver healthleech. Wolf: will give hallucinations. Lemming: will strip rebounding or shield; if neither are present, it will strip a random defence. Shield is always stripped before rebounding. Raven: will deliver sensitivity. Butterfly: will unblind its target.

abilities.description: Call the mighty grey wolf to your side.
abilities.detail: The most powerful of the animals that will come to your call, the mighty wolf will attack with its fangs and claws, damaging its victims. If your foe is lacking the deafness defence they will also be shaken by the wolf's howl, increasing damage taken. ** Those enemied to the forests will not be able to call upon the aid of Nature to assist them.

abilities.description: A trap to quickly overload an enemy with poisons.
abilities.detail: The darts trap, when sprung, will begin shooting darts (hopefully) holds 5 darts and will be destroyed when the last dart is shot.
abilities.required: 3 wood and 3 rope make 3 darts traps
abilities.syntax: ASSEMBLE DARTS TRAP / LAY DARTS <direction> / ENVENOM DARTS <direction> WITH <venom>

abilities.description: Your pledge.
abilities.detail: A wielder of the holy verses must first gain the ability to imbue their words with a remnant of Phoenix Song. Travel to the island of Anost in the City of Targossas(*) and ANOINT your brow with the holy ash that can be found there. * This is also a landmark, if you are unsure how to locate it on foot.

abilities.description: Knowledge of the holy verses.
abilities.detail: You may view the holy verses that you have learned, and the various limitations imposed on the use of each in prayer.

abilities.description: A verse to bolster the mind.
abilities.detail: This holy verse shall bolster the mind of yourself or an ally, improving their willpower regeneration.

abilities.description: May the protectors of Creation never falter.
abilities.detail: This holy verse shall grant improved endurance regeneration to yourself or an ally.

abilities.description: They shall hear what you have to say.
abilities.detail: Some would seek to close their ears as well as their hearts to the holy truth of the Light and Fire. No matter. With this verse you may force them to attend you, stripping away such protections with a simple sentence.

abilities.description: The verse of the righteous.
abilities.detail: Recite the verse of fire, granting you or an ally protection against the ravages of flame.

abilities.description: A verse to stave off the outer cold.
abilities.detail: This holy verse is both warning and protection. It grants improved resistance to cold damage to either yourself or an ally.

abilities.description: The verse of protection.
abilities.detail: A holy verse of protection, this scripture conveys a protection on yourself or an ally that reduces incoming damage from physical blows.

abilities.description: The profane are weak in body as with mind.
abilities.detail: Direct this holy verse at a profane enemy of Creation and the next blow you deal with your mace shall deal greatly increased damage to the chosen limb(*). * This increases the next mace attack's limb damage you deal by approximately 30%.

abilities.description: Chaining the holy verses.
abilities.detail: You may now chain holy verses together. Each verse you recite(*) somewhat quickly after a prior one will form a prayer; a prayer of two or more verses that you allow to finish without reciting further will grant you conviction. Conviction is used to enact some of the more powerful holy verses. Additionally, certain verses can only be utilised once per prayer, and others may require a prayer of a certain length before they can be recited. * Verses that specifically target yourself do not increase your prayer's length. Prayers that target others or that are somewhat indiscriminate do.

abilities.description: There will be a reckoning.
abilities.detail: Condemn your foe with this holy verse, striking them down with the justice affliction.

abilities.description: Remind them of their failings.
abilities.detail: This verse reminds a foe of their life's failings, forcing them to confront them. Attempts to focus their mind shall only serve to worsen their situation(*). * Focus still cures an affliction, but it also gives a new mental affliction in the cured one's place.

abilities.description: There will be barriers to overcome.
abilities.detail: You will persevere even when your enemy flees to the skies. Reciting this holy verse will draw them back down to your level.

abilities.description: You will not back away from what must be done.
abilities.detail: This holy verse can drive you to greater levels of fervour, allowing you to strike through the next attempt to parry that the foe you recite it against attempts. In addition, reciting this verse while you are not hunting the heretics shall convey the heresy defence, though it will be more short-lived compared to utilising the spirituality ability. Recitation of this verse is not affected by weariness.

abilities.description: Consign them to their fate.
abilities.detail: This verse brings forth latent fires that sear at the soul, lying in wait to be ignited by true fire(*). * When a target takes damage from ticks of being on fire, they will also suffer mana damage. They shall also take mana damage if they successfully move while on fire. * Gives the spiritburn affliction.

abilities.description: Let them gaze upon their sins.
abilities.detail: Recite this holy verse and allow the profane soul to gaze upon their past sins, paralysing them with the truth of their corruption(*). * Gives the paralysis affliction.

abilities.description: The verse of self reflection.
abilities.detail: Recite this verse against one of the profane and they shall share in the suffering they would seek to bring upon you. Some of the afflictions dealt to you shall be gifted back to them in turn for a short time(*). * Ten seconds.

abilities.description: Punish their transgressions.
abilities.detail: Your mastery of the holy verses now grants you the ability to conclude your prayer with a punishment of one of a heretics sins. Certain punishments require a prayer of longer length than others. The punishment is given alongside the standard verse effect: Chaos: requires a prayer of at least two verses, gives hallucinations. Darkness: requires a prayer of at least two verses, gives paranoia. Evil: requires a prayer of at least three verses, gives masochism. Heresy: requires a prayer of at least four verses. Gives the inquisition affliction to a target suffering from both the guilt and spiritburn afflictions. Note that you may only couple rebuke with a verse that also targets a specific enemy.

abilities.description: Let the fire speak for you.
abilities.detail: Perhaps the most straight forward of all holy verses, but no less powerful for that. Send fire to scourge the flesh of your profane foe, leaving them tender and pained to such an extent that any attempt to apply a salve shall cause them to suffer in mind(*). * Drains mana on applying salves. * Gives the tenderskin affliction.

abilities.description: The rallying cry of the Light.
abilities.detail: The rallying cry of the light, this verse will heal all of your blessed comrades in your location and for each one healed it shall cure an affliction from you. Though there is no limit on how often a priest may recite this verse, it may only be recited in a given location every so often(*). * 30 seconds.

abilities.description: Righteous fury is a thing to behold.
abilities.detail: The verse of wrath shall ravage your foe with holy flame, burning their mind(*). If they are also alight with regular flame(**) and prone, they shall suffer in body as well. * The mana damage scales to the number of afflictions they are suffering from. Guilt, ablaze, spiritburn, and tenderskin increase the value by more than other afflictions, followed by mental and limb based afflictions. Inquisition increases more than anything else. ** If they have the ablaze affliction.

abilities.description: Let the disease be burned away.
abilities.detail: Recite the holy verse of purging to damage your foe and set them ablaze.

abilities.description: You will not stand for such corruption.
abilities.detail: The verse of rejection is a manifestation of your defiance in the face of the enemies of Creation. Recite this verse, and even from a far you shall strike down your foes. * Does damage to a target in line of sight. Notably, this bypasses magical shields and prismatic barriers.

abilities.description: Creation shall flourish.
abilities.detail: The enemies of Creation shall learn that your cause is a righteous one, whether they care to hear or not(*). * You will never stumble over your recitals when directed against one afflicted with justice.

abilities.description: The verse of salvation.
abilities.detail: A prayer for salvation, not for yourself but for others, this powerful verse of prayer shall create a prismatic barrier for all blessed comrades in your location.

abilities.description: A holy blessing to protect the righteous.
abilities.detail: This holy benediction shall grant all of the blessings gained from reciting the verses of fire, void, protection, will and endurance to an individual in your location. Due to the nature of this supplication, it is not considered a holy verse and does not compose any aspect of a prayer.

abilities.description: The verse of glory.
abilities.detail: A verse inspiring victory and tenacity, this holy power will bring forth a blessed protection on a given location when recited against a foe of Creation. For one minute after activation if an individual blessed by devotion to the gods falls in battle and is raised by the grace of the stars, he or she shall be pulled from the location to a random adjacent location. This effect can fire up to three times before it runs its course, and it can not be brought forth again for a short time in the location(*). * This cooldown is on the location, not on the priest.

abilities.description: Show them Evil's horror.
abilities.detail: Recite this holy verse to reveal to a heretic the true depths of Evil's depravity; permit them not the chance to turn their eyes away. * Gives the hellsight affliction.
